generic.Defined scope/population: All cedant loss advices sitting in received status without an acknowledgement in the reinsurance administration system.
generic.In-scope period: Advices date-stamped as received since the previous acknowledgement run and still inside the contractual window.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Acknowledgement carries cedant claim reference, treaty number, unique market reference and a send date.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Advices received in the period equal advices acknowledged plus those still inside the contractual window.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Sent acknowledgement email filed to the reinsurance loss file with its send timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Advices that cannot be acknowledged are logged with the blocking reason and a named chase owner.
generic.Test population: All cedant loss advices received during the review period across every treaty.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fails if any loss advice remains unacknowledged beyond the contractual acknowledgement window.
generic.Exception handling path: Blocked acknowledgements return to the specialist worklist with a same-day resolution target.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Acknowledgement is accepted when it quotes claim and treaty references and states without prejudice wording.
generic.Evidence location: Acknowledgement correspondence stored on the ceded loss file in the reinsurance administration system.

steps.title: Extract unacknowledged loss advices from the reinsurance administration system
sop: Open the loss advice queue in the reinsurance administration system.
Filter on status received where no acknowledgement date is recorded.
Sort by advice date-stamp so the oldest advices are handled first.
Done when the unacknowledged advice worklist is produced for the run.
verify: Compare the worklist count to the advice queue filter count.
Pass when every received advice with no acknowledgement date appears on the worklist.

steps.title: Read the contractual acknowledgement window from the advice record
sop: Open each advice record and read the acknowledgement window held against the governing treaty.
Calculate the due date from the advice date-stamp, not the date the file was opened.
Mark advices already inside the final 24 hours of the window as priority.
Done when every advice on the worklist carries a calculated acknowledgement due date.
verify: Re-derive two due dates by hand from the advice date-stamp.
Pass when the recalculated due dates match the values on the advice records.

steps.title: Draft the acknowledgement text in Microsoft Teams / Email
sop: Start from the standard acknowledgement template held for cedant loss advices.
Insert the cedant claim reference, contract or treaty number and unique market reference.
State that the advice is noted without prejudice to coverage or liability.
Done when the acknowledgement draft is complete for each advice on the worklist.
verify: Read each draft against the three mandatory references and the without prejudice wording.
Pass when no draft is missing a reference or the without prejudice statement.

steps.title: Check the draft references against the reinsurance administration system record
sop: Open the ceded loss record alongside the acknowledgement draft.
Confirm the claim reference and treaty number in the draft match the system values.
Correct any mismatch in the draft rather than editing the system record.
Done when all draft references tie to the reinsurance administration system.
verify: Spot-check the references on a sample of drafts against the system record.
Pass when no sampled draft carries a reference that differs from the system.

steps.title: Send the acknowledgement to the cedant from Microsoft Teams / Email
sop: Address the acknowledgement to the cedant claims contact named on the advice.
Send within the contractual acknowledgement window measured from the advice date-stamp.
Capture the send timestamp for each acknowledgement issued.
Done when every in-scope advice has an acknowledgement sent.
verify: Compare each send timestamp against the calculated acknowledgement due date.
Pass when no acknowledgement was sent after its contractual due date.

steps.title: File the acknowledgement copy against the reinsurance loss file
sop: Attach the sent acknowledgement to the ceded loss file in the reinsurance administration system.
Set the acknowledgement date field on the advice record so it drops out of the queue.
Log any advice still unacknowledged with the blocking reason and a chase owner.
Done when every advice shows either an acknowledgement or a logged exception.
verify: Re-run the unacknowledged advice filter after filing.
Pass when the only advices returned are those carrying a logged exception reason.

generic.Defined scope/population: Loss advices issued to reinsurers where no acknowledgement has been received back from the market or broker.
generic.In-scope period: The weekly chase cycle covering all advices outstanding at the extract date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Every chase records contact name, channel used and chase date on the loss advice record.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Un-acknowledged advice count on the exception list equals open items on the chase log.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Chase emails retained against the advice record with the date each chase was issued.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Reinsurers with three or more open acknowledgements are flagged with the escalation decision recorded.
generic.Test population: All outstanding loss advices in the weekly chase cycle across reinsurers and brokers.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fails if an advice unanswered for 10 business days has no second chase to the broker.
generic.Exception handling path: Persistent non-responders are flagged to the Reinsurance Ops Manager with the chase history attached.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: A chase is accepted when contact name, channel and date are logged against the advice.
generic.Evidence location: Chase history held on each outstanding loss advice record in the reinsurance administration system.

steps.title: Run the un-acknowledged advices exception list in the reinsurance administration system
sop: Run the exception query for advices submitted with no reinsurer acknowledgement recorded.
Restrict to the weekly chase cycle cut-off date.
Include the submission date so ageing can be calculated per advice.
Done when the weekly un-acknowledged advice list is produced.
verify: Check the list against submitted advices with a blank acknowledgement field.
Pass when every submitted advice lacking an acknowledgement is on the list.

steps.title: Age the outstanding advices in Microsoft Excel
sop: Load the exception list into the chase workbook in Microsoft Excel.
Calculate business days elapsed since the advice submission date for each row.
Split the list into first chase due and second chase due at 10 business days.
Done when every outstanding advice sits in a chase bucket.
verify: Recalculate elapsed business days on a sample of rows.
Pass when the sampled rows fall into the same chase bucket on recalculation.

steps.title: Issue first chases to reinsurers from Microsoft Teams / Email
sop: Send the first chase to the reinsurer contact holding the advice.
Quote the advice reference, treaty and original submission date in the chase.
Request written acknowledgement and give a response date.
Done when a first chase is issued for every advice in the first chase bucket.
verify: Match sent chases to the first chase bucket rows.
Pass when no first chase bucket row is left without a sent chase.

steps.title: Issue second chases through the broker from Microsoft Teams / Email
sop: Identify advices unanswered beyond 10 business days from the ageing.
Send the second chase to the placing broker and copy the reinsurer.
Attach the original advice and the first chase for context.
Done when every advice past 10 business days has a broker second chase.
verify: Compare the 10 business day bucket to the second chases sent.
Pass when no advice past 10 business days lacks a broker chase.

steps.title: Log each chase against the advice record in the reinsurance administration system
sop: Open the advice record for each chase issued.
Record the contact name, channel used and chase date against the record.
Record any promised acknowledgement date given by the market.
Done when every chase issued in the cycle is logged on its advice record.
verify: Compare the count of chases sent to chase log entries created.
Pass when the chase log entry count equals the chases sent in the cycle.

steps.title: Flag repeat non-responders for escalation
sop: Group outstanding advices by reinsurer in the Microsoft Excel chase workbook.
Identify reinsurers carrying three or more open acknowledgements.
Flag those reinsurers to the Reinsurance Ops Manager with the chase history attached.
Done when every repeat non-responder is flagged with supporting chase history.
verify: Recount open advices per reinsurer from the exception list.
Pass when every reinsurer at three or more open advices carries an escalation flag.

generic.Defined scope/population: Ceded losses where the advice was issued after the contractual notice period in the governing treaty.
generic.In-scope period: Breaches identified since the previous notification compliance review.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Breach entry holds treaty, claim, contractual notice period and the actual notification date.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Breach count agrees to advices flagged late by the notification compliance extract.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Escalation correspondence and breach entry retained with the date the breach was identified.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Each breach records whether a waiver was sought and the market response received.
generic.Test population: All loss advices issued in the period tested against their contractual notice periods.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fails if a breach is not escalated to the Head of Reinsurance within 2 business days.
generic.Exception handling path: Contested breaches are routed to the broker for a without-prejudice waiver request.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: An escalation is accepted when it quantifies the prejudiced ceded amount and names the treaty clause.
generic.Evidence location: Breach register in the reinsurance administration system with escalation emails attached.

steps.title: Extract late notifications from the reinsurance administration system
sop: Run the notification compliance extract comparing advice date to submission date.
Flag every advice submitted after the contractual notice period expired.
Exclude advices where the notice period was extended by agreement on file.
Done when the late notification population for the period is identified.
verify: Re-test two flagged advices against their notice periods by hand.
Pass when both hand tests confirm the extract classification.

steps.title: Confirm the contractual notice period in the treaty repository
sop: Open the executed wording for the treaty and year in the treaty repository.
Read the notice period from the claims notification clause in the wording.
Confirm whether the period runs from knowledge of loss or from reserve threshold breach.
Done when the governing notice period is confirmed for every flagged advice.
verify: Compare the confirmed period to the value used in the compliance extract.
Pass when the extract period matches the executed wording for each flagged advice.

steps.title: Quantify the prejudiced ceded exposure in the reinsurance administration system
sop: Pull the ceded recoverable computed for the late-notified loss.
State the ceded amount potentially prejudiced by the late notice.
Note any layers where the exposure could still be recovered if a waiver is granted.
Done when each breach carries a quantified ceded exposure figure.
verify: Re-derive the ceded exposure from the recoverable calculation.
Pass when the quantified exposure agrees to the recoverable calculation.

steps.title: Record the breach entry on the breach register
sop: Create a breach entry holding treaty, claim and contractual notice period.
Record the actual notification date and the days by which it was late.
Attach the quantified ceded exposure to the entry.
Done when every identified breach has a complete register entry.
verify: Check each register entry for the four mandatory data points.
Pass when no breach entry is missing treaty, claim, notice period or notification date.

steps.title: Instruct the broker to seek a waiver of late notice by Microsoft Teams / Email
sop: Brief the broker on the breach, the exposure and the reason for the delay.
Ask the broker to seek a without-prejudice waiver of late notice from the market.
Set a response deadline for the broker to report the market position.
Done when a waiver instruction has been issued for every eligible breach.
verify: Check that each breach with waiver potential carries a broker instruction.
Pass when no eligible breach lacks a dated waiver instruction.

steps.title: Escalate the breach to the Head of Reinsurance
sop: Prepare an escalation stating the breach, the clause and the prejudiced exposure.
Issue the escalation within 2 business days of identifying the breach.
Record the escalation date and recipient on the breach register.
Done when every breach carries a dated escalation record.
verify: Compare the escalation date to the breach identification date on each entry.
Pass when no escalation was issued more than 2 business days after identification.

generic.Defined scope/population: Open claims in the claims management platform with gross incurred at or approaching a treaty notification threshold.
generic.In-scope period: The daily claims extract covering movements since the previous reportable loss run.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each flagged loss carries a reportable decision, the governing treaty and the clause cited.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Claims above the threshold in the extract equal claims carrying a reportable decision.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Daily extract retained with its run date alongside the reportable decisions taken.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Claims above threshold judged not reportable are logged with the rationale recorded.
generic.Test population: All claims in the daily extract at or above the treaty notification threshold.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fails if any claim over the notification threshold has no reportable decision recorded.
generic.Exception handling path: Borderline development cases are marked precautionary and re-tested on the next daily run.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: A flag is accepted when the reportable tag cites the governing treaty clause on the record.
generic.Evidence location: Reportable flags and clause references on the loss records in the reinsurance administration system.

steps.title: Run the daily claims extract in the claims management platform
sop: Run the daily extract of open claims with current gross incurred values.
Include loss date, line of business, territory and policy reference on each row.
Restrict to claims with movement since the previous extract plus all claims near threshold.
Done when the daily claims extract is available for threshold testing.
verify: Check the extract row count against the claims platform open claim count.
Pass when the extract covers every open claim in scope for the run.

steps.title: Load treaty notification thresholds from the treaty repository
sop: Open the treaty repository and read notification thresholds by treaty and year.
Note whether each threshold applies to incurred or paid amounts.
Record whether the threshold is expressed at 100 percent or on the ceded share.
Done when the threshold table for the run reflects the executed wordings.
verify: Compare two thresholds in the table to the executed wording text.
Pass when both sampled thresholds match the wording.

steps.title: Filter the extract on gross incurred against the thresholds
sop: Apply the threshold table to the daily claims extract by treaty and year.
Retain claims with gross incurred at or above the notification threshold.
Keep the applied threshold value on each retained row for traceability.
Done when the above-threshold claim population is isolated.
verify: Re-test a sample of retained rows against the applied threshold.
Pass when every sampled row is genuinely at or above its threshold.

steps.title: Identify precautionary cases with the Claims Examiner
sop: Review claims below threshold with adverse development or open litigation.
Flag cases where incurred could reasonably develop past the notification threshold.
Record the reason each case is treated as precautionary.
Done when the precautionary case list is agreed for the run.
verify: Review the precautionary list against the claims that were excluded.
Pass when no case with known adverse development is left off the list.

steps.title: Test facultative certificates separately in the reinsurance administration system
sop: Identify claims on risks with facultative certificates attached.
Read the per-risk certificate reporting terms for each affected risk.
Test the claim against the certificate terms rather than the treaty threshold.
Done when every facultative risk has a certificate-level reporting decision.
verify: Check the facultative decisions against the certificate reporting terms.
Pass when no facultative risk was tested only against the treaty threshold.

steps.title: Tag reportable losses with the governing clause on the loss record
sop: Set the reportable flag on each qualifying loss in the reinsurance administration system.
Cite the governing treaty clause on the record next to the flag.
Log a rationale for any above-threshold claim decided as not reportable.
Done when every above-threshold claim carries a reportable decision.
verify: Re-run the above-threshold filter and inspect the decision field.
Pass when no above-threshold claim is left without a reportable decision and clause.

generic.Defined scope/population: Claims in the claims management platform with a loss date inside a declared catastrophe event window.
generic.In-scope period: The event window as defined by the hours clause elected for the catastrophe.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Claim header holds event code, market catastrophe number and the event date range.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Event-coded claim count and gross incurred agree to the cat aggregation report.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Coding run output retained with its date and the event definition version applied.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Miscoded claims are logged with the correction made and the re-run confirmation.
generic.Test population: All claims carrying the event code plus all claims with loss dates inside the window.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fails if a claim outside the hours clause window still carries the event code.
generic.Exception handling path: Disputed event linkage is referred to the Claims Examiner before coding is changed.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Coding is accepted when the aggregation extract totals tie to the event-coded claim population.
generic.Evidence location: Event coding fields on the claim header in the claims management platform.

steps.title: Confirm the event definition and hours clause window
sop: Read the agreed catastrophe event definition for the declared event.
Note the elected hours clause window as 72 or 168 hours with start datetime.
Record the peril and territory scope covered by the definition.
Done when the coding parameters for the event are fixed for the run.
verify: Compare the parameters to the recorded event definition.
Pass when the window, peril and territory match the agreed definition.

steps.title: Set the event code on qualifying claims in Guidewire ClaimCenter
sop: Open each qualifying claim header in Guidewire ClaimCenter.
Set the event code, market catastrophe number and event date range.
Apply the code on the claim header rather than only in file notes.
Done when every qualifying claim carries the event coding fields.
verify: Query claims in the event population for a populated event code.
Pass when no qualifying claim is missing the event code on the header.

steps.title: Apply the hours clause window to the coded population
sop: List all claims currently carrying the event code with their loss date and time.
Test each loss date against the elected hours clause window.
Remove the code from claims falling outside the window.
Done when only losses inside the window carry the event code.
verify: Re-query coded claims and compare loss dates to the window.
Pass when no coded claim has a loss date outside the hours clause window.

steps.title: Correct claims coded to the wrong event with the Claims Examiner
sop: Review claims coded to a neighbouring or superseded event code.
Confirm the correct event with the handling examiner before changing the code.
Update the claim header to the correct event code and record the reason.
Done when every miscoded claim has been corrected on the claim header.
verify: Check corrected claims against the examiner confirmation notes.
Pass when every code change carries a recorded reason.

steps.title: Re-run the aggregation extract in the reinsurance administration system
sop: Re-run the cat aggregation extract after the coding corrections post.
Capture the event-coded claim count and gross incurred from the extract.
Retain the extract with its run date against the event record.
Done when a refreshed aggregation extract exists for the event.
verify: Compare the extract run date to the date of the last coding change.
Pass when the extract was run after the final coding correction.

steps.title: Reconcile coded claims to the cat aggregation report
sop: Compare the event-coded claim count in the claims platform to the aggregation report.
Compare gross incurred on the coded population to the aggregation total.
Investigate and clear any difference before signing off the coding run.
Done when the coded population reconciles to the aggregation report.
verify: Inspect the reconciliation for unexplained differences.
Pass when count and gross incurred agree with no unexplained variance.

generic.Defined scope/population: Inbound loss advices not yet linked to a governing treaty in the reinsurance administration system.
generic.In-scope period: Advices received since the previous treaty matching run.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Advice record holds a linked treaty, treaty year and the affected layers.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Unlinked advice count falls to nil or to a logged exception count after the run.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Attachment rationale filed to the loss file with the date the decision was made.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Advices where two treaty years could respond are logged with the attachment rationale.
generic.Test population: All inbound loss advices processed in the matching run.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fails if any advice is left without a linked treaty, treaty year and layer.
generic.Exception handling path: Ambiguous attachments are referred to the Ceded Reinsurance Analyst for a documented decision.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: A match is accepted when loss date, line of business and territory all fall inside the treaty terms.
generic.Evidence location: Treaty, year and layer links on the loss advice record in the reinsurance administration system.

steps.title: List unlinked loss advices in the reinsurance administration system
sop: Filter loss advices where the governing treaty link is blank.
Include loss date, line of business, territory and policy reference on each row.
Order by loss date so the oldest advices are matched first.
Done when the unlinked advice worklist is produced.
verify: Compare the worklist to advices with a blank treaty link.
Pass when every unlinked advice appears on the worklist.

steps.title: Retrieve candidate treaties from the treaty repository
sop: Search the treaty repository for treaties covering the line of business and territory.
Pull the treaty period and the attachment basis for each candidate.
Note whether the treaty is losses-occurring or risks-attaching.
Done when candidate treaties are identified for every advice on the worklist.
verify: Check that each advice has at least one candidate treaty listed.
Pass when no advice is left without a candidate treaty or a documented gap.

steps.title: Test the loss date against the treaty period on the correct basis
sop: For losses-occurring treaties test the loss date against the treaty period.
For risks-attaching treaties test the underlying policy inception instead.
Reject candidates where the applicable date falls outside the treaty period.
Done when a single attaching treaty year is identified for each advice.
verify: Re-test two advices on the stated attachment basis.
Pass when both retests select the same treaty year as the match.

steps.title: Confirm the business-covered clause in the treaty repository
sop: Read the business-covered clause in the executed wording for the selected treaty.
Confirm the line of business on the claim falls inside the clause.
Confirm the territory on the claim falls inside the territorial scope.
Done when business and territory coverage is confirmed for each match.
verify: Compare the claim line and territory to the clause text.
Pass when no matched advice sits outside the business-covered clause.

steps.title: Link the treaty year and affected layers on the advice record
sop: Open the loss advice record in the reinsurance administration system.
Link the confirmed treaty and treaty year to the advice.
Select the layers the notified amount is expected to affect.
Done when treaty, year and layers are recorded on the advice.
verify: Re-run the unlinked advice filter after the links are applied.
Pass when only advices with logged exceptions remain unlinked.

steps.title: Document the attachment rationale where two treaty years could respond
sop: Identify advices where more than one treaty year could arguably respond.
State the attachment decision and the basis relied on in a file note.
File the note to the ceded loss file with the decision date.
Done when every ambiguous attachment carries a documented rationale.
verify: Check ambiguous advices for a filed rationale note.
Pass when no ambiguous attachment lacks a dated rationale on file.

generic.Defined scope/population: Notified reserve amounts on draft loss advices awaiting claims department sign-off before market release.
generic.In-scope period: Advices prepared since the last sign-off cycle and not yet released to the market.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Sign-off record names the examiner, the reserve amount signed and the sign-off date.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Reserve figures on the advice tie exactly to the claim system case reserve at the extract date.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Sign-off email retained against the advice with the reserve extract date it relates to.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Reserve figures the examiner will not sign are logged with the disputed amount and next action.
generic.Test population: All draft loss advices carrying a notified reserve in the cycle.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fails if any advice is released to reinsurers without a recorded reserve sign-off.
generic.Exception handling path: Unsigned reserves hold the advice from release until the examiner position is resolved.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Sign-off is accepted when it names the specific reserve amount rather than the claim generally.
generic.Evidence location: Sign-off records held against the notified reserve on the ceded loss file.

steps.title: Extract case reserves from the claims management platform
sop: Extract the current case reserve for every claim on a draft loss advice.
Record the extract date and time so the advice can quote the same basis.
Include paid to date so the incurred position is visible.
Done when a dated reserve extract exists for every draft advice.
verify: Compare a sample of extracted reserves to the claim screens.
Pass when the sampled reserves match the claims platform values.

steps.title: Tie advice reserve figures to the extract in the reinsurance administration system
sop: Compare the reserve stated on each draft advice to the extracted case reserve.
Correct the advice where the figure differs from the extract.
Record the extract date on the advice as the valuation basis.
Done when every advice reserve ties exactly to the extract.
verify: Re-compare advice reserves to the extract after corrections.
Pass when no advice carries a reserve differing from the extract.

steps.title: Explain reserve movement since the previous advice
sop: Compare the current reserve to the amount on the previous advice for the same loss.
Write a one-line rationale for each movement identified.
Attach the rationale to the draft advice for examiner review.
Done when every moved reserve carries a movement rationale.
verify: Check moved reserves for an attached rationale line.
Pass when no reserve movement is left unexplained.

steps.title: Request examiner sign-off by Microsoft Teams / Email
sop: Send the reserve figure, the extract date and the movement rationale to the handling examiner.
Ask the examiner to confirm the specific reserve amount, not the claim generally.
Set a response deadline aligned to the advice release date.
Done when a sign-off request is issued for every draft advice.
verify: Match sign-off requests to the draft advice population.
Pass when no draft advice lacks a sign-off request.

steps.title: Obtain and record the Claims Examiner sign-off
sop: Review the notified reserve against the claim file and adjuster position.
Confirm or challenge the specific reserve amount in writing.
State any condition attached to the sign-off.
Done when a written examiner position exists for every notified reserve.
verify: Read each examiner response for the specific amount confirmed.
Pass when every response names the reserve amount it approves.

steps.title: Gate release of the advice on the recorded sign-off
sop: Attach the examiner sign-off to the ceded loss file against the reserve.
Release only advices holding a recorded sign-off for the notified amount.
Log unsigned reserves with the disputed amount and the next action.
Done when every released advice carries a recorded reserve sign-off.
verify: Review released advices for an attached sign-off record.
Pass when no released advice lacks a recorded reserve sign-off.

generic.Defined scope/population: Ceded claims identified as reportable that have no reinsurance loss file open in the reinsurance administration system.
generic.In-scope period: Reportable claims raised since the previous file opening run.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Ceded loss record holds treaty, layer, cedant claim reference and the loss event.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Reportable claims equal ceded loss files opened plus logged exceptions.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: File opening entry retained with its creation date and the source claim reference.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Claims that cannot be opened are logged with the missing data and an owner.
generic.Test population: All reportable ceded claims processed in the file opening run.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fails if a ceded loss file exists with no cross-reference from the underlying claim record.
generic.Exception handling path: Missing treaty or layer data is referred to the Ceded Reinsurance Analyst before the file opens.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: A file is accepted when gross, retained and ceded amounts are populated at opening.
generic.Evidence location: Ceded loss record in the reinsurance administration system linked to the claim record.

steps.title: List reportable claims without a ceded loss file
sop: Filter reportable claims with no ceded loss file number recorded.
Include treaty, layer and cedant claim reference on each row.
Order by loss date so the oldest reportable claims open first.
Done when the file opening worklist is produced.
verify: Compare the worklist to reportable claims lacking a file number.
Pass when every reportable claim without a file appears on the worklist.

steps.title: Create the ceded loss record in the reinsurance administration system
sop: Create a ceded loss record for each claim on the worklist.
Populate treaty, layer, cedant claim reference and the loss event.
Set the file status to open with the opening date recorded.
Done when a ceded loss record exists for every worklist claim.
verify: Check each new record for the four mandatory identifiers.
Pass when no new record is missing treaty, layer, claim reference or event.

steps.title: Populate gross, retained and ceded amounts at opening
sop: Read gross incurred from the claims management platform for the claim.
Apply the treaty retention to derive the retained and ceded split.
Enter gross, retained and ceded amounts on the ceded loss record.
Done when all three amounts are populated on every new file.
verify: Recompute the ceded amount from gross less retention on a sample.
Pass when the sampled ceded amounts agree to the recomputation.

steps.title: Link underlying documents from the claim file repository
sop: Locate the adjuster report, policy and payment evidence in the claim file repository.
Link the documents to the ceded loss record rather than re-uploading copies.
Confirm each link resolves to the current document version.
Done when the required underlying documents are linked to the ceded file.
verify: Open each link from the ceded loss record.
Pass when every link resolves and no document has been duplicated.

steps.title: Write the ceded file number back to the claims management platform
sop: Open the underlying claim record in the claims management platform.
Record the ceded loss file number in the reinsurance reference field.
Save the claim so the cross-reference is visible to claims handlers.
Done when every opened ceded file is referenced on its claim record.
verify: Query claims with a ceded file for a populated reference field.
Pass when every ceded file is cross-referenced from its claim record.

steps.title: Log exceptions where a file cannot be opened
sop: Identify worklist claims blocked by missing treaty or amount data.
Log each blocked claim with the missing data item and a named owner.
Set a target date for the missing data to be supplied.
Done when every blocked claim carries a logged exception.
verify: Compare the worklist to files opened plus logged exceptions.
Pass when the two totals reconcile with no unaccounted claim.

generic.Defined scope/population: Ceded losses flagged reportable with an open loss file and no formal loss advice drafted.
generic.In-scope period: Reportable losses arising inside the current contractual notice periods.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Advice states loss date, cause, policy or certificate, gross incurred, retention and ceded share.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Reinsurer signed shares on the advice sum to 100 percent of the ceded layer.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Draft advice held on the ceded loss file with its draft date and version.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Advices that cannot be completed are logged with the missing data item and owner.
generic.Test population: All reportable ceded losses requiring a formal advice in the drafting cycle.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fails if any mandatory data field on a drafted advice is left blank.
generic.Exception handling path: Missing adjuster reports are chased from the cedant before the advice is finalised.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: A draft is accepted when the reserve basis is stated as case, precautionary or advice-only.
generic.Evidence location: Draft loss advice stored on the ceded loss file in the reinsurance administration system.

steps.title: List reportable losses needing an advice in the reinsurance administration system
sop: Filter open ceded loss files flagged reportable with no draft advice attached.
Include the contractual notice period end date on each row.
Order by notice period expiry so the tightest deadlines draft first.
Done when the advice drafting worklist is produced.
verify: Compare the worklist to reportable files without a draft advice.
Pass when every reportable file lacking a draft appears on the worklist.

steps.title: Assemble loss facts from the ceded loss file
sop: Collect loss date, cause of loss and the policy or certificate reference.
Collect gross incurred split between paid to date and outstanding.
Note the retention applying under the governing treaty.
Done when the loss fact set is complete for each advice to be drafted.
verify: Check the fact set against the ceded loss record fields.
Pass when no fact on the set conflicts with the ceded loss record.

steps.title: Compute the ceded share and reinsurer signed shares in Microsoft Excel
sop: Apply the treaty retention to gross incurred to derive the ceded amount.
Apply reinsurer signed shares for the treaty year to split the ceded amount.
Check the signed shares total 100 percent of the ceded layer.
Done when per-reinsurer shares are computed for the advice.
verify: Sum the signed shares on the computed schedule.
Pass when the shares sum to 100 percent of the ceded layer.

steps.title: State the reserve basis explicitly on the draft
sop: Determine whether the notified reserve is case, precautionary or advice-only.
Write the reserve basis into the advice in plain terms.
Note the valuation date the reserve figure relates to.
Done when the reserve basis is stated explicitly on every draft advice.
verify: Read each draft for an explicit reserve basis statement.
Pass when no draft leaves the reserve basis unstated.

steps.title: Attach the adjuster report and coverage position from the claim file repository
sop: Retrieve the latest adjuster report and coverage position from the claim file repository.
Attach both to the draft advice as supporting documentation.
Log a chase where either document is not yet available.
Done when supporting documentation is attached or a chase is logged.
verify: Check each draft for attached adjuster report and coverage position.
Pass when every draft holds both documents or a logged chase.

steps.title: Save the completed draft to the ceded loss file
sop: Review the draft against the mandatory data field list.
Save the draft to the ceded loss file with a version and draft date.
Mark the file as advice drafted so it moves to the submission queue.
Done when every worklist loss has a saved draft advice.
verify: Inspect saved drafts for completion of all mandatory fields.
Pass when no saved draft has a blank mandatory data field.

generic.Defined scope/population: All open ceded losses above the large-loss threshold plus notification compliance results for the month.
generic.In-scope period: The reporting month ending at the last calendar day of the period.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Register rows carry loss reference, treaty, current ceded amount and movement since prior month.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Register total ties to the ceded outstanding balance in the reinsurance administration system.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Issued report retained with its version and the date it was circulated.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Losses excluded from the register are logged with the exclusion reason.
generic.Test population: All open losses above the large-loss threshold at month end.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fails if the report is not circulated to the Head of Reinsurance by the 5th working day.
generic.Exception handling path: Data gaps found in preparation are referred back to the specialist queue before issue.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: The report is accepted when new and closed losses are shown as separate sections.
generic.Evidence location: Published monthly report on the BI reporting platform with the circulation record.

steps.title: Extract open large losses from the reinsurance administration system
sop: Extract open ceded losses at or above the large-loss threshold at month end.
Include prior month ceded amount so movement can be calculated.
Include notification and submission dates for the compliance metric.
Done when the month end large-loss extract is available.
verify: Check the extract against the open loss population above threshold.
Pass when every open loss above threshold is in the extract.

steps.title: Calculate movement since the prior month in Microsoft Excel
sop: Load the current and prior month extracts into the register workbook.
Calculate the movement in ceded amount for each open loss.
Flag movements above the reporting tolerance for commentary.
Done when every register row carries a calculated movement.
verify: Recalculate movement on a sample of rows.
Pass when the sampled movements agree to the workbook values.

steps.title: Compute the notification compliance metric
sop: Compare submission dates to contractual notice period end dates for the month.
Compute the percentage of advices issued inside the notice period.
List the late advices individually beneath the metric.
Done when the notification compliance metric is computed for the month.
verify: Re-test the late advices against their notice periods.
Pass when the metric agrees to the recount of late advices.

steps.title: Split newly notified and closed losses into separate sections
sop: Identify losses newly notified during the reporting month.
Identify losses closed during the reporting month.
Present each group as its own section in the register.
Done when new and closed losses are shown separately from the standing register.
verify: Review the register layout for the two separate sections.
Pass when new and closed losses are not merged into the main list.

steps.title: Publish the report on the BI reporting platform
sop: Load the register and compliance metric into the monthly report on the BI platform.
Reconcile the register total to the ceded outstanding balance before publishing.
Version the published report with the reporting period.
Done when the monthly report is published for the period.
verify: Compare the published register total to the ceded outstanding balance.
Pass when the two totals agree.

steps.title: Circulate the report to the Head of Reinsurance
sop: Circulate the published report by the 5th working day of the month.
Record the circulation date and recipients against the report.
Log any data gap raised in response with an owner and due date.
Done when the report is circulated and the circulation is recorded.
verify: Compare the circulation date to the 5th working day of the month.
Pass when the report was circulated on or before the 5th working day.

generic.Defined scope/population: Ceded loss files where adjuster reports, proof of loss or payment evidence are outstanding from the cedant.
generic.In-scope period: Documentation gaps identified since the previous documentation review run.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each request lists the missing items, the treaty clause relied on and a response due date.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Open documentation gaps equal issued requests plus items already received and indexed.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Issued request email retained on the ceded loss file with its send date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Cedants refusing documents are logged with the refusal reason and the escalation taken.
generic.Test population: All ceded loss files with an incomplete documentation checklist.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fails if an outstanding documentation request has no due date on the ceded loss file.
generic.Exception handling path: Overdue documentation requests move to the chase list for a second request to the cedant.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: A request is accepted when it cites the access-to-records or claims-cooperation clause.
generic.Evidence location: Documentation request and received items indexed to the ceded loss file.

steps.title: Review documentation completeness on the ceded loss file
sop: Open each ceded loss file and check the documentation checklist status.
Compare held documents in the claim file repository against the required list.
Mark files where adjuster report, proof of loss or payment evidence is missing.
Done when files with documentation gaps are identified.
verify: Re-check two flagged files against the claim file repository contents.
Pass when both files genuinely lack the items marked as missing.

steps.title: Itemise the documentation gap list
sop: List the specific outstanding items per loss file rather than a generic request.
Name the adjuster report, proof of loss and payment evidence individually.
Note any item already promised by the cedant with its promised date.
Done when an itemised gap list exists for each affected loss file.
verify: Compare the gap list to the documentation checklist on the file.
Pass when every unchecked required item appears on the gap list.

steps.title: Cite the governing clause in the request
sop: Identify the access-to-records or claims-cooperation clause in the governing treaty.
Quote the clause reference in the request text.
State the contractual basis for the documents being sought.
Done when every request carries the governing clause reference.
verify: Read each request for a quoted clause reference.
Pass when no request is issued without a clause citation.

steps.title: Issue the request to the cedant from Microsoft Teams / Email
sop: Send the itemised request to the named cedant claims contact.
Set an explicit response due date in the request text.
Copy the broker where the relationship runs through an intermediary.
Done when a request is issued for every file with a documentation gap.
verify: Match issued requests to the gap list population.
Pass when no file with a gap is left without an issued request.

steps.title: Diarise the response due date against the ceded loss file
sop: Record the request and its due date on the ceded loss file.
Set a diary entry to review the file on the due date.
Flag files where the due date falls close to a notification deadline.
Done when every issued request is diarised with a due date.
verify: Query open documentation requests for a populated due date.
Pass when no open request lacks a due date on the ceded loss file.

steps.title: Index received documents to the ceded loss file
sop: Index documents received against the request into the claim file repository.
Link the indexed documents to the ceded loss file on arrival.
Close the gap item on the documentation checklist once indexed.
Done when all received documents are indexed and the checklist is updated.
verify: Compare received documents to closed checklist items.
Pass when every received document has been indexed and its item closed.

generic.Defined scope/population: Drafted loss advices awaiting submission to reinsurers and brokers on the treaty security list.
generic.In-scope period: Advices due for submission inside their contractual notice periods.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Submission record holds recipients, send date-stamp and the delivery confirmation reference.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Distribution list matches the signed security on the treaty slip for that treaty year.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Delivery receipt or exchange confirmation stored against the loss advice record.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Failed deliveries are logged with the reinsurer, the failure reason and the resend action.
generic.Test population: All drafted loss advices in the submission queue for the cycle.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fails if a prepared advice remains unsubmitted past its contractual notice period.
generic.Exception handling path: Bounced or rejected submissions are resent through the broker the same business day.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: A submission is accepted when a dated delivery confirmation is stored on the advice record.
generic.Evidence location: Submission confirmations on the loss advice record in the reinsurance administration system.

steps.title: Build the distribution list from the treaty security
sop: Open the treaty slip security for the relevant treaty year.
List every reinsurer on risk with its signed share and contact route.
Add the placing broker where the placement is intermediated.
Done when the distribution list is built for each advice to be submitted.
verify: Compare the distribution list to the signed security on the slip.
Pass when the list matches the signed security for that treaty year.

steps.title: Check notice period headroom before submission
sop: Read the contractual notice period end date on each drafted advice.
Order the submission queue so advices closest to expiry go first.
Escalate any advice already past its notice period before sending.
Done when the submission queue is ordered by notice period headroom.
verify: Compare queue order to the notice period end dates.
Pass when no advice with earlier expiry sits behind a later one.

steps.title: Submit the advice through the Reinsurer Exchange
sop: Upload the advice and supporting documents to the Reinsurer Exchange.
Address the submission to each reinsurer on the distribution list.
Capture the exchange confirmation reference generated on submission.
Done when the advice is submitted to every exchange-enabled reinsurer.
verify: Compare exchange confirmations to the exchange-enabled recipients.
Pass when every exchange recipient has a confirmation reference.

steps.title: Submit to remaining recipients from Microsoft Teams / Email
sop: Send the advice by email to reinsurers not reachable on the exchange.
Copy the placing broker on every intermediated submission.
Request a read or delivery receipt on each email sent.
Done when every distribution list recipient has received the advice.
verify: Match sent emails to the non-exchange recipients on the list.
Pass when no listed recipient is left without a submission.

steps.title: Date-stamp the submission on the loss advice record
sop: Record the submission date-stamp on the loss advice record.
Compare the date-stamp to the contractual notice period end date.
Flag any submission made after the notice period for breach handling.
Done when every submitted advice carries a recorded submission date.
verify: Query submitted advices for a populated submission date-stamp.
Pass when no submitted advice is missing its date-stamp.

steps.title: Store delivery confirmations against the advice record
sop: Attach exchange confirmations and email delivery receipts to the advice record.
Log failed deliveries with the reinsurer and the failure reason.
Resend failed submissions through the broker the same business day.
Done when every submission has a stored confirmation or a logged failure.
verify: Review advice records for stored confirmations.
Pass when every recipient shows a confirmation or a logged and resent failure.

generic.Defined scope/population: Notified losses on the loss advice register affected by reserve movements or additional payments.
generic.In-scope period: Claims system incurred movement since the previous register refresh run.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each register row carries paid-to-date, outstanding and the refresh date applied.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Register total reconciles to the ceded outstanding balance in the reinsurance administration system.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Refreshed register retained in Microsoft Excel with its refresh date and version.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Movements that fail to load are logged with the loss reference and the correction applied.
generic.Test population: All notified losses on the loss advice register at the refresh date.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fails if the register does not show a refresh date inside the current reporting period.
generic.Exception handling path: Movements piercing a further layer are flagged for a supplementary advice to the market.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: A refresh is accepted when paid and outstanding are maintained separately per notified loss.
generic.Evidence location: Loss advice register held against the ceded portfolio in the reinsurance administration system.

steps.title: Extract incurred movement from the claims management platform
sop: Extract current paid and outstanding for every notified loss on the register.
Compare against the values captured at the previous refresh.
Retain only losses showing movement plus any newly notified losses.
Done when the movement extract is available for the refresh.
verify: Sample two moved losses and check against the claim screens.
Pass when the sampled movements match the claims platform values.

steps.title: Refresh the register in Microsoft Excel
sop: Load the movement extract into the loss advice register workbook.
Update paid-to-date and outstanding for each affected notified loss.
Stamp the register with the refresh date for the run.
Done when the register reflects the current incurred position.
verify: Compare a sample of register rows to the movement extract.
Pass when the sampled rows carry the extracted values.

steps.title: Maintain the paid and outstanding split per notified loss
sop: Keep paid-to-date and outstanding as separate columns on every row.
Do not net payments against outstanding on the register.
Derive incurred as the sum of the two components for reporting only.
Done when every register row shows a maintained paid and outstanding split.
verify: Check register rows for populated separate paid and outstanding values.
Pass when no row reports only a combined incurred figure.

steps.title: Flag movements that pierce a further treaty layer
sop: Compare the refreshed incurred against the layer attachment points on each treaty.
Flag losses whose movement pierces a layer not previously advised.
Route flagged losses to the supplementary advice queue.
Done when every layer-piercing movement is flagged for a supplementary advice.
verify: Re-test flagged losses against the layer attachment points.
Pass when every loss now above a new attachment point carries a flag.

steps.title: Post the refreshed figures to the reinsurance administration system
sop: Update the notified amounts on each ceded loss record from the register.
Record the refresh date on the ceded loss records updated.
Log any loss where the update fails with the correction applied.
Done when refreshed figures are posted to the ceded loss records.
verify: Compare posted amounts to the register for a sample of losses.
Pass when the sampled posted amounts match the register.

steps.title: Reconcile the register total to the ceded outstanding balance
sop: Total the outstanding column on the refreshed register.
Compare against the ceded outstanding balance in the reinsurance system.
Investigate and clear differences before closing the refresh run.
Done when the register total agrees to the ceded outstanding balance.
verify: Inspect the reconciliation for unexplained residual differences.
Pass when the register and ceded outstanding balance agree.

generic.Defined scope/population: Loss advices awaiting a compliance check against the notification threshold and reporting clauses.
generic.In-scope period: Advices prepared or amended since the previous compliance verification run.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Compliance confirmation records the clause reference and the threshold basis applied.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Advices verified plus advices rejected equal the advices submitted for verification.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Wording extract used for the check retained with the advice and its verification date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Advices failing the threshold test are logged with the reason and returned to drafting.
generic.Test population: All loss advices presented for verification in the run.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fails if a compliance confirmation is recorded without a clause reference quoted.
generic.Exception handling path: Ambiguous clause wording is referred to the specialist for a documented interpretation.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Verification is accepted when the clause is read from the executed wording, not the slip summary.
generic.Evidence location: Compliance confirmation recorded on the loss advice record with the clause reference.

steps.title: Retrieve the executed wording from the treaty repository
sop: Locate the executed treaty wording for the treaty and year on the advice.
Confirm the document is the executed version and not the slip summary.
Retain the notification clause extract with the advice for evidence.
Done when the executed wording is retrieved for every advice under check.
verify: Check the retrieved document type for each advice.
Pass when no check relies on a slip summary in place of executed wording.

steps.title: Read the notification clause and threshold basis
sop: Read the notification clause text from the executed wording.
Determine whether the threshold applies to incurred or paid amounts.
Determine whether it is expressed at 100 percent or on the ceded share.
Done when the threshold basis is established for each advice.
verify: Compare the recorded basis to the clause text.
Pass when the recorded basis matches the executed wording for each advice.

steps.title: Apply the threshold test to the advice amounts
sop: Take the amount on the advice on the basis the clause specifies.
Compare that amount against the notification threshold.
Record the test result as met or not met on the advice.
Done when every advice carries a threshold test result.
verify: Recompute the test on a sample of advices.
Pass when the recomputed results match the recorded results.

steps.title: Check special notice duties in the wording
sop: Check the wording for cash loss notice duties on the treaty.
Check for extra-contractual obligations and aggregate erosion notice duties.
Note any additional notice required beyond the standard advice.
Done when special notice duties are identified for each advice.
verify: Compare identified duties against the clause list in the wording.
Pass when no special notice clause in the wording is left unchecked.

steps.title: Cross-check the advice content against the claim file repository
sop: Compare the loss facts on the advice to the claim file documents.
Confirm the loss date and cause on the advice match the adjuster report.
Return advices with factual conflicts to drafting with the conflict noted.
Done when the advice content is confirmed against the claim file.
verify: Sample two advices against their claim file documents.
Pass when the sampled advices carry no unexplained factual conflict.

steps.title: Record the compliance confirmation on the advice record
sop: Record the compliance confirmation on the loss advice record.
Quote the governing clause reference alongside the confirmation.
Log failed advices with the reason and return them to drafting.
Done when every advice carries a confirmation or a logged failure.
verify: Query verified advices for a clause reference on the confirmation.
Pass when no confirmation is recorded without a quoted clause reference.

generic.Defined scope/population: All claims coded to the declared catastrophe event that qualify under the hours clause window.
generic.In-scope period: The event window elected under the hours clause for the catastrophe.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each layer row holds attachment, limit, event loss applied and the reinstatement position.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Event claim total at 100 percent agrees to the cat aggregation report for the event.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Aggregation workbook retained in Microsoft Excel with the extract date and version.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Claims excluded from the event total are logged with the exclusion reason recorded.
generic.Test population: All event-coded claims in the aggregation extract for the catastrophe.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fails if attachment and exhaustion are not computed for every pierced layer.
generic.Exception handling path: Claims with disputed event linkage are excluded pending a documented linkage decision.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: The aggregation is accepted when the loss occurrence deductible is applied before attachment.
generic.Evidence location: Layer attachment and exhaustion positions stored on the event record.

steps.title: Extract event claims from the claims management platform
sop: Extract all claims carrying the event code with gross incurred at 100 percent.
Include loss date and time so the hours clause can be applied.
Record the extract date on the workbook for traceability.
Done when the event claim extract is loaded for aggregation.
verify: Compare the extract count to the event-coded claim count.
Pass when the extract holds every event-coded claim.

steps.title: Apply the hours clause to form the qualifying event total
sop: Apply the elected hours clause window to the extracted loss dates.
Exclude losses falling outside the window from the event total.
Log each exclusion with its loss date and the reason.
Done when only qualifying losses form the event total.
verify: Re-test excluded losses against the window.
Pass when no qualifying loss has been excluded from the total.

steps.title: Sum gross incurred at 100 percent before retention
sop: Sum the qualifying claims on gross incurred at 100 percent.
Do not apply any retention or cession at this stage.
Record the gross event total with the extract date.
Done when the gross event total at 100 percent is computed.
verify: Recompute the sum from the qualifying claim rows.
Pass when the recomputed total matches the recorded gross event total.

steps.title: Apply the loss occurrence deductible from the treaty terms
sop: Read the loss occurrence deductible for the catastrophe programme.
Deduct it from the gross event total to give the ultimate net loss.
Record the deductible applied alongside the calculation.
Done when the ultimate net loss for the event is derived.
verify: Recompute the ultimate net loss from the gross total and deductible.
Pass when the recomputation agrees to the recorded figure.

steps.title: Test attachment and exhaustion layer by layer
sop: Compare the ultimate net loss to each layer attachment point in turn.
Mark each layer as not attached, attached or exhausted.
Compute the loss falling into each attached layer up to its limit.
Done when every layer carries an attachment and exhaustion conclusion.
verify: Recompute the layer positions from the ultimate net loss.
Pass when the recomputed positions match the recorded conclusions.

steps.title: Record the reinstatement position per pierced layer
sop: For each pierced layer read the reinstatement provisions in the treaty.
Record reinstatements used and reinstatements remaining for that layer.
Store the layer positions on the event record in the reinsurance system.
Done when the reinstatement position is recorded for every pierced layer.
verify: Check each pierced layer for a used and remaining reinstatement figure.
Pass when no pierced layer lacks a recorded reinstatement position.

generic.Defined scope/population: Catastrophe event layers confirmed as attached, with reinsurer signed shares for the treaty year.
generic.In-scope period: The event valuation date used for management reporting of the catastrophe.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each row holds layer, reinsurer, signed share, recovery amount and the valuation date.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Per-reinsurer recoveries sum to the layer recovery for every attached layer.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Recovery workbook retained in Microsoft Excel labelled preliminary with its valuation date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Layers excluded from the calculation are logged with the reason and the review owner.
generic.Test population: All attached layers on the catastrophe programme at the valuation date.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fails if any recovery exceeds the layer limit or ignores the attachment point.
generic.Exception handling path: Signed share gaps are referred back to the placement record before figures are issued.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: The calculation is accepted when reinstatement premium is shown as a separate line.
generic.Evidence location: Preliminary recovery calculation stored against the event in the reinsurance administration system.

steps.title: Load attached layer positions from the reinsurance administration system
sop: Pull the layer attachment and exhaustion positions computed for the event.
Take the ultimate net loss figure used in the attachment test.
Note the valuation date attached to those positions.
Done when the attached layer positions are loaded for the calculation.
verify: Compare the loaded positions to the stored event aggregation.
Pass when the loaded positions match the stored layer conclusions.

steps.title: Compute recovery per layer in Microsoft Excel
sop: Compute loss in excess of the attachment point for each attached layer.
Cap the computed recovery at the layer limit.
Show the uncapped and capped figures so the cap is visible.
Done when a recovery amount exists for every attached layer.
verify: Recompute one capped and one uncapped layer by hand.
Pass when both recomputations agree to the workbook.

steps.title: Apply reinsurer signed shares to the layer recoveries
sop: Read reinsurer signed shares for each layer from the treaty year placement.
Apply the shares to the layer recovery to give per-reinsurer amounts.
Check the shares on each layer sum to 100 percent.
Done when per-reinsurer recovery amounts are computed for every layer.
verify: Sum the per-reinsurer amounts back to each layer recovery.
Pass when the per-reinsurer amounts sum to the layer recovery.

steps.title: Compute reinstatement premium payable as a separate line
sop: Read the reinstatement premium terms for each pierced layer.
Compute the reinstatement premium payable on the recovery amount.
Present it as a separate line rather than netting it into the recovery.
Done when reinstatement premium is computed and shown separately.
verify: Check the workbook for a distinct reinstatement premium line.
Pass when no recovery figure has reinstatement premium embedded in it.

steps.title: Label the calculation preliminary with its valuation date
sop: Mark the recovery output as preliminary on every page and export.
State the valuation date the underlying claim data relates to.
Note that the figures will move as claims develop.
Done when the output is labelled preliminary with a valuation date.
verify: Inspect the exported output for the preliminary label and date.
Pass when both the label and the valuation date appear on the output.

steps.title: Store the calculation against the event record
sop: Store the recovery workbook against the event in the reinsurance system.
Record the layers and reinsurers covered by the calculation.
Log any layer excluded from the calculation with the reason.
Done when the preliminary calculation is stored against the event.
verify: Open the event record and locate the stored calculation.
Pass when the stored calculation covers every attached layer or logs the exclusion.

generic.Defined scope/population: The declared catastrophe event requiring an agreed definition with reinsurers and the placing brokers.
generic.In-scope period: The proposed event start and end datetime under the elected hours clause.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Event record holds start datetime, end datetime, elected hours window, peril and territory.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Reinsurers confirming the definition match the reinsurers on the treaty security list.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Broker written confirmation retained against the event record with its date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Reinsurers disputing the definition are logged with their position and the resolution route.
generic.Test population: All reinsurers on risk for the catastrophe programme in the affected treaty year.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fails if bordereaux are issued before the agreed definition is recorded on the event.
generic.Exception handling path: Disputed definitions are escalated through the broker for a market meeting.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: The definition is accepted when peril and territory match the loss occurrence clause.
generic.Evidence location: Agreed event definition and hours clause election recorded on the event record.

steps.title: Draft the proposed event definition from the treaty repository wording
sop: Read the loss occurrence definition in the executed treaty wording.
Draft the event start and end datetime with the elected hours window stated.
State the peril and territory scope to match the wording.
Done when a proposed event definition is drafted from the wording.
verify: Compare the drafted scope to the loss occurrence clause text.
Pass when the peril and territory in the draft match the clause.

steps.title: Test the elected window against the claim spread
sop: Plot the claim loss dates for the catastrophe against candidate windows.
Test both the 72 and 168 hour elections where the wording allows a choice.
Select the election giving the correct contractual outcome for the event.
Done when the hours clause election is selected and evidenced.
verify: Recompute the claim spread under the selected election.
Pass when the selected election captures the claims stated in the draft definition.

steps.title: Issue the proposed definition to the market by Microsoft Teams / Email
sop: Send the proposed definition to the broker and the lead reinsurer.
State the start and end datetime, the window elected, peril and territory.
Set a response date for market confirmation.
Done when the proposed definition has been issued to the market.
verify: Check the issued proposal against the treaty security list.
Pass when every reinsurer on risk received the proposal directly or via the broker.

steps.title: Obtain written broker confirmation of the agreed definition
sop: Chase the broker for written confirmation of the agreed event definition.
Confirm the broker response covers the full following market.
Log reinsurers disputing the definition with their stated position.
Done when written confirmation or a logged dispute exists for the market.
verify: Read the broker confirmation against the proposed definition.
Pass when the confirmation matches the proposed definition or a dispute is logged.

steps.title: Record the agreed definition on the event record
sop: Record the agreed start and end datetime on the event record.
Record the elected hours clause window alongside the dates.
Attach the broker confirmation to the event record.
Done when the agreed definition is recorded with its confirmation attached.
verify: Open the event record and inspect the recorded definition fields.
Pass when the recorded definition matches the broker confirmation.

steps.title: Apply the agreed definition to subsequent bordereaux
sop: Set the agreed definition as the basis for all event bordereaux production.
Re-run the event claim population against the agreed window.
Withhold bordereaux until the agreed definition is on the event record.
Done when bordereaux production uses the agreed event definition.
verify: Compare the bordereau population to the agreed event window.
Pass when no bordereau row falls outside the agreed definition.

generic.Defined scope/population: Claims in the catastrophe event portfolio subject to case reserve adequacy review with the claims department.
generic.In-scope period: The reserve review cycle for the event since the previous adequacy check.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each reviewed claim records the review outcome, the reviewing examiner and the review date.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Reviewed claim count plus deferred claims equals the event claim portfolio count.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Review outcome workbook retained in Microsoft Excel with the review cycle date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Claims where reserve strengthening is refused are logged with the examiner rationale.
generic.Test population: All event claims with reserves unchanged for 30 or more days plus large open claims.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fails if the ceded recovery is not re-run after agreed reserve movements post.
generic.Exception handling path: Unresolved adequacy disagreements are referred to the examiner supervisor for decision.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: The review is accepted when the outcome is recorded per claim segment and per adjuster.
generic.Evidence location: Reserve adequacy review outcomes filed against the event claim portfolio.

steps.title: List stale reserves from the claims management platform
sop: Extract event claims with case reserves unchanged for 30 or more days.
Include claim segment, adjuster and current reserve on each row.
Add all event claims above the large loss threshold regardless of age.
Done when the adequacy review list is produced for the cycle.
verify: Recompute reserve age on a sample of listed claims.
Pass when every claim with a 30 day or older reserve appears on the list.

steps.title: Circulate the review list to the Claims Examiner
sop: Send the review list to the handling examiners by claim segment.
State the review cycle deadline for responses.
Ask for an adequacy view against the latest adjuster estimate.
Done when the review list has been circulated with a response deadline.
verify: Match circulated segments to the examiners handling them.
Pass when every listed claim has been circulated to a named examiner.

steps.title: Review reserve adequacy against adjuster estimates
sop: Compare the booked case reserve to the latest adjuster estimate on each claim.
State whether the reserve is adequate, understated or overstated.
Recommend the revised reserve where a change is needed.
Done when an adequacy view exists for every claim on the review list.
verify: Check the review responses against the listed claims.
Pass when no listed claim is returned without an adequacy view.

steps.title: Record outcomes per segment and adjuster in Microsoft Excel
sop: Load the examiner responses into the adequacy review workbook.
Summarise outcomes by claim segment and by adjuster.
Highlight adjusters with a pattern of understated reserves.
Done when review outcomes are recorded per segment and per adjuster.
verify: Check the workbook for segment and adjuster level summaries.
Pass when outcomes are recorded at both segment and adjuster level.

steps.title: Agree and post reserve strengthening in the claims management platform
sop: Post the agreed reserve movements where adjuster estimates exceed booked reserves.
Record the rationale for each strengthening on the claim file.
Log refusals to strengthen with the examiner rationale.
Done when agreed reserve movements are posted or refusals logged.
verify: Compare posted movements to the agreed strengthening list.
Pass when every agreed strengthening is posted or logged as refused.

steps.title: Re-run the ceded recovery in the reinsurance administration system
sop: Wait until the agreed reserve movements have posted in the claims platform.
Re-run the ceded recovery calculation for the event on the new figures.
Record the recalculation date against the event record.
Done when the ceded recovery reflects the agreed reserve movements.
verify: Compare the recalculation date to the last posted reserve movement.
Pass when the recalculation was run after the final reserve movement posted.

generic.Defined scope/population: All reinsurers and brokers with open recovery actions on the declared catastrophe event.
generic.In-scope period: The recovery coordination cycle running from event declaration to full collection.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Every action log line holds reinsurer, action, named owner and a due date.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Reinsurers on the action log match the reinsurers on the event treaty security.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Weekly recovery call minutes filed against the event record with the call date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Actions missed at their due date are logged with the reason and a revised date.
generic.Test population: All open recovery actions on the event action log.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fails if any open action lacks a named owner or a due date.
generic.Exception handling path: Blocked recoveries are routed to the broker allocated to that reinsurer.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Coordination is accepted when the cash call or periodic billing route is recorded per treaty.
generic.Evidence location: Recovery action log held against the event in the reinsurance administration system.

steps.title: Open the recovery action log on the event record
sop: Create a single recovery action log against the event record.
List every reinsurer on risk for the affected treaties.
Set the log as the only tracking record for event recovery actions.
Done when the recovery action log is open for the event.
verify: Compare the log reinsurer list to the treaty security.
Pass when every reinsurer on risk appears on the log.

steps.title: Assign owners and due dates to each recovery action
sop: Break the recovery into actions per reinsurer such as billing, query and chase.
Assign a named owner to each action.
Set a due date consistent with the contractual settlement period.
Done when every action carries a named owner and a due date.
verify: Scan the log for blank owner or due date fields.
Pass when no open action lacks an owner or a due date.

steps.title: Allocate intermediated reinsurers to the broker
sop: Identify reinsurers where collection runs through the placing broker.
Allocate those reinsurers to the broker on the action log.
Notify the broker of the allocated reinsurers by Microsoft Teams / Email.
Done when every intermediated reinsurer is allocated to a broker.
verify: Compare allocations to the placement route on each treaty.
Pass when every intermediated reinsurer is allocated to its broker.

steps.title: Decide the cash call or periodic billing route per treaty
sop: Check each treaty for a cash loss clause supporting a cash call.
Decide cash call or periodic billing as the collection route for that treaty.
Record the route decision on the action log.
Done when every treaty on the event carries a recorded collection route.
verify: Compare the recorded routes to the cash loss clause availability.
