Pass when no cash call route is recorded for a treaty without a cash loss clause.

steps.title: Run the weekly recovery call and issue minutes
sop: Hold the weekly recovery call using the action log as the agenda.
Update action status and revised due dates during the call.
File the minutes against the event record with the call date.
Done when the weekly call is held and minutes are filed.
verify: Check the event record for minutes covering each week of the cycle.
Pass when no week in the cycle is missing filed minutes.

steps.title: Track submissions and responses through the Reinsurer Exchange
sop: Check the Reinsurer Exchange for responses against submitted recovery items.
Update the action log with responses and outstanding items.
Escalate items past their due date to the allocated broker.
Done when exchange responses are reflected on the action log.
verify: Compare exchange responses to the action log status.
Pass when every exchange response is reflected against its action.

generic.Defined scope/population: All claims with a loss date inside the declared catastrophe event window in the claims management platform.
generic.In-scope period: The event window as fixed by the agreed event definition and hours clause.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Claim header carries the catastrophe flag, the event code and a consistent peril and territory.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Linked claim count and gross incurred reconcile to the event aggregation report.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Screening run output retained with its date and the event definition version applied.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: De-linked claims are logged with the recorded reason for removal from the event.
generic.Test population: All claims screened for event linkage in the run.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fails if an event-linked claim carries a peril or territory outside the event definition.
generic.Exception handling path: Borderline linkage decisions are referred to the handling examiner before the flag is set.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Linkage is accepted when the flag sits on the claim header rather than only in file notes.
generic.Evidence location: Catastrophe flag and event code on the claim header in Guidewire ClaimCenter.

steps.title: Screen claims with loss dates inside the event window
sop: Extract all claims with a loss date inside the agreed event window.
Include peril, territory and policy reference on each row.
Retain claims already linked so the full population is visible.
Done when the screening population is produced for the event.
verify: Compare the population to the event window date range.
Pass when every claim with a loss date in the window is on the list.

steps.title: Assess event linkage on each screened claim
sop: Review each screened claim against the agreed peril and territory scope.
Decide whether the claim arises from the declared catastrophe.
Record the linkage decision and the reason for borderline cases.
Done when a linkage decision exists for every screened claim.
verify: Check the screening list for a decision on each row.
Pass when no screened claim is left without a linkage decision.

steps.title: Set the catastrophe flag and event code in Guidewire ClaimCenter
sop: Open the claim header in Guidewire ClaimCenter for each linked claim.
Set the catastrophe flag and the event code on the header.
Do not record the linkage only in file notes.
Done when every linked claim carries header level event coding.
verify: Query linked claims for a populated header event code.
Pass when no linked claim relies on file notes alone.

steps.title: De-link claims outside the covered territory or peril
sop: Identify coded claims whose peril or territory falls outside the event definition.
Remove the event code and catastrophe flag from those claims.
Record the de-linking reason on the claim file.
Done when every out-of-scope claim is de-linked with a reason.
verify: Re-query event-linked claims for peril and territory consistency.
Pass when no linked claim sits outside the event peril and territory.

steps.title: Refresh the event aggregation in the reinsurance administration system
sop: Re-run the event aggregation extract after linkage changes post.
Capture linked claim count and gross incurred from the refreshed extract.
Store the extract against the event record with its run date.
Done when a refreshed aggregation extract exists for the event.
verify: Compare the extract run date to the last linkage change.
Pass when the extract was run after the final linkage change.

steps.title: Reconcile linked claims to the event aggregation report
sop: Compare linked claim count in the claims platform to the aggregation report.
Compare gross incurred on the linked population to the aggregation total.
Investigate and clear differences before closing the linkage run.
Done when the linked population reconciles to the aggregation report.
verify: Inspect the reconciliation for unexplained differences.
Pass when count and gross incurred agree with no unexplained variance.

generic.Defined scope/population: All reinsurer and broker queries raised on catastrophe event claims data and coverage determination.
generic.In-scope period: Queries received since the previous query log review for the event.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Query log holds reinsurer, date received, question text and target response date.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Queries received equal queries answered plus queries open within the service window.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Response correspondence retained against the query entry with its send date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Queries that cannot be answered are logged with the blocking reason and escalation route.
generic.Test population: All reinsurer queries logged against the catastrophe event.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fails if a logged query has no response date recorded after the agreed service window.
generic.Exception handling path: Coverage determination questions are routed to the handling examiner before any reply.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: A response is accepted when it is issued in the service window and copied to the broker.
generic.Evidence location: Reinsurer query log held against the event in the reinsurance administration system.

steps.title: Log inbound reinsurer queries on the event query log
sop: Capture every query received by Microsoft Teams / Email against the event.
Record reinsurer, date received and the question text verbatim.
Set a target response date from the agreed service window.
Done when every inbound query is logged with a target response date.
verify: Compare logged queries to the query inbox for the period.
Pass when no received query is missing from the log.

steps.title: Classify queries as data or coverage determination
sop: Review each logged query and classify it as data or coverage determination.
Mark coverage questions for examiner routing before any reply.
Mark data questions for direct response from the event aggregation.
Done when every logged query carries a classification.
verify: Check the log for a classification on each open query.
Pass when no open query is left unclassified.

steps.title: Route coverage questions to the Claims Examiner
sop: Review coverage determination questions against the claim file position.
Provide the coverage answer in writing with the basis stated.
Flag any question that must not be answered without counsel input.
Done when a written examiner position exists for every coverage question.
verify: Match coverage queries to examiner responses.
Pass when no coverage query was answered without an examiner position.

steps.title: Assemble supporting data from the claim file repository
sop: Retrieve the claim documents needed to support each data response.
Check each document against the access-to-records clause before release.
Record which documents are being released to which reinsurer.
Done when supporting documents are assembled and release-checked.
verify: Compare released documents to the access-to-records clause scope.
Pass when no document outside the clause scope is prepared for release.

steps.title: Issue responses inside the agreed service window
sop: Send the response to the reinsurer by Microsoft Teams / Email.
Copy the placing broker on every response issued.
Attach only the release-checked supporting documents.
Done when a response is issued for every query due in the window.
verify: Compare response dates to target response dates on the log.
Pass when no query was answered after its target response date.

steps.title: Close the query log entries and track document release
sop: Record the response date against each answered query on the log.
Record the documents released against the access-to-records clause.
Log unanswerable queries with the blocking reason and escalation route.
Done when every query is closed or carries a logged exception.
verify: Re-read the query log for open items past the service window.
Pass when every past-window item carries a response date or a logged exception.

generic.Defined scope/population: Aggregate incurred for the declared catastrophe event across all event-linked claims.
generic.In-scope period: Each month end from event declaration until the event is closed.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Development record holds paid, case outstanding and IBNR-equivalent at each extract date.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Event incurred in the extract agrees to the event aggregation report for the same date.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Monthly development extract retained in Microsoft Excel with its extract date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Unexplained movements above tolerance are logged with the investigation outcome.
generic.Test population: All event-linked claims in the month end aggregation extract.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fails if the event has no aggregate development extract for the current period.
generic.Exception handling path: Movements beyond tolerance are referred to the specialist for commentary before publication.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Development is accepted when paid, outstanding and IBNR-equivalent are shown separately.
generic.Evidence location: Event development history stored on the event record and the BI reporting platform.

steps.title: Re-extract event incurred at month end
sop: Re-run the event claim extract from the reinsurance administration system.
Take the extract at the agreed month end cut-off date.
Record the extract date on the development workbook.
Done when the month end event extract is captured.
verify: Compare the extract date to the month end cut-off.
Pass when the extract was taken at the agreed cut-off date.

steps.title: Split development into paid, outstanding and IBNR-equivalent
sop: Split the event incurred into paid, case outstanding and IBNR-equivalent.
Keep each component as its own column in the development workbook.
Do not present only a combined incurred movement.
Done when the three components are shown separately for the period.
verify: Sum the three components back to event incurred.
Pass when the components sum to the reported event incurred.

steps.title: Compare against the prior period in Microsoft Excel
sop: Load the prior period extract alongside the current extract.
Calculate the movement for each component and in total.
Highlight movements exceeding the agreed tolerance.
Done when period on period movement is calculated for the event.
verify: Recalculate the total movement from the two extracts.
Pass when the recalculated movement matches the workbook.

steps.title: Flag layers approaching attachment or exhaustion
sop: Compare the developed event loss to each layer attachment and limit.
Flag layers now within the alert margin of attachment or exhaustion.
Note layers newly pierced since the previous period.
Done when layer proximity flags are set from the current development.
verify: Re-test flagged layers against the developed event loss.
Pass when every layer within the alert margin carries a flag.

steps.title: Add commentary on movements beyond tolerance
sop: Investigate each movement flagged as beyond the agreed tolerance.
Write commentary naming the driver such as reserve strengthening or new claims.
Attach the commentary to the development record for the period.
Done when every out-of-tolerance movement carries commentary.
verify: Check flagged movements for attached commentary.
Pass when no out-of-tolerance movement is left without commentary.

steps.title: Publish the development history to the BI reporting platform
sop: Load the period development and commentary to the BI reporting platform.
Append the period to the event development history series.
Store the workbook against the event record with its extract date.
Done when the period development is published and stored.
verify: Open the published series and check the current period appears.
Pass when the current period development is visible on the BI platform.

generic.Defined scope/population: Modelled catastrophe event loss compared against reported event loss on the same event definition.
generic.In-scope period: The reporting date at which reported losses are compared to the modelled estimate.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Reconciliation holds modelled loss, reported loss, variance and the driver attribution.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Reported event total in the reconciliation agrees to the event aggregation report.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Reconciliation workbook retained in Microsoft Excel with the model run reference and date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Unexplained variance is logged with the follow-up owner and the review date.
generic.Test population: All lines of business contributing to the modelled and reported event totals.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fails if the reconciliation carries no variance commentary at the reporting date.
generic.Exception handling path: Model and reported scope mismatches are corrected before variance is attributed.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: The reconciliation is accepted when variance is split into exposure, vulnerability and lag drivers.
generic.Evidence location: Modelled versus reported reconciliation filed to the cat modelling and recovery planning file.

steps.title: Pull the modelled event loss from Moody's RMS
sop: Run or retrieve the modelled loss for the event in Moody's RMS.
Apply the same event definition, peril and territory used for reporting.
Record the model version and run reference.
Done when the modelled event loss is retrieved on the reporting basis.
verify: Compare the model run scope to the agreed event definition.
Pass when the model scope matches the event definition used for reporting.

steps.title: Pull the reported event loss from the reinsurance administration system
sop: Extract the reported event total from the event aggregation report.
Split the reported total by line of business.
Record the reporting date the figures relate to.
Done when the reported event total is captured by line of business.
verify: Compare the extracted total to the event aggregation report.
Pass when the extracted total agrees to the aggregation report.

steps.title: Align the two populations in Microsoft Excel
sop: Map modelled line of business categories to the reported categories.
Remove any scope mismatch such as excluded perils before comparing.
Document the mapping applied in the reconciliation workbook.
Done when modelled and reported totals sit on a comparable basis.
verify: Review the mapping for unmatched categories.
Pass when every modelled and reported category is mapped or explicitly excluded.

steps.title: Decompose the variance into drivers
sop: Calculate the total variance between modelled and reported loss.
Attribute the variance to exposure, vulnerability and claims reporting lag.
Quantify each driver rather than describing it only in words.
Done when the variance is decomposed into quantified drivers.
verify: Sum the quantified drivers against the total variance.
Pass when the drivers sum to the total variance.

steps.title: Track the reported to modelled ratio by line of business
sop: Compute the reported to modelled ratio for each line of business.
Compare the ratio against the previous reporting date for the event.
Highlight lines where the ratio is moving fastest.
Done when the ratio is computed and trended per line of business.
verify: Recompute two ratios from the aligned totals.
Pass when the recomputed ratios agree to the workbook.

steps.title: File the variance explanation to the recovery planning file
sop: Write the variance explanation covering each quantified driver.
Share it with the cat modelling and recovery planning file.
Log any residual unexplained variance with an owner and review date.
Done when the variance explanation is filed for the event.
verify: Open the recovery planning file and locate the explanation.
Pass when the filed explanation covers every quantified driver.

generic.Defined scope/population: The catastrophe event recovery position covering expected recoveries, cash collected and outstanding billings.
generic.In-scope period: The event reporting cycle agreed with the CFO and CRO for the catastrophe.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Report holds gross event loss, net retention, expected recoveries and cash collected to date.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Cash collected in the report agrees to receipts posted in the reinsurance administration system.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Issued report retained on the BI reporting platform with its cycle date and version.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Figures excluded from the report are logged with the exclusion reason and owner.
generic.Test population: All treaties and reinsurers exposed to the catastrophe event.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fails if the report is not issued to the CFO and CRO on the agreed cadence.
generic.Exception handling path: Late data from collection is flagged in the report rather than delaying issue.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: The report is accepted when reinstatement premium obligations are disclosed alongside recoveries.
generic.Evidence location: Published cat event recovery status report on the BI reporting platform.

steps.title: Extract the event recovery position from the reinsurance administration system
sop: Extract gross event loss, retention and expected recoveries for the event.
Include cash collected to date by reinsurer.
Record the extract date for the reporting cycle.
Done when the event recovery position is extracted for the cycle.
verify: Compare extracted recoveries to the stored recovery calculation.
Pass when the extract agrees to the stored recovery calculation.

steps.title: Age outstanding billings by reinsurer in Microsoft Excel
sop: Load open billings for the event into the reporting workbook.
Age each balance from the contractual due date.
Rank reinsurers by outstanding value and name the largest five.
Done when outstanding billings are aged and ranked by reinsurer.
verify: Recompute the ageing on a sample of billings.
Pass when the sampled ageing buckets agree to the workbook.

steps.title: Add reinstatement premium obligations to the position
sop: Pull reinstatement premium payable for each pierced layer on the event.
Show the obligation alongside the recovery position, not netted into it.
Note the due dates for reinstatement premium payments.
Done when reinstatement premium obligations are disclosed in the report.
verify: Check the report for a distinct reinstatement premium disclosure.
Pass when reinstatement obligations appear separately from recoveries.

steps.title: Reconcile cash collected to posted receipts
sop: Compare cash collected in the report to receipts posted for the event.
Investigate and clear differences before the report is published.
Record the reconciliation alongside the report data.
Done when reported cash collected agrees to posted receipts.
verify: Inspect the reconciliation for unexplained differences.
Pass when reported cash collected equals posted receipts.

steps.title: Publish the report on the BI reporting platform
sop: Load the recovery position, ageing and reinstatement disclosure to the BI platform.
Version the report with the event and the reporting cycle date.
Note any late data as a flagged item rather than delaying issue.
Done when the report is published for the reporting cycle.
verify: Open the published report and check all four sections are present.
Pass when the published report holds position, ageing, reinstatement and flags.

steps.title: Issue the report to the CFO and CRO
sop: Issue the published report to the CFO and CRO on the agreed cadence.
Record the issue date and recipients against the event record.
Log queries raised in response with an owner and due date.
Done when the report is issued and the issue is recorded.
verify: Compare the issue date to the agreed reporting cadence.
Pass when the report was issued on or before the cadence date.

generic.Defined scope/population: Claim-level event loss data for the catastrophe due for bordereau submission to reinsurers.
generic.In-scope period: The bordereau reporting period agreed for the catastrophe event.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each row holds policy reference, loss date, gross paid, gross outstanding and ceded share.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Bordereau control totals agree to the event aggregation report before release.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Submitted bordereau retained against the event record with its submission date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Rows rejected by the reinsurer are logged with the rejection reason and the resubmission.
generic.Test population: All event claims included in the bordereau for the reporting period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fails if a bordereau is released before its control totals agree to the aggregation report.
generic.Exception handling path: Template mismatches are corrected with the reinsurer before resubmission.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: A submission is accepted when receipt confirmation is logged against the event record.
generic.Evidence location: Submitted bordereau and receipt confirmation stored on the event record.

steps.title: Confirm the bordereau template agreed with the reinsurer
sop: Retrieve the market-standard template agreed for this reinsurer and treaty.
Confirm the column set and formats required by the reinsurer.
Note any reinsurer-specific variations to apply.
Done when the correct template version is confirmed for the submission.
verify: Compare the template in use to the agreed reinsurer specification.
Pass when the template matches the agreed specification.

steps.title: Extract claim-level event data from the reinsurance administration system
sop: Extract event claims with policy reference, loss date and amounts.
Include gross paid, gross outstanding and the ceded share per row.
Restrict to the agreed bordereau reporting period.
Done when the claim-level extract is available for the bordereau.
verify: Check the extract for blanks in the mandatory columns.
Pass when no row is missing a mandatory field.

steps.title: Populate the bordereau in Microsoft Excel
sop: Map the extract columns into the agreed bordereau template.
Format dates and amounts as the template requires.
Do not add or remove columns from the agreed template.
Done when the bordereau is populated in the agreed template.
verify: Compare the populated file structure to the template.
Pass when the structure matches the agreed template exactly.

steps.title: Agree control totals to the event aggregation report
sop: Total gross paid and gross outstanding on the bordereau.
Compare the totals to the event aggregation report for the same period.
Clear any difference before the bordereau is released.
Done when bordereau control totals agree to the aggregation report.
verify: Inspect the control total comparison for residual differences.
Pass when the bordereau totals equal the aggregation report totals.

steps.title: Submit the bordereau through the Reinsurer Exchange
sop: Upload the bordereau to the Reinsurer Exchange for each reinsurer on risk.
Attach the supporting event summary where the reinsurer requires it.
Capture the exchange submission reference for each upload.
Done when the bordereau is submitted to every reinsurer on risk.
verify: Compare submissions to the reinsurers on the event security list.
Pass when every reinsurer on risk has a submission reference.

steps.title: Log submission and receipt confirmation on the event record
sop: Store the submitted bordereau against the event record.
Record the submission date and the reinsurer receipt confirmation.
Log rejected rows with the reason and the resubmission action.
Done when submission and receipt confirmation are logged for the event.
verify: Open the event record and check for stored bordereau and confirmation.
Pass when both the bordereau and a receipt confirmation are stored.

generic.Defined scope/population: Ceded recovery estimates on treaties where underlying claim incurred has moved since the last valuation.
generic.In-scope period: The valuation period since the previous recovery estimate run.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each estimate holds valuation date, treaty, layer, recovery amount and the movement explanation.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Updated estimates sum to the ceded recoverable balance flagged for ledger recognition.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Recovery workbook retained in Microsoft Excel with its valuation date and version.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Estimates that cannot be recomputed are logged with the blocking data item and owner.
generic.Test population: All ceded recovery estimates affected by claim movement in the period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fails if an estimate carries a valuation date outside the current period.
generic.Exception handling path: Estimates rolled forward without recomputation are rejected and returned for rework.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: An update is accepted when it is computed from current claim incurred, not rolled forward.
generic.Evidence location: Updated ceded recovery estimates posted to the ceded balance in the reinsurance administration system.

steps.title: Identify treaties with claim movement in the period
sop: Extract claim incurred movement since the previous recovery valuation.
Map moved claims to their governing treaties and layers.
List the treaties requiring a recovery estimate update.
Done when the treaties needing recomputation are identified.
verify: Compare the treaty list to the claims showing movement.
Pass when every moved claim maps to a treaty on the list.

steps.title: Recompute recovery from current claim incurred in Microsoft Excel
sop: Recompute each recovery from current claim incurred values.
Do not roll forward the prior estimate as a starting point.
Record the valuation date on each recomputed estimate.
Done when every affected estimate is recomputed from current data.
verify: Trace two recomputed estimates back to current claim incurred.
Pass when both estimates derive from current incurred rather than the prior estimate.

steps.title: Re-test layer attachment and exhaustion after the movement
sop: Re-apply the loss occurrence deductible to the moved loss totals.
Re-test attachment and exhaustion for each affected layer.
Record layers newly attached or newly exhausted.
Done when layer positions are re-tested for every affected treaty.
verify: Recompute the layer position on a sample of treaties.
Pass when the sampled positions agree to the recorded conclusions.

steps.title: Explain the change versus prior period per treaty and layer
sop: Compare the recomputed estimate to the prior period estimate.
Write the movement explanation per treaty and per layer.
Name the driver such as reserve strengthening or new claims.
Done when every changed estimate carries a movement explanation.
verify: Check changed estimates for an attached explanation.
Pass when no changed estimate is left unexplained.

steps.title: Post the updated estimate to the ceded balance
sop: Post the recomputed estimates to the ceded balance in the reinsurance system.
Stamp each posting with the valuation date used.
Log estimates that could not be posted with the blocking item.
Done when updated estimates are posted to the ceded balance.
verify: Compare posted amounts to the workbook estimates.
Pass when the posted amounts equal the recomputed estimates.

steps.title: Flag the updated estimates for ledger recognition
sop: Flag the posted estimates for recognition in the ledger period.
Confirm the total flagged agrees to the ceded recoverable movement.
Hand the flagged population to the recoverable booking authorisation step.
Done when the updated estimates are flagged for ledger recognition.
verify: Compare the flagged total to the ceded recoverable movement.
Pass when the flagged total equals the ceded recoverable movement.

generic.Defined scope/population: Recovery receipts received from reinsurers awaiting application against outstanding billing statements.
generic.In-scope period: Receipts received since the previous cash application run.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each application holds statement number, treaty, loss or claim reference and the amount applied.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Cash applied plus residual balances equals the total receipts in the run.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Remittance advice retained against the applied billing with the application date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Short payments are left open as a residual balance with a reason code recorded.
generic.Test population: All recovery receipts received in the application period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fails if a received recovery sits unapplied beyond the clearing deadline.
generic.Exception handling path: Unidentified receipts are held with an owner and cleared before the deadline.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: An application is accepted when cash is applied at loss or claim level, not reinsurer summary level.
generic.Evidence location: Cash application records against billing statements in the reinsurance administration system.

steps.title: List unapplied recovery receipts in the ceded accounting platform
sop: Extract receipts recorded with no billing application against them.
Include receipt date, currency, amount and the remitting reinsurer.
Age each receipt against the clearing deadline.
Done when the unapplied receipt worklist is produced.
verify: Compare the worklist to receipts with no application recorded.
Pass when every unapplied receipt appears on the worklist.

steps.title: Match the remittance advice to the billing statement
sop: Read the remittance advice supplied with each receipt.
Match the advice to the billing statement number and the governing treaty.
Flag receipts with no usable remittance advice for chasing.
Done when each receipt is matched to a statement or flagged.
verify: Compare matched statement numbers to the open billing list.
Pass when each matched statement exists on the open billing list.

steps.title: Apply cash at loss or claim level in the reinsurance administration system
sop: Apply the receipt against the specific loss or claim lines on the statement.
Do not hold cash at reinsurer summary level.
Record the application date against each line applied.
Done when cash is applied at loss or claim level for each receipt.
verify: Inspect applied receipts for line level allocation.
Pass when no receipt remains applied only at reinsurer summary level.

steps.title: Record short payments as residual balances with reason codes
sop: Identify statements where the receipt is less than the billed amount.
Leave the shortfall open as a residual balance on the statement.
Record a reason code such as query, dispute or FX difference.
Done when every short payment carries an open residual with a reason code.
verify: Query residual balances for a populated reason code.
Pass when no residual balance is left without a reason code.

steps.title: Close fully settled billings so they drop out of the ageing
sop: Identify billing statements now fully settled by the applied cash.
Close those statements in the reinsurance administration system.
Confirm they no longer appear in the recoverable ageing.
Done when all fully settled billings are closed.
verify: Re-run the recoverable ageing after closure.
Pass when no fully settled billing still appears in the ageing.

steps.title: Reconcile applied cash to the ERP general ledger receipts
sop: Compare cash applied in the run to receipts posted in the ERP general ledger.
Investigate differences between applied and posted amounts.
Clear unidentified receipts before the clearing deadline.
Done when applied cash reconciles to the ledger receipts for the run.
verify: Inspect the reconciliation for open unidentified receipts.
Pass when no receipt remains unapplied past the clearing deadline.

generic.Defined scope/population: Ceded recoverable bookings prepared for recognition in the general ledger and awaiting authorisation.
generic.In-scope period: Bookings prepared for the current ledger period close.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each booking holds treaty, amount, calculation reference and the collectability adjustment applied.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Authorised booking total equals the recoverable movement released to the ledger interface.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Authorisation record retained with the approver name, date and the booking amount.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Bookings rejected at review are logged with the rejection reason and the rework owner.
generic.Test population: All recoverable bookings submitted for authorisation in the period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fails if any recoverable posts to the ledger without a recorded approver.
generic.Exception handling path: Bookings above the delegated authority limit are escalated for higher level approval.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Authorisation is accepted when it sits within the delegated authority for the booking amount.
generic.Evidence location: Authorisation records held against each booking in the reinsurance administration system.

steps.title: Assemble the booking pack in the reinsurance administration system
sop: List recoverable bookings prepared for the current ledger period.
Attach the underlying recovery calculation to each booking.
Include the treaty reference and valuation date on each line.
Done when the booking pack is assembled for authorisation.
verify: Check each booking for an attached calculation.
Pass when no booking is submitted without its calculation.

steps.title: Review the calculation against the treaty terms
sop: Check the recovery calculation applies the correct retention and layer limits.
Confirm the treaty year and cession percentage used are correct.
Return calculations with errors to the preparer before authorisation.
Done when each calculation is reviewed against the treaty terms.
verify: Re-test one calculation against the treaty terms.
Pass when the retested calculation agrees to the treaty terms.

steps.title: Confirm the collectability adjustment is applied
sop: Check each booking for the counterparty default and collectability adjustment.
Confirm the adjustment uses the current counterparty rating.
Flag bookings with no adjustment where one is required.
Done when the collectability adjustment is confirmed on every booking.
verify: Query bookings for a populated collectability adjustment.
Pass when no booking requiring an adjustment lacks one.

steps.title: Check the booking amount against the delegated authority
sop: Compare each booking amount to the delegated authority limit.
Approve bookings within the limit personally.
Escalate bookings above the limit to the next authority level.
Done when every booking is routed to the correct approval level.
verify: Compare approvals to the delegated authority schedule.
Pass when no booking is approved above the approver limit.

steps.title: Record the authorisation against the booking
sop: Record the approval against the booking with approver name and date.
State the amount approved on the authorisation record.
Log rejected bookings with the reason and the rework owner.
Done when every booking carries an authorisation or a logged rejection.
verify: Query bookings for a recorded approver.
Pass when no booking is left without an approver or a logged rejection.

steps.title: Release the authorised booking to the ERP general ledger interface
sop: Release only authorised bookings to the general ledger interface.
Attach the calculation reference to the released journal.
Reconcile the released total to the authorised booking total.
Done when authorised bookings are released to the ledger.
verify: Compare released journals to the authorised booking list.
Pass when no released journal lacks a matching authorisation.

generic.Defined scope/population: Paid and outstanding losses on ceded claims requiring a recoverable calculation under their governing treaties.
generic.In-scope period: Losses with paid or outstanding movement in the current calculation period.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Calculation holds treaty year, cession basis, deductible, limit and the paid outstanding split.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Sum of calculated recoverables agrees to the ceded recoverable movement for the period.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Calculation workbook retained in Microsoft Excel with its run date and treaty references.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Losses that cannot be calculated are logged with the missing term and an owner.
generic.Test population: All ceded losses in scope for recoverable calculation in the period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fails if a calculation is stored without the treaty terms and workings referenced.
generic.Exception handling path: Ambiguous ALAE treatment is referred to the specialist for a documented treaty reading.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: A calculation is accepted when paid and outstanding components are shown separately.
generic.Evidence location: Ceded recoverable calculations stored against the loss records in the reinsurance administration system.

steps.title: Extract paid and outstanding losses from the claims management platform
sop: Extract paid to date and outstanding for each ceded loss in scope.
Include allocated loss adjustment expense as a separate amount.
Record the extract date for the calculation run.
Done when the loss data extract is available for calculation.
verify: Sample two losses against the claim screens.
Pass when the sampled paid and outstanding values match the claims platform.

steps.title: Compute quota share cessions on the ceded percentage
sop: Identify losses attaching to quota share treaties.
Apply the ceded percentage for the correct treaty year.
Record the treaty year used on each calculation line.
Done when quota share cessions are computed for all applicable losses.
verify: Recompute one cession from the treaty percentage.
Pass when the recomputation agrees to the calculation line.

steps.title: Compute excess of loss recoveries net of the deductible
sop: Identify losses attaching to excess of loss layers.
Deduct the loss occurrence deductible before computing the recovery.
Cap the recovery at the layer limit for each pierced layer.
Done when excess of loss recoveries are computed with deductible and cap applied.
verify: Recompute one layered recovery by hand.
Pass when the recomputed recovery matches the calculation.

steps.title: Apply the treaty treatment for allocated loss adjustment expense
sop: Read the treaty treatment of allocated loss adjustment expense.
Apply ALAE pro-rata or in addition to limit as the treaty requires.
Record the ALAE treatment applied on the calculation.
Done when ALAE is treated per the governing treaty on every calculation.
verify: Compare the applied ALAE treatment to the treaty text.
Pass when the applied treatment matches the treaty for each calculation.

steps.title: Split the recoverable between paid and outstanding
sop: Split each computed recoverable between paid and outstanding components.
Keep the two components as separate lines on the calculation.
Total the components back to the recoverable amount.
Done when every recoverable shows a paid and outstanding split.
verify: Sum the components back to the recoverable on a sample.
Pass when the components sum to the recoverable amount.

steps.title: Store the calculation with treaty terms referenced
sop: Store the calculation against the loss record in the reinsurance system.
Reference the treaty terms and the workings used on the stored calculation.
Log losses that could not be calculated with the missing term.
Done when every calculation is stored with treaty terms referenced.
verify: Open stored calculations and check for treaty term references.
Pass when no stored calculation lacks a treaty term reference.

generic.Defined scope/population: Cash calls issued to reinsurers that remain unpaid past the contractual settlement days.
generic.In-scope period: The chase cycle covering all cash calls overdue at the extract date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each chase records the call reference, amount outstanding, contact and any promised payment date.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Overdue calls on the register equal the calls chased plus calls with logged exceptions.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Chase correspondence retained against the cash call record with its send date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Reinsurers disputing a call are logged with their position and the referral made.
generic.Test population: All overdue cash calls on the cash call register at the extract date.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fails if an overdue cash call has no chase activity recorded against it.
generic.Exception handling path: Disputed calls are moved out of chasing and into the dispute logging route.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: A chase is accepted when it quotes the cash loss clause, call date and amount outstanding.
generic.Evidence location: Chase history recorded against each cash call in the reinsurance administration system.

steps.title: Extract overdue cash calls from the cash call register
sop: Run the cash call register filtered on calls past the contractual settlement days.
Include original call date, amount outstanding and reinsurer contact.
Sort by days overdue so the oldest calls chase first.
Done when the overdue cash call list is produced for the cycle.
verify: Recompute days overdue on a sample of calls.
Pass when every call past the settlement period appears on the list.

steps.title: Confirm the amount outstanding against the ledger
sop: Compare the outstanding call amount to cash received in the ledger.
Deduct any part payment already applied against the call.
Correct the register where the outstanding figure is stale.
Done when the outstanding amount on each overdue call is confirmed.
verify: Recompare a sample of confirmed amounts to applied cash.
Pass when the sampled outstanding amounts reflect applied cash.

steps.title: Issue chases quoting the cash loss clause
sop: Send the chase to the reinsurer contact holding the cash call.
Quote the cash loss clause, the original call date and the amount outstanding.
Request a payment date in the response.
Done when a chase is issued for every overdue cash call.
verify: Read a sample of chases for the three required references.
Pass when every sampled chase quotes clause, call date and amount.

steps.title: Chase the broker in parallel on intermediated calls
sop: Identify overdue calls submitted through a placing broker.
Send a parallel chase to the broker claims contact.
Attach the original cash call and the reinsurer chase.
Done when every intermediated overdue call has a broker chase.
verify: Compare broker chases to the intermediated overdue calls.
Pass when no intermediated overdue call lacks a broker chase.

steps.title: Capture promised payment dates on the cash call record
sop: Record any promised payment date given by the reinsurer or broker.
Set a diary review on the promised date.
Log disputes raised instead of a promised date with the stated position.
Done when every response is captured against the cash call record.
verify: Query open overdue calls for a response or a logged dispute.
Pass when every chased call carries a response or a logged dispute.

steps.title: Track the chase cycle in Microsoft Excel
sop: Maintain the chase workbook with chase dates and promised payment dates.
Escalate calls that miss a promised payment date to the next chase level.
Reconcile the workbook back to the overdue population on the register.
Done when the chase workbook reflects the current overdue population.
verify: Compare the workbook to the register overdue population.
Pass when the workbook and register overdue populations agree.

generic.Defined scope/population: Treaty layers exposed to losses where attachment and exhaustion must be established before recovery.
generic.In-scope period: Losses valued at the current recovery calculation date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each layer row holds attachment point, limit, UNL applied and the reinstatements remaining.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Loss allocated across layers sums to the ultimate net loss above the retention.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Recovery workbook retained in Microsoft Excel with the treaty references and run date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Layers with unclear inuring order are logged with the interpretation applied and its source.
generic.Test population: All layers on treaties exposed to the losses under calculation.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fails if any exposed layer lacks a recorded attachment and exhaustion conclusion.
generic.Exception handling path: Disputed UNL definitions are referred to the specialist for a documented treaty reading.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: The conclusion is accepted when inuring reinsurance is applied before the excess layer.
generic.Evidence location: Attachment and exhaustion conclusions recorded per layer on the recovery workbook.

steps.title: Read the UNL definition from the treaty repository
sop: Open the executed wording for the treaty and year in the treaty repository.
Read the ultimate net loss definition including its expense treatment.
Note any salvage and subrogation deductions the definition requires.
Done when the UNL definition is established for each exposed treaty.
verify: Compare the recorded definition to the wording text.
Pass when the recorded definition matches the executed wording.

steps.title: Compute the ultimate net loss on the treaty definition
sop: Apply the UNL definition to the loss paid and outstanding amounts.
Include or exclude expenses as the definition requires.
Deduct recoveries the definition requires to be netted.
Done when UNL is computed for each exposed loss or event.
verify: Recompute one UNL figure from the underlying amounts.
Pass when the recomputation agrees to the recorded UNL.

steps.title: Apply inuring reinsurance in the correct order
sop: Identify reinsurance that inures to the benefit of the excess layer.
Apply inuring recoveries before testing the excess layer attachment.
Record the order of operation applied on the workbook.
Done when inuring reinsurance is applied ahead of the excess layers.
verify: Check the workbook order of operation against the treaty terms.
Pass when inuring cover is applied before the excess layer in every case.

steps.title: Test attachment against each layer in Microsoft Excel
sop: Compare the post-inuring UNL against each layer attachment point.
Mark each layer as not attached or attached.
Compute the loss falling into each attached layer.
Done when attachment is tested for every exposed layer.
verify: Recompute two layer attachment tests by hand.
Pass when both recomputations agree to the workbook conclusions.

steps.title: Test exhaustion against limits and reinstatements
sop: Compare the loss in each attached layer to the layer limit.
Check the remaining reinstatements available for that layer.
Mark layers as exhausted where the limit and reinstatements are used.
Done when exhaustion is tested for every attached layer.
verify: Recompute the remaining reinstatement position on a sample.
Pass when the sampled remaining reinstatements agree to the workbook.

steps.title: Record the conclusion per layer on the recovery workbook
sop: Record the attachment and exhaustion conclusion against each layer.
Store the workbook against the loss or event in the reinsurance system.
Log layers with an unclear inuring order and the interpretation applied.
Done when every exposed layer carries a recorded conclusion.
verify: Scan the workbook for layers with a blank conclusion.
Pass when no exposed layer lacks an attachment and exhaustion conclusion.

generic.Defined scope/population: Recovery receipts confirmed as banked and awaiting posting to the general ledger.
generic.In-scope period: Receipts banked within the current ledger posting period.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each journal holds currency, FX rate, billing statement reference and the treaty.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Journal totals agree to the bank credit advices for the posting run.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Bank credit advice retained with the posted journal and its posting date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Receipts held in suspense are logged with the reason and a clearing owner.
generic.Test population: All recovery receipts banked in the posting period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fails if a recovery receipt is posted to suspense rather than the recoverable control account.
generic.Exception handling path: Unidentified receipts are posted to suspense only with a named owner and clearing date.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: A posting is accepted when a second reviewer approves it per the journal authority matrix.
generic.Evidence location: Posted journals in the ERP general ledger referenced to the billing statement.

steps.title: List banked recovery receipts from the ceded accounting platform
sop: Extract receipts banked in the period that are not yet posted.
Include bank credit advice reference, currency and amount.
Match each receipt to its reinsurer and billing statement.
Done when the posting worklist is produced for the period.
verify: Compare the worklist to bank credits for the period.
Pass when every banked recovery receipt appears on the worklist.

steps.title: Confirm currency and FX rate against the bank credit advice
sop: Read the currency and settled amount from the bank credit advice.
Set the FX rate on the journal to match the advice.
Do not apply a standard rate where the advice states an actual rate.
Done when currency and FX rate on each journal match the advice.
verify: Recompute one converted amount from the advice rate.
Pass when the recomputed amount agrees to the journal.

steps.title: Post the receipt to the recoverable control account in the ERP
sop: Post each receipt to the reinsurance recoverable control account.
Do not post recovery receipts to suspense where the statement is known.
Set the posting date within the current ledger period.
Done when each identified receipt is posted to the control account.
verify: Query posted journals for the account used.
Pass when no identified recovery receipt is posted to suspense.

steps.title: Reference the billing statement and treaty in the journal narrative
sop: Write the billing statement number into the journal narrative.
Add the treaty reference so the posting is traceable.
Avoid generic narratives that cannot be traced to a statement.
Done when every journal narrative references statement and treaty.
verify: Read a sample of journal narratives.
Pass when every sampled narrative names a statement and a treaty.

steps.title: Obtain second reviewer approval per the journal authority matrix
sop: Submit each posted journal for second reviewer approval.
Check the reviewer is within the authority matrix for the amount.
Hold posting release until the approval is recorded.
Done when every journal carries a recorded second approval.
verify: Query posted journals for an approver record.
Pass when no journal is released without a recorded approver.

steps.title: Update the reinsurance administration system with the posting reference
sop: Record the ledger journal reference against the recovery in the reinsurance system.
Confirm the receipt now shows as posted on the recovery record.
Log receipts held in suspense with the reason and clearing owner.
Done when postings are reflected against the recovery records.
verify: Compare posted journals to recovery records carrying a journal reference.
Pass when every posted journal is referenced on its recovery record.

generic.Defined scope/population: Paid losses on treaties with a cash loss clause where cash call eligibility has been confirmed.
generic.In-scope period: Loss payments made since the previous cash call drafting run.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each call holds the clause reference, paid loss amount, per-reinsurer shares and settlement date.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Per-reinsurer amounts sum back to the total cash call amount.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Proof of the underlying loss payment attached to the draft with its payment date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Calls that cannot be drafted are logged with the missing evidence and an owner.
generic.Test population: All eligible paid losses in the cash call drafting run.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fails if a drafted call has no payment proof or no per-reinsurer share breakdown.
generic.Exception handling path: Missing payment proof is chased from claims before the call is drafted.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: A draft is accepted when the requested settlement date follows the contractual settlement period.
generic.Evidence location: Drafted cash call requests held on the ceded loss file with attached payment proof.

steps.title: List eligible paid losses in the reinsurance administration system
sop: Filter losses with a confirmed cash call eligibility decision.
Include the paid loss amount that triggers the cash loss clause.
Exclude losses already covered by an issued cash call.
Done when the drafting worklist of eligible paid losses is produced.
verify: Compare the worklist to losses with a recorded eligibility decision.
Pass when every eligible loss without an issued call is on the worklist.

steps.title: Retrieve payment proof from the claim file repository
sop: Retrieve the payment evidence for the underlying loss from the claim file repository.
Check the evidence shows the payee, amount and payment date.
Log a chase where payment evidence is not available.
Done when payment proof is retrieved or a chase is logged for each loss.
verify: Check each draft for attached payment proof.
Pass when no draft is prepared without payment proof or a logged chase.

steps.title: Cite the cash loss clause and the triggering amount
sop: Quote the cash loss clause reference in the call text.
State the paid loss amount that triggers the clause.
Confirm the paid amount exceeds the clause threshold.
Done when every draft call cites the clause and the triggering amount.
verify: Read each draft for a clause citation and paid amount.
Pass when no draft omits the clause reference or the triggering amount.

steps.title: Compute per-reinsurer amounts in Microsoft Excel
sop: Apply reinsurer signed shares for the treaty year to the call amount.
Produce a per-reinsurer breakdown of the amount requested.
Total the breakdown back to the call amount.
Done when a per-reinsurer breakdown exists for each draft call.
verify: Sum the per-reinsurer amounts on each draft.
Pass when the per-reinsurer amounts total the call amount.

steps.title: Set the requested settlement date from the contractual period
sop: Read the contractual settlement period from the treaty terms.
Set the requested settlement date from the intended issue date.
Note the date on the draft so it can be diarised at submission.
Done when a requested settlement date is set on every draft call.
verify: Recompute a settlement date from the contractual period.
Pass when the recomputed date agrees to the date on the draft.

steps.title: Save the draft call to the ceded loss file
sop: Attach the payment proof and share breakdown to the draft call.
Save the draft to the ceded loss file with a draft date.
Move the loss into the cash call submission queue.
Done when every eligible loss has a saved draft cash call.
verify: Open saved drafts and check for proof and share breakdown.
Pass when every saved draft holds payment proof and a share breakdown.

generic.Defined scope/population: Ceded paid losses, LAE and recoveries for the accounting period due for billing to reinsurers.
generic.In-scope period: The agreed accounting period covered by the statement.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Statement shows paid losses, LAE and recoveries as separate lines with the treaty reference.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Statement totals reconcile to the ceded ledger before the statement is issued.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Prepared statement retained in the ceded accounting platform with its period and version.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Items excluded from the statement are logged with the reason and the next period plan.
generic.Test population: All ceded transactions for the treaty in the accounting period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fails if statement totals do not agree to the ceded ledger before issue.
generic.Exception handling path: Netting proposals not permitted by the treaty are reversed before the statement is finalised.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: A statement is accepted when the prior period unpaid balance is shown separately.
generic.Evidence location: Prepared recovery billing statements held in the ceded accounting platform.

steps.title: Extract period transactions from the reinsurance administration system
sop: Extract ceded paid losses, LAE and recoveries for the accounting period.
Restrict to the treaty and treaty year being billed.
Record the extract date and period covered.
Done when the period transaction extract is available.
verify: Compare the extract period to the agreed accounting period.
Pass when the extract covers exactly the agreed accounting period.

steps.title: Present paid losses, LAE and recoveries as separate lines
sop: Lay out the statement with paid losses, LAE and recoveries on separate lines.
Do not combine LAE into the paid loss line.
Show the treaty reference and period on the statement header.
Done when the statement shows the three categories separately.
verify: Inspect the statement layout for the three separate lines.
Pass when no category is merged into another line.

steps.title: Bring forward the prior period unpaid balance
sop: Read the unpaid balance carried from the prior period statement.
Show it brought forward as a separate line from current activity.
Confirm the brought forward figure agrees to the prior statement.
Done when the prior period unpaid balance is shown separately.
verify: Compare the brought forward balance to the prior statement closing balance.
Pass when the two balances agree.

steps.title: Apply permitted offsets only where the treaty allows netting
sop: Check the treaty for permission to net premium and reinstatement premium.
Apply offsets only where the treaty expressly permits netting.
Reverse any offset applied without treaty permission.
Done when only permitted offsets remain on the statement.
verify: Compare applied offsets to the treaty netting permission.
Pass when no offset is applied without treaty permission.

steps.title: Reconcile statement totals to the ceded ledger
sop: Total the statement and compare against the ceded ledger for the period.
Investigate and clear any difference before finalising.
Record the reconciliation alongside the statement.
Done when statement totals agree to the ceded ledger.
verify: Inspect the reconciliation for residual differences.
Pass when the statement total equals the ceded ledger balance.

steps.title: Finalise the statement in the ceded accounting platform
sop: Mark the statement ready to send in the ceded accounting platform.
Version the statement with the accounting period.
Log excluded items with the reason and the next period plan.
Done when the statement is finalised and ready to send.
verify: Open the finalised statement and check its status and version.
Pass when the statement is marked ready to send with a version and period.

generic.Defined scope/population: Recovery receipts posted in the period and the claims recoverable control account balance.
generic.In-scope period: The monthly close period for the claims recoverable account.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Reconciliation holds bank receipts, cash applied, reconciling items and their ages.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Bank receipts for the period agree to cash applied in the reinsurance administration system.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Signed reconciliation retained in the close pack with the period and sign-off dates.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Reconciling items are logged with an age, a named owner and a clearing plan.
generic.Test population: All recovery receipts and recoverable account movements in the close period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fails if a reconciling item remains open past the ageing threshold without escalation.
generic.Exception handling path: Aged reconciling items are escalated with a clearing plan before sign-off.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: The reconciliation is accepted when preparer and reviewer sign-offs are both recorded.
generic.Evidence location: Signed monthly reconciliation filed to the close pack.

steps.title: Extract bank receipts for the period from the ERP general ledger
sop: Extract recovery bank receipts posted in the close period.
Include value date, currency and the credit advice reference.
Exclude receipts belonging to other ledger accounts.
Done when the period bank receipt extract is available.
verify: Compare the extract total to the ledger account movement.
Pass when the extract agrees to the ledger movement for receipts.

steps.title: Extract cash applied from the reinsurance administration system
sop: Extract cash applied against billings in the same close period.
Include the statement and treaty referenced on each application.
Record the extract date for the reconciliation.
Done when the cash applied extract is available for the period.
verify: Compare the applied total to the reinsurance system report.
Pass when the extract agrees to the cash application report.

steps.title: Agree bank receipts to cash applied
sop: Match bank receipts to cash applied line by line.
List differences as reconciling items with a description.
Do not force a balancing entry to clear a difference.
Done when receipts and applications are matched or listed as reconciling items.
verify: Recompute the total of matched items and reconciling items.
Pass when matched plus reconciling items equals the bank receipt total.

steps.title: Age unapplied cash and assign clearing owners
sop: List unapplied cash with the days since receipt.
Assign a named owner to clear each unapplied item.
Set a target clearing date for each item.
Done when every unapplied item has an age and a named owner.
verify: Query unapplied cash for an owner and target date.
Pass when no unapplied item lacks an owner or a target date.

steps.title: Escalate reconciling items past the ageing threshold
sop: Identify reconciling items older than the ageing threshold.
Escalate each with a clearing plan and a committed date.
Record the escalation on the reconciliation.
Done when every aged reconciling item carries an escalation and plan.
verify: Compare aged items to the escalations recorded.
Pass when no aged item is left without an escalation and clearing plan.

steps.title: Obtain preparer and reviewer sign-off and file to the close pack
sop: Record the preparer sign-off with the date on the reconciliation.
Obtain and record the reviewer sign-off before the period locks.
File the signed reconciliation to the close pack.
Done when the signed reconciliation is filed for the period.
verify: Open the close pack and check for both sign-offs.
Pass when the filed reconciliation carries preparer and reviewer sign-offs.

generic.Defined scope/population: The reinsurance recoverable position including cash calls, billed balances and unbilled recoverables.
generic.In-scope period: The reporting month ending at the ledger period close date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Report holds opening balance, new recoverables, cash collected and the closing balance.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Closing balance reconciles to the recoverable control account in the ERP general ledger.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Published report retained on the BI reporting platform with its period and version.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Balances excluded from the report are logged with the exclusion reason and owner.
generic.Test population: All open recoverable balances at the reporting date across reinsurers.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fails if the monthly recoverable position report is not issued to the CFO for the period.
generic.Exception handling path: Data queries raised by the CFO are logged and closed before the next reporting cycle.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: The report is accepted when open cash calls and unbilled recoverables are shown separately.
generic.Evidence location: Published monthly recoverable position report on the BI reporting platform.

steps.title: Extract the recoverable roll-forward from the ERP general ledger
sop: Extract the opening recoverable balance for the reporting month.
Add new recoverables recognised and deduct cash collected in the month.
Derive the closing balance from the roll-forward.
Done when the recoverable roll-forward is produced for the month.
verify: Recompute the closing balance from the roll-forward components.
Pass when the recomputed closing balance agrees to the ledger.

steps.title: Build ageing buckets by reinsurer in Microsoft Excel
sop: Age open balances into current, 30, 60 and 90-plus day buckets.
Age from the contractual due date rather than the billing date.
Present the buckets by reinsurer.
Done when the ageing buckets are built by reinsurer.
verify: Recompute the bucket for a sample of balances.
Pass when the sampled balances fall in the recomputed buckets.

steps.title: Separate open cash calls and unbilled recoverables
sop: Identify open cash calls not yet settled at the reporting date.
Identify recoverables recognised but not yet billed.
Present both as separate lines from billed balances.
Done when cash calls and unbilled recoverables are shown separately.
verify: Inspect the report for the separate lines.
Pass when cash calls and unbilled amounts are not merged with billed balances.

steps.title: Explain movements above the reporting threshold
sop: Compare the closing balance by reinsurer to the prior month.
Identify movements above the reporting threshold.
Write commentary naming the driver for each such movement.
Done when every threshold movement carries commentary.
verify: Check threshold movements for attached commentary.
Pass when no threshold movement is left unexplained.

steps.title: Publish the position on the BI reporting platform
sop: Load the roll-forward, ageing and commentary to the BI reporting platform.
Reconcile the published closing balance to the recoverable control account.
Version the report with the reporting month.
Done when the monthly report is published for the period.
verify: Compare the published closing balance to the control account.
Pass when the published balance equals the control account balance.

steps.title: Issue the report to the CFO and close queries
sop: Issue the published report to the CFO for the reporting month.
Record the issue date and recipients.
Log CFO queries with an owner and close them before the next cycle.
Done when the report is issued and queries are logged.
verify: Check the issue record against the reporting month.
Pass when the report was issued for the current period.

generic.Defined scope/population: Drafted cash call requests ready for submission to reinsurers on risk for the treaty year.
generic.In-scope period: Cash calls drafted and awaiting submission in the current cycle.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Submission record holds recipients, signed shares, due date and the submission evidence.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Reinsurers issued the call match the reinsurers on risk for that treaty year.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Submission evidence stored against the cash call record with the send date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Failed submissions are logged with the reinsurer, the failure reason and the resend action.
generic.Test population: All drafted cash calls in the submission queue.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fails if a submitted call has no due date recorded in the cash call register.
generic.Exception handling path: Undeliverable submissions are rerouted through the placing broker the same day.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: A submission is accepted when the intermediary settlement route is confirmed before issue.
generic.Evidence location: Submission evidence and due dates held in the cash call register.

steps.title: Confirm the reinsurers on risk for the treaty year
sop: Read the treaty security for the relevant treaty year.
List every reinsurer on risk with its signed share.
Confirm the shares total 100 percent of the ceded layer.
Done when the recipient list for the cash call is confirmed.
verify: Compare the recipient list to the treaty security.
Pass when every reinsurer on risk appears on the recipient list.

steps.title: Confirm the intermediary settlement route before issue
sop: Identify reinsurers whose settlement runs through the placing broker.
Confirm the broker settlement route with the broker before issuing.
Record the route against each recipient on the call.
Done when the settlement route is confirmed for every recipient.
verify: Compare recorded routes to the placement arrangements.
Pass when every intermediated recipient carries a confirmed broker route.

steps.title: Issue the cash call through the Reinsurer Exchange
sop: Upload the cash call and payment proof to the Reinsurer Exchange.
Address the call to each exchange-enabled reinsurer on its signed share.
Capture the exchange submission reference.
Done when the call is issued to every exchange-enabled reinsurer.
verify: Compare exchange submissions to the exchange-enabled recipients.
Pass when every exchange recipient has a submission reference.

steps.title: Issue to remaining recipients from Microsoft Teams / Email
sop: Email the cash call to reinsurers not reachable on the exchange.
Copy the placing broker on every intermediated call.
Request delivery confirmation on each email.
Done when every recipient has received the cash call.
verify: Match sent emails to the non-exchange recipients.
Pass when no recipient is left without a submission.

steps.title: Diarise the due date in the cash call register
sop: Record the cash call in the register at the point of submission.
Set the due date from the contractual settlement period.
Set the review diary entry on the due date.
Done when every submitted call is diarised with a due date.
verify: Query submitted calls in the register for a due date.
Pass when no submitted call lacks a due date.

steps.title: Store submission evidence against the cash call record
sop: Attach exchange references and email confirmations to the call record.
Log failed submissions with the reinsurer and the failure reason.
Reroute failed submissions through the broker the same day.
Done when every submission has stored evidence or a logged failure.
verify: Open cash call records and check for stored submission evidence.
Pass when every recipient shows evidence or a logged and rerouted failure.

generic.Defined scope/population: Finalised recovery billing statements and their supporting bordereaux due for issue to reinsurers.
generic.In-scope period: Statements due inside the contractual account rendering deadline.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Issue record holds recipients, issue date, due date and the acknowledgement reference.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Statements issued equal statements finalised less any logged exceptions.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Reinsurer or broker acknowledgement captured against the statement with its date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Statements not issued by the deadline are logged with the reason and the revised date.
generic.Test population: All finalised statements in the issue queue for the period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fails if an issued statement is not recorded as billed with a due date in the ageing.
generic.Exception handling path: Rejected submissions are corrected and reissued inside the rendering deadline where possible.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: An issue is accepted when the supporting bordereau matches the detail the treaty requires.
generic.Evidence location: Issued statements and acknowledgements held in the ceded accounting platform.

steps.title: Check the account rendering deadline for each statement
sop: Read the contractual account rendering deadline for the treaty.
Compare the deadline to the statement period end date.
Order the issue queue by the tightest deadline first.
Done when the issue queue is ordered by rendering deadline.
verify: Compare queue order to the rendering deadlines.
Pass when no statement with an earlier deadline sits behind a later one.

steps.title: Attach the supporting claim bordereau at the required detail
sop: Read the level of claim detail the treaty requires with the statement.
Attach the claim bordereau at that level of detail.
Do not issue a summary where claim level detail is required.
Done when each statement carries a compliant supporting bordereau.
verify: Compare the attached bordereau detail to the treaty requirement.
Pass when every statement carries the required level of detail.

steps.title: Issue the statement through the Reinsurer Exchange
sop: Upload the statement and bordereau to the Reinsurer Exchange.
Address it to each reinsurer on risk for the statement period.
Capture the exchange submission reference for each upload.
Done when the statement is issued to every exchange-enabled reinsurer.
verify: Compare uploads to the exchange-enabled recipients.
Pass when every exchange recipient has a submission reference.

steps.title: Issue to remaining recipients from Microsoft Teams / Email
sop: Email the statement and bordereau to non-exchange reinsurers.
Copy the placing broker on intermediated placements.
Request acknowledgement of receipt in each email.
Done when every recipient has received the statement.
verify: Match sent emails to the non-exchange recipients.
Pass when no recipient is left without an issued statement.

steps.title: Log the statement as billed with a due date in the ageing
sop: Record the statement as billed in the ceded accounting platform.
Set the due date from the contractual settlement period.
Confirm the balance now appears in the recoverable ageing.
Done when every issued statement is logged as billed with a due date.
verify: Query issued statements in the ageing for a due date.
Pass when no issued statement is missing from the ageing or its due date.

steps.title: Capture acknowledgements against the statement
sop: Capture reinsurer or broker acknowledgements against each statement.
Log statements with no acknowledgement for chasing.
Record rejections with the reason and the reissue action taken.
Done when every issued statement has an acknowledgement or a logged chase.
verify: Open statement records and check for acknowledgement references.
Pass when every statement holds an acknowledgement or a logged chase.

generic.Defined scope/population: All open cash calls on the register regardless of whether payment has been received in full.
generic.In-scope period: The status update cycle covering all open calls at the update date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Register holds status, value received, days outstanding and the allocation of part payments.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Value received on the register agrees to cash applied in the ERP general ledger.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Updated register retained in Microsoft Excel with the update date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Calls with unmatched receipts are logged with the difference and a clearing owner.
generic.Test population: All open cash calls in the register at the update date.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fails if days outstanding is calculated from the submission date rather than the due date.
generic.Exception handling path: Calls unpaid past the due date are pushed into the collections chase list.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: An update is accepted when part payments are allocated to the specific loss lines in the call.
generic.Evidence location: Cash call register in the reinsurance administration system.

steps.title: Extract receipts against cash calls from the ERP general ledger
sop: Extract receipts posted against cash calls since the previous update.
Include the reinsurer, value date and the amount received.
Map each receipt to its cash call reference.
Done when receipts are extracted and mapped to cash calls.
verify: Compare mapped receipts to the ledger postings.
Pass when every posted cash call receipt is mapped.

steps.title: Update payment status on the cash call register
sop: Set each call to paid, part paid or unpaid from the mapped receipts.
Record the value received against each call.
Leave calls with no receipt marked unpaid.
Done when every open call carries a current payment status.
verify: Query the register for calls without a status.
Pass when no open call is left without a payment status.

steps.title: Calculate days outstanding from the contractual due date
sop: Take the contractual due date recorded at submission.
Calculate days outstanding from that due date, not the submission date.
Record days outstanding against each unpaid or part paid call.
Done when days outstanding is calculated for every open call.
verify: Recompute days outstanding on a sample from the due date.
Pass when the recomputed values agree to the register.
