steps.title: Allocate part payments to specific loss lines
sop: Read the remittance detail supplied with each part payment.
Allocate the payment to the specific loss lines within the call.
Leave unallocated residuals visible with a reason.
Done when every part payment is allocated to loss lines.
verify: Sum allocations back to the part payment received.
Pass when allocations equal the payment received for each call.

steps.title: Reconcile register receipts to applied cash in Microsoft Excel
sop: Compare value received on the register to cash applied in the ledger.
List differences as reconciling items with an owner.
Clear differences before the register is published.
Done when the register receipts reconcile to applied cash.
verify: Inspect the reconciliation for residual differences.
Pass when register receipts equal applied cash.

steps.title: Push overdue calls into the collections chase list
sop: Identify calls unpaid beyond the contractual due date.
Add each to the collections chase list with the outstanding amount.
Flag calls chased three or more times for escalation.
Done when every overdue call sits on the collections chase list.
verify: Compare overdue calls to the chase list entries.
Pass when no overdue call is missing from the chase list.

generic.Defined scope/population: Paid losses proposed for a cash call, tested against treaty cash loss clause thresholds.
generic.In-scope period: Loss payments made since the previous eligibility validation run.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Eligibility decision records the clause reference, threshold applied and the paid amount tested.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Losses tested equal losses ruled eligible plus losses routed to periodic billing.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Wording extract retained with the eligibility decision and its decision date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Losses failing the eligibility test are logged and routed to periodic billing.
generic.Test population: All paid losses proposed for a cash call in the run.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fails if a cash call is raised on a treaty without a cash loss clause.
generic.Exception handling path: Borderline paid amounts are re-tested at the next payment rather than called early.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: A decision is accepted when the test is applied to the amount paid, not incurred.
generic.Evidence location: Eligibility decisions with clause references on the loss records in the reinsurance administration system.

steps.title: List paid losses proposed for a cash call
sop: Extract losses with payments made since the previous eligibility run.
Include the paid amount and the governing treaty on each row.
Exclude losses already covered by an issued cash call.
Done when the eligibility test population is produced.
verify: Compare the population to losses with new payments in the period.
Pass when every newly paid loss in scope is on the list.

steps.title: Read the cash loss clause from the treaty repository
sop: Open the executed wording for the treaty and correct treaty year.
Read the cash loss clause and its threshold amount.
Note treaties where no cash loss clause exists.
Done when the clause position is established for every treaty in scope.
verify: Compare the recorded threshold to the executed wording.
Pass when the recorded threshold matches the wording for each treaty.

steps.title: Apply the threshold test to the amount actually paid
sop: Take the amount actually paid on the loss, not the incurred figure.
Compare that amount to the cash loss clause threshold.
Record the test result against the loss.
Done when every proposed loss carries a threshold test result.
verify: Recompute the test on a sample using the paid amount.
Pass when the recomputed results match the recorded results.

steps.title: Exclude treaties with no cash loss clause
sop: Identify losses on treaties with no cash loss clause.
Mark those losses as not eligible for a cash call.
Route them to the periodic billing process instead.
Done when every loss without a cash loss clause is routed to billing.
verify: Query eligible losses for a treaty cash loss clause.
Pass when no eligible loss sits on a treaty without a cash loss clause.

steps.title: Record the eligibility decision with the clause reference
sop: Record the eligibility decision on the loss record before drafting.
Quote the governing clause reference with the decision.
State the threshold amount used in the test.
Done when every tested loss carries a recorded eligibility decision.
verify: Query decisions for a populated clause reference.
Pass when no eligibility decision lacks a clause reference.

steps.title: Track the eligibility run in Microsoft Excel
sop: Record the eligibility run results in the tracking workbook.
Reconcile losses tested to eligible plus routed to billing.
Retain the workbook with its run date for evidence.
Done when the eligibility run is reconciled and retained.
verify: Compare the workbook totals to the tested population.
Pass when eligible plus routed losses equal the losses tested.

generic.Defined scope/population: Reinsurers whose settlement behaviour has slowed materially against their historic payment pattern.
generic.In-scope period: The credit review cycle covering payment behaviour since the previous assessment.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Assessment records rating, outlook, collateral held, exposed balance and the conclusion.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Exposed balance in the assessment agrees to the aged recoverable report by reinsurer.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Rating check retained with the date checked and the source used.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Reinsurers with no current rating are logged with the alternative evidence relied on.
generic.Test population: All reinsurers showing settlement slowdown at the review date.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fails if a distress conclusion is recorded without a dated rating check.
generic.Exception handling path: Distressed counterparties are referred for provisioning and security review.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: An assessment is accepted when collateral held is compared to the exposed balance.
generic.Evidence location: Counterparty distress assessments recorded on the reinsurer record.

steps.title: Extract settlement behaviour by reinsurer in Microsoft Excel
sop: Extract days to settle by reinsurer for the review period.
Compare against each reinsurer historic settlement days.
List reinsurers whose settlement days have deteriorated materially.
Done when the slowdown list is produced for the review.
verify: Recompute the settlement trend for a sample of reinsurers.
Pass when the sampled trends confirm the slowdown classification.

steps.title: Check current financial strength ratings and outlooks
sop: Check the current financial strength rating for each listed reinsurer.
Note any watch status or negative outlook and its date.
Record the source and the date the rating was checked.
Done when a dated rating position exists for every listed reinsurer.
verify: Query the assessments for a dated rating check.
Pass when no assessment lacks a dated rating and source.

steps.title: Quantify the exposed balance from the reinsurance administration system
sop: Extract the total open recoverable balance for each listed reinsurer.
Split billed, unbilled and disputed amounts within the balance.
Agree the total to the aged recoverable report.
Done when the exposed balance is quantified per reinsurer.
verify: Compare the exposed balance to the aged recoverable report.
Pass when the two figures agree by reinsurer.

steps.title: Compare collateral held against the exposed balance
sop: List collateral held as letters of credit, funds withheld or trust.
Compare the collateral value to the exposed balance per reinsurer.
Compute the uncollateralised exposure remaining.
Done when uncollateralised exposure is computed per reinsurer.
verify: Recompute uncollateralised exposure on a sample.
Pass when the recomputed exposure agrees to the assessment.

steps.title: Trend the position on the BI reporting platform
sop: Load settlement days, rating and exposure into the counterparty view.
Trend the position against previous review cycles.
Highlight reinsurers deteriorating across more than one measure.
Done when the counterparty trend view is refreshed for the cycle.
verify: Open the trend view and check the current cycle is present.
Pass when the current cycle appears with all three measures.

steps.title: Document the distress conclusion and recommended action
sop: State the distress conclusion for each reinsurer assessed.
Recommend the action such as collateral call, provision or security review.
Record the conclusion on the counterparty record with the assessment date.
Done when every assessed reinsurer carries a documented conclusion.
verify: Open counterparty records for a recorded conclusion and action.
Pass when no assessed reinsurer lacks a conclusion and recommended action.

generic.Defined scope/population: Recoverable balances outstanding past the contractual settlement period across all reinsurers.
generic.In-scope period: The chase cycle covering all overdue balances at the extract date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each chase records contact name, chase date and any promised payment date.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Overdue balances on the chase list equal balances chased plus logged exceptions.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Chase correspondence retained against the balance with its send date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Balances under query or dispute are logged and removed from the routine chase cycle.
generic.Test population: All overdue recoverable balances at the chase extract date.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fails if any overdue recoverable balance has no chase contact recorded.
generic.Exception handling path: Disputed balances are routed to the dispute logging process instead of further chasing.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: A chase is accepted when it quotes the statement number, treaty and amount outstanding.
generic.Evidence location: Chase records held against each recoverable balance in the reinsurance administration system.

steps.title: Generate the chase list from the reinsurance administration system
sop: Extract balances past the contractual settlement period.
Include statement number, treaty, reinsurer and amount outstanding.
Exclude balances already flagged as disputed.
Done when the chase list is generated for the cycle.
verify: Compare the list to overdue balances in the ageing.
Pass when every non-disputed overdue balance appears on the list.

steps.title: Assign chase level from the dunning schedule in Microsoft Excel
sop: Load the chase list into the collections workbook.
Assign first, second or third chase level from the dunning schedule.
Do not re-select chase levels manually outside the schedule.
Done when every listed balance carries a chase level.
verify: Recompute chase level from prior chase dates on a sample.
Pass when the sampled chase levels follow the dunning schedule.

steps.title: Issue chases from Microsoft Teams / Email
sop: Send each chase to the named reinsurer collections contact.
Quote the statement number, treaty and amount outstanding.
Request a payment date in the response.
Done when a chase is issued for every listed balance.
verify: Read a sample of chases for the three required references.
Pass when every sampled chase quotes statement, treaty and amount.

steps.title: Log contact and promised payment dates against the balance
sop: Record the contact name and chase date against the balance.
Record any promised payment date given in the response.
Set a diary review on each promised payment date.
Done when every chase and response is logged against the balance.
verify: Query overdue balances for a logged chase contact.
Pass when no overdue balance is left without a chase record.

steps.title: Route queries and disputes out of the chase cycle
sop: Identify balances where the response raises a query or dispute.
Route disputed balances to the dispute logging process.
Remove them from the routine chase cycle with the reason recorded.
Done when queried and disputed balances are routed out of chasing.
verify: Compare routed balances to the dispute register entries.
Pass when every routed balance appears on the dispute register.

steps.title: Track chase outcomes for the next cycle
sop: Record chase outcomes in the collections workbook.
Compare promised payment dates against actual receipts.
Escalate balances where a promise was missed.
Done when chase outcomes are recorded for the cycle.
verify: Compare recorded outcomes to receipts applied in the period.
Pass when every promised payment is marked kept or missed.

generic.Defined scope/population: Aged recoverable balances with slow-paying or disputing markets where broker help is needed to collect.
generic.In-scope period: Balances aged beyond the routine chase cycle at the engagement date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Engagement record holds broker contact name, balances handed over and the response deadline.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Balances collected through the broker reconcile back to the original billing statements.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Broker engagement correspondence retained with the statement pack and the send date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Broker feedback is logged per reinsurer as query, dispute or promised payment date.
generic.Test population: All aged balances handed to the broker for collection support.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fails if a broker engagement has no agreed written response deadline.
generic.Exception handling path: Balances the broker cannot progress are escalated for formal escalation or dispute.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Engagement is accepted when the broker receives the statement pack and the full ageing.
generic.Evidence location: Broker engagement records held against the aged balances in the reinsurance administration system.

steps.title: Select aged balances needing broker support
sop: Identify aged balances where direct chasing has not produced payment.
Group the balances by market and by placing broker.
Exclude balances already in formal dispute.
Done when the balances for broker engagement are selected.
verify: Compare the selection to the aged balance list.
Pass when every selected balance is genuinely past the chase cycle.

steps.title: Assemble the statement pack and full ageing
sop: Assemble the billing statements underlying each selected balance.
Add the full ageing for the market concerned.
Include the chase history already undertaken.
Done when the broker pack is assembled for each market.
verify: Check each pack for statements, ageing and chase history.
Pass when no pack is missing one of the three components.

steps.title: Engage the named broker contact by Microsoft Teams / Email
sop: Send the pack to the named broker claims broking contact.
State the collection support required per reinsurer.
Agree a written response deadline with the broker.
Done when the broker is engaged with an agreed response deadline.
verify: Read the engagement correspondence for a stated deadline.
Pass when every engagement carries an agreed written deadline.

steps.title: Track broker progress through the Reinsurer Exchange
sop: Monitor exchange activity for the balances handed to the broker.
Record reinsurer responses received through the exchange.
Chase the broker where no activity appears by the deadline.
Done when broker progress is tracked for every handed balance.
verify: Compare exchange activity to the handed balance list.
Pass when every handed balance shows tracked progress or a broker chase.

steps.title: Log broker feedback per reinsurer
sop: Record broker feedback against each reinsurer balance.
Classify each as query, dispute or promised payment date.
Route disputes to the dispute logging process.
Done when broker feedback is logged for every handed balance.
verify: Query handed balances for logged broker feedback.
Pass when no handed balance lacks a logged feedback classification.

steps.title: Reconcile broker collections to the original billing statements
sop: Match cash collected through the broker to the original statements.
Investigate collections that cannot be traced to a statement.
Close statements fully settled through the broker route.
Done when broker collections are reconciled to the billing statements.
verify: Inspect the reconciliation for untraced broker collections.
Pass when every broker collection traces to an original statement.

generic.Defined scope/population: Recoverable balances aged beyond 90 days from the contractual due date across all reinsurers.
generic.In-scope period: The escalation cycle covering balances at 90-plus days at the extract date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each escalation holds reinsurer, balance, cause code and the recommended next step.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Escalated balances equal the 90-plus day population on the aged recoverable report.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Escalation record retained with the prior chase history and the escalation date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Balances not escalated are logged with the documented decision and its author.
generic.Test population: All balances aged beyond 90 days at the escalation date.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fails if a 90-plus day balance sits without an escalation or a documented decision.
generic.Exception handling path: Balances judged uncollectable are routed to the bad debt provision recommendation.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: An escalation is accepted when it states a recommended next step per balance.
generic.Evidence location: Escalation records held against the aged balances in the reinsurance administration system.

steps.title: Extract the 90-plus day population in Microsoft Excel
sop: Extract balances aged beyond 90 days from the contractual due date.
List them by reinsurer with the treaty and statement reference.
Total the population so the escalation can be reconciled.
Done when the 90-plus day population is extracted.
verify: Compare the extract to the aged recoverable report 90-plus bucket.
Pass when the extract total agrees to the report bucket.

steps.title: Assign a cause code to each aged balance
sop: Review the chase history and responses for each aged balance.
Assign a cause code of query, dispute or no response.
Record the cause code against the balance.
Done when every aged balance carries a cause code.
verify: Query the aged population for a populated cause code.
Pass when no aged balance is left without a cause code.

steps.title: Attach the prior chase history as evidence
sop: Pull the chase history for each balance from the reinsurance system.
Attach the history to the escalation to evidence collection effort.
Note where chase activity is thin so it can be completed first.
Done when chase history is attached to every escalation.
verify: Open escalations and check for attached chase history.
Pass when no escalation is submitted without chase evidence.

steps.title: State the recommended next step per balance
sop: Recommend broker escalation, formal demand or provision per balance.
Base the recommendation on the cause code and the counterparty position.
Record the recommendation on the escalation entry.
Done when every escalated balance carries a recommended next step.
verify: Read escalations for a stated recommendation.
Pass when no escalation lacks a recommended next step.

steps.title: Issue the escalation to the Reinsurance Ops Manager
sop: Send the escalation pack by Microsoft Teams / Email to the Ops Manager.
Include the population, cause codes, chase history and recommendations.
Request a decision date for each escalated balance.
Done when the escalation pack is issued for the cycle.
verify: Compare the issued pack to the 90-plus day population.
Pass when the pack covers every 90-plus day balance.

steps.title: Record acknowledgement and the decision date
sop: Acknowledge the escalation and set a decision date per balance.
Record the acknowledgement against the balance in the reinsurance system.
Refer uncollectable balances to the bad debt provision process.
Done when every escalated balance carries an acknowledgement and decision date.
verify: Query escalated balances for an acknowledgement and decision date.
Pass when no escalated balance lacks both.

generic.Defined scope/population: Aged recoverable balances requiring formal escalation above the routine chase to the market or broker.
generic.In-scope period: Balances aged past the escalation trigger at the escalation date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Escalation letter records the balance, contractual clause cited and a response deadline.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Formal escalations issued equal the aged balances selected for escalation.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Escalation correspondence stored against the ageing record with its send date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Balances where escalation is deferred are logged with the reason and a review date.
generic.Test population: All aged balances selected for formal escalation in the cycle.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fails if a formal escalation is issued without a recorded response deadline.
generic.Exception handling path: Non-responses at the deadline route to broker engagement or dispute initiation.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: An escalation is accepted when it is addressed to the market claims manager, not the routine contact.
generic.Evidence location: Formal escalation correspondence stored against the aged balance.

steps.title: Select balances for formal escalation in the reinsurance administration system
sop: Identify aged balances where routine chasing has been exhausted.
Confirm at least the scheduled chases have been issued and logged.
Select the balances for formal escalation this cycle.
Done when the formal escalation population is selected.
verify: Check selected balances for completed routine chase history.
Pass when every selected balance has exhausted the routine chase cycle.

steps.title: Identify the market claims manager for each escalation
sop: Identify the market claims manager at each reinsurer concerned.
Identify the broker claims broking lead for the placement.
Record both contacts against the escalation.
Done when escalation recipients are identified for every balance.
verify: Compare recipients to the routine chase contacts.
Pass when every escalation is addressed above the routine contact.

steps.title: Draft the formal escalation letter citing the contractual clause
sop: Draft a formal escalation letter above the routine chase wording.
Cite the contractual settlement clause and any interest or offset rights.
State the balance, statement and treaty in the letter.
Done when a formal escalation letter is drafted for each balance.
verify: Read each letter for a cited settlement clause.
Pass when no letter is issued without a clause citation.

steps.title: Issue the escalation from Microsoft Teams / Email
sop: Send the escalation letter to the market claims manager.
Copy the broker claims broking lead on every escalation.
State a response deadline in the letter.
Done when every escalation is issued with a response deadline.
verify: Read issued escalations for a stated response deadline.
Pass when no issued escalation lacks a deadline.

steps.title: Record the escalation on the ageing record
sop: Record the escalation date and response deadline on the ageing record.
Attach the escalation correspondence to the balance.
Set a diary review on the response deadline.
Done when every escalation is recorded against its ageing record.
verify: Query escalated balances for a recorded escalation date and deadline.
Pass when no escalated balance is missing either field.

steps.title: Track responses through the Reinsurer Exchange
sop: Monitor the Reinsurer Exchange for responses to the escalations.
Record responses or non-responses at the deadline.
Route non-responses to broker engagement or dispute initiation.
Done when every escalation has a recorded response or onward route.
verify: Compare escalations to recorded responses at the deadline.
Pass when every escalation shows a response or an onward route.

generic.Defined scope/population: Contested recovery amounts where collection has failed and formal dispute resolution is required.
generic.In-scope period: Contested balances identified since the previous dispute review.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Dispute record holds counterparty, treaty, contested amount and the basis of contest.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Contested amounts reclassified as disputed equal the reduction in collectable balances.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Notice of dispute retained with its issue date and the clause relied on.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Balances where dispute is deferred are logged with the reason and a review date.
generic.Test population: All contested recovery balances considered for formal dispute resolution.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fails if a dispute record is opened without the dispute resolution clause referenced.
generic.Exception handling path: Disputes below the materiality threshold are held for commercial resolution first.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Initiation is accepted when notice is issued per the notice requirements in the clause.
generic.Evidence location: Dispute records held in the legal matter management system and the reinsurance system.

steps.title: Ring-fence the contested amount in the reinsurance administration system
sop: Identify the specific contested amount within the recoverable balance.
Reclassify the amount from collectable to disputed.
Leave any uncontested remainder in the collectable ageing.
Done when the contested amount is ring-fenced as disputed.
verify: Compare the reclassified amount to the collectable ageing reduction.
Pass when the reduction equals the contested amount reclassified.

steps.title: Identify the dispute resolution clause in the treaty wording
sop: Read the dispute resolution clause in the executed treaty wording.
Determine whether it requires mediation, arbitration or service of suit.
Note the notice requirements and any time limits in the clause.
Done when the governing dispute route and notice requirements are identified.
verify: Compare the identified route to the clause text.
Pass when the identified route matches the executed wording.

steps.title: Assemble the contest basis from the claim file repository
sop: Collect the correspondence stating the reinsurer position.
Collect the underlying claim documents supporting the recovery.
Summarise the basis on which the amount is contested.
Done when the basis of contest is documented with supporting evidence.
verify: Check the summary against the collected evidence.
Pass when every contest ground is supported by a referenced document.

steps.title: Draft the notice of dispute per the clause requirements
sop: Draft the notice of dispute in the form the clause requires.
Include the treaty, contested amount and basis of contest.
Follow the service method and address stated in the clause.
Done when the notice of dispute is drafted for issue.
verify: Compare the draft notice to the clause notice requirements.
Pass when the draft satisfies form, content and service requirements.

steps.title: Issue the notice of dispute to the counterparty
sop: Issue the notice by the service method the clause requires.
Record the issue date and the method of service.
Copy the broker where the placement is intermediated.
Done when the notice of dispute has been served.
verify: Check the service record against the clause requirements.
Pass when the notice was served by the required method and is dated.

steps.title: Open the dispute record in the legal matter management system
sop: Open a matter recording counterparty, treaty, amount and basis of contest.
Reference the dispute resolution clause on the matter record.
Link the matter to the ring-fenced balance in the reinsurance system.
Done when the dispute record is open and linked.
verify: Open the matter and check for the clause reference and linked balance.
Pass when the record holds both the clause reference and the linked balance.

generic.Defined scope/population: Incoming reinsurer remittances awaiting matching to outstanding recoverable balances.
generic.In-scope period: Remittances received since the previous matching run.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each match holds statement or claim reference, amount matched and the FX difference if any.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Remittances received equal amounts matched plus amounts held in suspense.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Remittance advice retained against the matched balance with the matching date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Unidentified receipts are held in suspense with an owner and a clearing deadline.
generic.Test population: All reinsurer remittances received in the matching period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fails if a remittance remains in suspense beyond the clearing deadline.
generic.Exception handling path: Remittances without usable advice are chased from the reinsurer or broker.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: A match is accepted when the advice is parsed to statement or claim level before application.
generic.Evidence location: Matched remittance records in the reinsurance administration system and ceded accounting platform.

steps.title: List unmatched remittances in the ceded accounting platform
sop: Extract remittances received with no recoverable match recorded.
Include reinsurer, currency, amount and the receipt date.
Age each unmatched remittance against the clearing deadline.
Done when the unmatched remittance worklist is produced.
verify: Compare the worklist to receipts without a match.
Pass when every unmatched remittance is on the worklist.

steps.title: Parse the remittance advice to statement or claim level
sop: Read the remittance advice supplied with each receipt.
Break the advice down to statement or claim level lines.
Flag receipts with no usable advice for chasing.
Done when each remittance is parsed or flagged for chasing.
verify: Compare parsed lines back to the remittance total.
Pass when the parsed lines sum to the remittance amount.

steps.title: Match parsed lines to outstanding recoverables
sop: Match each parsed line to an outstanding recoverable balance.
Apply the match at claim level where the advice supports it.
Leave unmatched lines open rather than forcing a match.
Done when parsed lines are matched to outstanding recoverables.
verify: Check matched lines against the open recoverable list.
Pass when every match points to a genuine open recoverable.

steps.title: Post FX differences to the FX variance account in the ERP
sop: Compute the FX difference on foreign currency settlements.
Post the difference to the FX variance account in the ERP.
Do not absorb FX differences into the recoverable balance.
Done when FX differences are posted to the variance account.
verify: Query FX postings against the settled foreign currency remittances.
Pass when every FX difference is posted to the variance account.

steps.title: Hold unidentified receipts in suspense with an owner
sop: Post unidentified receipts to suspense in the ceded accounting platform.
Assign a named owner and a clearing deadline to each item.
Chase the reinsurer or broker for the missing advice.
Done when every unidentified receipt is in suspense with an owner.
verify: Query suspense items for an owner and a clearing deadline.
Pass when no suspense item lacks both.

steps.title: Mark matched items settled and clear them from the ageing
sop: Mark fully matched recoverables as settled in the reinsurance system.
Confirm settled items drop out of the recoverable ageing.
Reconcile matched plus suspense to the total remittances received.
Done when matched items are settled and the run reconciles.
verify: Re-run the ageing and the suspense listing after matching.
Pass when matched plus suspense equals total remittances received.

generic.Defined scope/population: All open recoverable balances segmented by reinsurer, treaty and loss event at the reporting date.
generic.In-scope period: The reporting period ending at the ledger close date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each row holds reinsurer, treaty, loss event, due date and the ageing bucket.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Report total agrees to the recoverable control account balance in the ledger.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Published report retained on the BI reporting platform with its period and version.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Balances excluded from the ageing are logged with the exclusion reason and owner.
generic.Test population: All open recoverable balances at the reporting date.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fails if buckets are calculated from the billing date rather than the contractual due date.
generic.Exception handling path: Balances failing control account agreement are investigated before the report is published.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: The report is accepted when disputed and provisioned balances are shown separately.
generic.Evidence location: Published aged recoverable report on the BI reporting platform.

steps.title: Extract open recoverables from the reinsurance administration system
sop: Extract all open recoverable balances at the reporting date.
Include reinsurer, treaty, loss event, billing date and due date.
Record the extract date on the report source.
Done when the open recoverable extract is available.
verify: Compare the extract total to the open recoverable balance.
Pass when the extract equals the open recoverable balance.

steps.title: Calculate ageing buckets from the contractual due date
sop: Calculate days outstanding from the contractual due date on each balance.
Assign current, 30, 60 and 90-plus day buckets.
Do not age from the billing date.
Done when every balance carries an ageing bucket.
verify: Recompute the bucket for a sample using the due date.
Pass when the sampled buckets agree to the due date calculation.

steps.title: Segment the ageing by reinsurer, treaty and loss event
sop: Build the ageing views required by management.
Provide segmentation by reinsurer, by treaty and by loss event.
Keep the underlying balance list consistent across the three views.
Done when the three segmentation views are built.
verify: Compare the totals across the three segmentation views.
Pass when all three views total to the same balance.

steps.title: Separate disputed and provisioned balances in Microsoft Excel
sop: Identify balances flagged disputed or carrying a bad debt provision.
Show them separately from the clean receivable balances.
State the provision held against each provisioned balance.
Done when disputed and provisioned balances are shown separately.
verify: Inspect the report for the separated sections.
Pass when disputed and provisioned amounts are not mixed with clean receivables.

steps.title: Agree the report total to the recoverable control account
sop: Compare the report total to the recoverable control account in the ledger.
Investigate and clear any difference before publishing.
Record the agreement alongside the report.
Done when the report total agrees to the control account.
verify: Inspect the agreement for unexplained differences.
Pass when the report total equals the control account balance.

steps.title: Publish the report on the BI reporting platform
sop: Publish the aged recoverable report on the BI reporting platform.
Version the report with the reporting period.
Log balances excluded from the ageing with the reason.
Done when the aged recoverable report is published for the period.
verify: Open the published report and check the period and version.
Pass when the current period report is published with its control account agreement.

generic.Defined scope/population: The recoverable status pack covering cash collected, forecast collections and disputed balances.
generic.In-scope period: The monthly close period as set by the close calendar.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Pack holds cash collected in month, forecast collections, disputed and provisioned movements.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Cash collected in the pack agrees to receipts posted in the ERP general ledger.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Delivered pack retained on the BI reporting platform with its close date and version.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Controller queries are logged with an owner and closed before the period locks.
generic.Test population: All recoverable balances and receipts within the close period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fails if the status pack is delivered after the close calendar date for the recoverable line.
generic.Exception handling path: Late data is flagged in the pack rather than delaying delivery past the close date.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: The pack is accepted when movements in disputed and provisioned balances are explained.
generic.Evidence location: Delivered monthly status pack held on the BI reporting platform.

steps.title: Confirm the close calendar date for the recoverable line
sop: Read the close calendar date for the recoverable reporting line.
Work back to set the data cut-off and preparation dates.
Notify contributors of the cut-off.
Done when the close date and cut-off are confirmed for the period.
verify: Compare the planned delivery date to the close calendar.
Pass when the planned delivery date is on or before the close date.

steps.title: Extract cash collected in month from the ERP general ledger
sop: Extract recovery receipts posted in the close period.
Split the receipts by reinsurer and by treaty.
Agree the total to the recoverable control account movement.
Done when cash collected in month is extracted and agreed.
verify: Compare extracted cash to the control account movement.
Pass when the two figures agree.

steps.title: Prepare the forecast for next month collections in Microsoft Excel
sop: Take promised payment dates and due dates falling in the next month.
Build the forecast collection profile from those dates.
Exclude disputed balances from the forecast.
Done when the next month collection forecast is prepared.
verify: Check the forecast excludes disputed balances.
Pass when no disputed balance appears in the forecast.

steps.title: Explain movements in disputed and provisioned balances
sop: Compare disputed and provisioned balances to the prior month.
Write commentary explaining each material movement.
Name the driver such as new dispute, settlement or provision release.
Done when disputed and provisioned movements are explained.
verify: Check each material movement for attached commentary.
Pass when no material movement is left unexplained.

steps.title: Deliver the status pack on the close calendar date
sop: Publish the pack on the BI reporting platform for the period.
Deliver it to the finance controller on the close calendar date.
Flag any late data in the pack rather than delaying delivery.
Done when the status pack is delivered on the close date.
verify: Compare the delivery date to the close calendar date.
Pass when the pack was delivered on or before the close date.

steps.title: Log and close controller queries before the period locks
sop: Log every controller query with an owner and a target date.
Provide the answer and record it against the query.
Close all queries before the ledger period is locked.
Done when all controller queries are closed for the period.
verify: Check the query log status before the period lock.
Pass when no controller query remains open at period lock.

generic.Defined scope/population: Recoverable balances assessed as uncollectible in whole or in part and requiring a bad debt provision.
generic.In-scope period: The provisioning review cycle at the reporting period end.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each recommendation holds balance, age, counterparty rating, collateral and the provision proposed.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Proposed provisions sum to the movement requested in the bad debt provision account.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Per-balance workings retained in Microsoft Excel with the review date and version.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Balances reviewed and not provided are logged with the rationale recorded.
generic.Test population: All aged and impaired recoverable balances in the provisioning review.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fails if a provision is booked without approval at the level set in the write-off matrix.
generic.Exception handling path: Balances in insolvency are provided at the estimated scheme dividend rather than written off.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: A recommendation is accepted when the collateralised portion is excluded from the provision.
generic.Evidence location: Provision recommendations and workings held against the counterparty records.

steps.title: Select impaired balances from the aged recoverable report
sop: Select aged balances with failed collection or counterparty impairment.
Include age, counterparty rating and any insolvency status.
Exclude balances already fully provided.
Done when the provisioning population is selected.
verify: Compare the selection to the aged and impaired balances.
Pass when every impaired aged balance is considered.

steps.title: Compute the provision per balance in Microsoft Excel
sop: Compute the provision per balance from age, rating and collateral held.
Show the inputs and the resulting percentage on each line.
Do not apply a blanket rate across dissimilar balances.
Done when a provision is computed for each selected balance.
verify: Recompute two provisions from the stated inputs.
Pass when the recomputations agree to the workings.

steps.title: Provide insolvency balances at the estimated scheme dividend
sop: Identify balances with counterparties in insolvency or scheme of arrangement.
Obtain the estimated scheme dividend for each such counterparty.
Provide the balance down to the estimated recoverable dividend.
Done when insolvency balances are provided at the scheme dividend.
verify: Compare the provided amounts to the estimated dividends.
Pass when every insolvency balance is provided to the scheme dividend.

steps.title: Exclude the collateralised portion from the provision
sop: Identify collateral held against each balance being provided.
Exclude the collateralised portion from the provision calculation.
Note the collateral type and value on the working.
Done when collateralised portions are excluded from every provision.
verify: Recompute a provision with collateral excluded.
Pass when the recomputation matches the working.

steps.title: Assemble the recommendation with supporting evidence
sop: Assemble the per-balance workings into a provision recommendation.
Attach chase history, rating evidence and collateral confirmation.
State the total provision movement requested.
Done when the recommendation and supporting evidence are assembled.
verify: Check the recommendation for attached supporting evidence.
Pass when every provided balance carries supporting evidence.

steps.title: Route the recommendation through the write-off approval matrix
sop: Compare the total provision to the write-off approval matrix thresholds.
Route the recommendation to the required approval level.
Withhold booking until the approval is recorded.
Done when the recommendation is routed and the approval is recorded.
verify: Compare the approval level obtained to the write-off matrix.
Pass when no provision is booked below its required approval level.

generic.Defined scope/population: Recoverable balances outstanding beyond the contractual settlement days agreed with each reinsurer.
generic.In-scope period: The collections review cycle at the extract date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Priority list holds balance, reinsurer, value rank, named owner and target date.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Balances beyond credit terms in the extract equal the items on the priority follow-up list.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Priority list retained in Microsoft Excel with its review date and version.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Balances deliberately left off the priority list are logged with the rationale.
generic.Test population: All recoverable balances outside the agreed credit terms at the review date.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fails if a priority item has no named owner or no target date.
generic.Exception handling path: Repeat late payers are flagged into the credit and security review for counterparty action.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: The review is accepted when balances are ranked by value across the population.
generic.Evidence location: Priority follow-up list held against the collections cycle in the reinsurance administration system.

steps.title: Extract balances beyond contractual settlement days
sop: Extract recoverable balances past the contractual settlement days.
Include reinsurer, treaty, statement and days outstanding.
Exclude balances already in formal dispute.
Done when the out-of-terms balance population is extracted.
verify: Recompute days outstanding on a sample of balances.
Pass when every sampled balance is genuinely outside credit terms.

steps.title: Rank the population by value in Microsoft Excel
sop: Load the out-of-terms population into the collections workbook.
Rank the balances by value outstanding.
Show the cumulative share of the total for the top balances.
Done when the population is ranked by value.
verify: Check the ranking against the balance values.
Pass when the ranking follows outstanding value order.

steps.title: Identify repeat late payers across treaty years
sop: Compare current late balances against payment history by reinsurer.
Look across treaty years rather than only the current balances.
Mark reinsurers with a repeated pattern of late settlement.
Done when repeat late payers are identified for the cycle.
verify: Re-test a sample of marked reinsurers against payment history.
Pass when the sampled reinsurers show a repeated late pattern.

steps.title: Agree the priority follow-up list with owners and target dates
sop: Select the priority balances from the value ranking and repeat payers.
Assign a named owner to each priority item.
Set a target date for the follow-up action.
Done when the priority follow-up list is agreed with owners and dates.
verify: Scan the priority list for blank owner or target date fields.
Pass when no priority item lacks an owner or a target date.

steps.title: Flag credit term breaches into the credit and security review
sop: Flag counterparties breaching credit terms into the credit review.
Attach the payment history evidence to each flag.
State the exposure at risk for each flagged counterparty.
Done when every credit term breach is flagged for credit review.
verify: Compare flags to the counterparties breaching credit terms.
Pass when every breaching counterparty carries a credit review flag.

steps.title: Publish the review on the BI reporting platform
sop: Publish the priority list and ranking on the BI reporting platform.
Version the publication with the review cycle date.
Log balances excluded from the priority list with the rationale.
Done when the collections review is published for the cycle.
verify: Open the published view for the current cycle.
Pass when the current cycle priority list is published with owners and dates.

generic.Defined scope/population: All open recoverable balances requiring an ageing refresh at the current period end.
generic.In-scope period: The current reporting period ending at the ledger period end date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each refreshed row holds due date, current balance, ageing bucket and the refresh date.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Refreshed totals equal the prior report plus movements in the period.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Refreshed ageing retained in Microsoft Excel with its refresh date and version.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Balances failing to refresh are logged with the source issue and a named owner.
generic.Test population: All open recoverable balances at the refresh date.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fails if the ageing report does not show a refresh date in the current period.
generic.Exception handling path: Source data mismatches are cleared with the ledger team before publication.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: A refresh is accepted when cash applied since the previous run is removed from open balances.
generic.Evidence location: Refreshed recoverable ageing report on the BI reporting platform.

steps.title: Refresh source balances from the reinsurance administration system
sop: Extract open recoverable balances as at the current period end.
Include billing date, contractual due date and current balance.
Record the extract date as the refresh date.
Done when the source balance extract is refreshed for the period.
verify: Compare the extract date to the current period end.
Pass when the extract is taken at the current period end.

steps.title: Remove cash applied since the previous run
sop: Identify cash applied against balances since the previous refresh.
Reduce or close the affected open balances accordingly.
Confirm fully settled balances drop out of the ageing.
Done when applied cash is removed from the open balances.
verify: Compare applied cash in the period to the reduction in open balances.
Pass when the reduction equals the cash applied.

steps.title: Add new billings and cash calls with due dates
sop: Add billings and cash calls issued since the previous refresh.
Set the contractual due date on each new item.
Confirm the new items carry a treaty and statement reference.
Done when new billings and calls are added with due dates.
verify: Query new items for a populated contractual due date.
Pass when no new item lacks a due date.

steps.title: Recalculate ageing buckets in Microsoft Excel
sop: Recalculate days outstanding from the contractual due dates.
Reassign each balance to its current ageing bucket.
Highlight balances that moved into a worse bucket this period.
Done when every open balance carries a refreshed ageing bucket.
verify: Recompute the bucket for a sample of balances.
Pass when the sampled buckets agree to the recomputation.

steps.title: Reconcile the refreshed totals to the prior report plus movements
sop: Take the prior report total and add new billings less cash applied.
Compare the result to the refreshed report total.
Investigate and clear any difference before publication.
Done when the refreshed totals reconcile to prior plus movements.
verify: Inspect the reconciliation for residual differences.
Pass when the refreshed total equals prior plus movements.

steps.title: Publish the refreshed ageing on the BI reporting platform
sop: Publish the refreshed ageing on the BI reporting platform.
Stamp the publication with the refresh date and period.
Log balances that failed to refresh with the source issue and owner.
Done when the refreshed ageing is published for the period.
verify: Open the published ageing and check the refresh date.
Pass when the published refresh date falls in the current period.

generic.Defined scope/population: Executed commutation agreements and the contract records of the treaties they commute.
generic.In-scope period: Commutations executed since the previous archive run.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Treaty record holds commuted status, the commutation effective date and the agreement link.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Executed commutations equal treaties set to commuted plus logged exceptions.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Executed agreement filed with its effective date and document version.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Treaties that cannot be closed are logged with the blocking balance and an owner.
generic.Test population: All treaties commuted in the archive run.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fails if a new cession posts to a treaty flagged as commuted.
generic.Exception handling path: Open ceded balances block closure until they are cleared by the accounting step.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Archiving is accepted when retention and legal hold classification is applied to the file.
generic.Evidence location: Commutation agreement in the contract lifecycle management repository linked to the treaty record.

steps.title: File the executed agreement in the contract lifecycle management repository
sop: Upload the fully executed commutation agreement to the contract repository.
Record the commutation effective date on the document record.
Link the document to the treaty record it commutes.
Done when the executed agreement is filed and linked to the treaty.
verify: Open the treaty record and follow the agreement link.
Pass when the link resolves to the executed agreement with its effective date.

steps.title: Set the treaty status to commuted in the reinsurance administration system
sop: Open the treaty record in the reinsurance administration system.
Set the status to commuted with the effective date.
Confirm the treaty drops out of active cession processing.
Done when the treaty status is set to commuted.
verify: Attempt a test cession posting against the commuted treaty.
Pass when the system blocks new cessions on the commuted treaty.

steps.title: Apply retention and legal hold classification in the document repository
sop: Apply the retention class required for commutation files.
Apply any legal hold where related disputes remain open.
Record the classification applied on the document record.
Done when retention and hold classification are applied to the file.
verify: Check the document record for the classification fields.
Pass when both retention class and hold status are recorded.

steps.title: Link the commutation record to the closed ceded balances
sop: Identify the ceded balances closed under the commutation.
Link those balances to the commutation record.
Confirm the closed balances show nil outstanding.
Done when closed ceded balances are linked to the commutation record.
verify: Open the commutation record and inspect the linked balances.
Pass when every linked balance shows a nil outstanding position.

steps.title: Verify no residual open items remain on the treaty
sop: Query the treaty for open recoverables, billings or cash calls.
Investigate any residual open item found.
Log treaties that cannot be closed with the blocking balance.
Done when residual open items are cleared or logged.
verify: Re-run the open item query on the commuted treaty.
Pass when no residual open item remains unlogged.

steps.title: Close the contract record in the treaty register
sop: Close the contract record in the treaty register.
Record the closure date and the commutation reference.
Confirm the treaty no longer appears in active treaty listings.
Done when the treaty contract record is closed.
verify: Query the active treaty listing for the commuted treaty.
Pass when the commuted treaty no longer appears as active.

generic.Defined scope/population: Ceded loss data for the candidate treaty being proposed for commutation.
generic.In-scope period: The full treaty term covered by the commutation proposal.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Pack holds paid to date, case outstanding and IBNR by accident year for the treaty.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Data pack totals reconcile to the ceded balance in the reinsurance administration system.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Data pack retained in Microsoft Excel with its extract date and version.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Data gaps in early accident years are logged with the estimation approach used.
generic.Test population: All ceded losses on the candidate treaty across its full term.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fails if pack totals do not reconcile to the ceded balance before release.
generic.Exception handling path: Unreconciled differences are investigated before the pack is shared with the counterparty.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: The pack is accepted when loss development history covers the full treaty term.
generic.Evidence location: Commutation data pack stored against the treaty in the reinsurance administration system.

steps.title: Extract ceded losses by accident year from the reinsurance administration system
sop: Extract paid to date, case outstanding and IBNR for the treaty.
Split the extract by accident year across the treaty term.
Record the extract date on the pack.
Done when the ceded loss extract by accident year is produced.
verify: Compare the extract total to the treaty ceded balance.
Pass when the extract agrees to the treaty ceded balance.

steps.title: Produce the claim-level listing for the largest open losses
sop: Rank open losses on the treaty by ceded outstanding.
List the largest open losses at claim level with status and reserve.
Include the coverage position where a dispute is open.
Done when the claim-level listing for the largest open losses is produced.
verify: Compare the listing to the ranked open loss population.
Pass when the listing covers the largest open losses by value.

steps.title: Compile the loss development history in Microsoft Excel
sop: Compile paid and incurred development triangles for the treaty.
Cover the full treaty term rather than recent years only.
Note any change in reserving basis over the period.
Done when loss development history is compiled for the full term.
verify: Check the triangles cover every year of the treaty term.
Pass when no year of the treaty term is missing from the history.

steps.title: Attach supporting claim documents from the claim file repository
sop: Retrieve key claim documents for the largest open losses.
Attach adjuster reports and coverage positions to the pack.
Check documents against the access-to-records clause before inclusion.
Done when supporting documents are attached to the pack.
verify: Compare attached documents to the access-to-records clause scope.
Pass when no document outside the clause scope is included.

steps.title: Reconcile pack totals to the ceded balance
sop: Total paid, outstanding and IBNR across the pack.
Compare the totals to the ceded balance in the reinsurance system.
Investigate and clear differences before release.
Done when the pack totals reconcile to the ceded balance.
verify: Inspect the reconciliation for unexplained differences.
Pass when the pack totals equal the ceded balance.

steps.title: Store the completed data pack against the treaty
sop: Store the completed pack against the treaty in the reinsurance system.
Version the pack with its extract date.
Log data gaps with the estimation approach used.
Done when the completed data pack is stored against the treaty.
verify: Open the treaty record and locate the stored pack.
Pass when the stored pack carries its extract date and reconciliation.

generic.Defined scope/population: Ceded recoverable and payable balances on the treaty being closed under an executed commutation.
generic.In-scope period: The ledger period in which the commutation settlement is recognised.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Closure entry holds treaty, carrying value, settlement consideration and the gain or loss.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Closing ceded position on the commuted treaty is nil after the entries post.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Closure workings retained in the close file with the posting date and version.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Residual balances that cannot be cleared are logged with the reason and an owner.
generic.Test population: All ceded balances on the commuted treaty at the closure date.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fails if any residual ceded recoverable remains open on the commuted treaty.
generic.Exception handling path: Unclearable residuals are escalated before the treaty is flagged as fully closed.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Closure is accepted when it agrees to the commutation agreement amount.
generic.Evidence location: Closure entries in the ERP general ledger evidenced in the period close file.

steps.title: List open ceded balances on the commuted treaty
sop: Extract all open ceded recoverable and payable balances on the treaty.
Include billed, unbilled and disputed components.
Total the carrying value at the closure date.
Done when the open ceded balance position is listed.
verify: Compare the listed total to the treaty ceded balance.
Pass when the listed total equals the treaty ceded balance.

steps.title: Derecognise the outstanding recoverable in the reinsurance administration system
sop: Derecognise the outstanding ceded recoverable to nil for the treaty.
Reference the commutation agreement on each derecognition entry.
Post entries in the ledger period the commutation is recognised.
Done when the ceded recoverable on the treaty is derecognised to nil.
verify: Re-query the treaty ceded recoverable after posting.
Pass when the treaty ceded recoverable shows nil.

steps.title: Post the commutation gain or loss in the ERP general ledger
sop: Compute the difference between settlement consideration and carrying value.
Post the difference to the commutation gain or loss account.
Reference the treaty and agreement in the journal narrative.
Done when the gain or loss is posted for the commutation.
verify: Recompute the gain or loss from consideration less carrying value.
Pass when the recomputation agrees to the posted amount.

steps.title: Block future cessions on the treaty
sop: Set the cession block on the treaty in the reinsurance system.
Confirm no new ceded transactions can post to the treaty.
Notify the ceding process owners of the block.
Done when future cessions are blocked on the commuted treaty.
verify: Attempt a test cession posting against the treaty.
Pass when the system rejects the cession.

steps.title: Agree the closure to the commutation agreement amount
sop: Compare the closure entries to the commutation agreement amount.
Confirm currency and effective date match the agreement.
Record the agreement reference in the close file.
Done when the closure agrees to the commutation agreement amount.
verify: Compare the posted settlement to the agreement amount.
Pass when the posted settlement equals the agreement amount.

steps.title: Evidence the closure in the ceded accounting platform close file
sop: File the closure workings in the period close file.
Attach the derecognition and gain or loss postings.
Log any residual balance that could not be cleared with an owner.
Done when the closure is evidenced in the close file.
verify: Re-query the treaty for residual ceded balances.
Pass when no residual ceded recoverable remains open or unlogged.

generic.Defined scope/population: Shortlisted run-off treaties where a commutation approach to the counterparty is to be opened.
generic.In-scope period: The negotiation window agreed in the commutation timetable.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Negotiation log holds counterparty contact, scope of years, target timetable and owner.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Negotiations opened equal shortlisted treaties less those deferred with a logged reason.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Opening correspondence retained against the treaty with its send date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Counterparties declining to engage are logged with their position and the review date.
generic.Test population: All shortlisted run-off treaties approached in the cycle.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fails if a negotiation is opened without a target timetable and a named owner.
generic.Exception handling path: Counterparties with no run-off contact are approached through the placing broker.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: An approach is accepted when it states the confidential and without-prejudice basis.
generic.Evidence location: Commutation negotiation log held against the treaty in the reinsurance administration system.

steps.title: Confirm the shortlist and scope from the treaty repository
sop: Take the ranked commutation candidate shortlist.
Confirm the treaty years and liabilities in scope for each candidate.
Read the treaty for any restriction on commutation.
Done when the negotiation scope is confirmed for each shortlisted treaty.
verify: Compare the confirmed scope to the candidate shortlist.
Pass when every shortlisted treaty carries a confirmed scope.

steps.title: Identify the run-off or commutation contact
sop: Identify the named run-off or commutation contact at the reinsurer.
Where no direct contact exists identify the broker route instead.
Record the contact and route against the treaty.
Done when a contact route is identified for every candidate.
verify: Query candidates for a recorded contact or broker route.
Pass when no candidate lacks a contact route.

steps.title: Draft the opening approach on a without-prejudice basis
sop: Draft the opening approach for each counterparty.
State the confidential and without-prejudice basis in the text.
State the treaty years and liabilities in play.
Done when the opening approach is drafted for each counterparty.
verify: Read each draft for the confidentiality and without-prejudice statement.
Pass when no draft omits either statement.

steps.title: Issue the approach from Microsoft Teams / Email
sop: Send the approach to the identified contact or the broker.
Request confirmation of willingness to discuss a commutation.
Set a response date for the counterparty.
Done when the approach is issued for every candidate.
verify: Match issued approaches to the candidate shortlist.
Pass when every candidate approached has an issued approach.

steps.title: Log the negotiation with timetable and owner
sop: Open a negotiation log entry against the treaty.
Record the counterparty contact, scope and target timetable.
Assign a named owner to the negotiation.
Done when every opened negotiation is logged with timetable and owner.
verify: Query negotiation entries for a timetable and owner.
Pass when no open negotiation lacks a timetable or an owner.

steps.title: Record counterparty responses against the treaty
sop: Record each counterparty response on the negotiation log.
Log declines with the stated position and a review date.
Move willing counterparties into the valuation and terms workflow.
Done when every approach has a recorded response or a logged decline.
verify: Compare approaches issued to responses logged.
Pass when every approach carries a response or a logged decline.

generic.Defined scope/population: Future ceded liabilities on the commutation candidate treaty requiring a present value estimate.
generic.In-scope period: The projected run-off period until the ceded liabilities are fully settled.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Estimate holds ultimate liability, payment pattern, discount rate and the sensitivity range.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Undiscounted projected cash flows sum to the projected ultimate ceded liability.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Valuation workbook retained in Microsoft Excel with assumptions and its valuation date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Assumptions without a documented source are logged and replaced before use.
generic.Test population: All open and IBNR ceded liabilities on the candidate treaty.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fails if the discount rate has no documented source on the valuation.
generic.Exception handling path: Unstable development factors trigger a wider sensitivity range rather than a single point.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: An estimate is accepted when a sensitivity range is produced, not a single point value.
generic.Evidence location: Present value estimate stored against the treaty in the reinsurance administration system.

steps.title: Project the ultimate ceded liability in Microsoft Excel
sop: Take the ceded development history for the treaty business.
Apply loss development factors to project the ultimate ceded liability.
Record the factors used and their derivation.
Done when the ultimate ceded liability is projected for the treaty.
verify: Recompute the projection on one accident year.
Pass when the recomputation agrees to the workbook.

steps.title: Apply a payment pattern to build dated cash flows
sop: Select a payment pattern appropriate to the treaty business.
Spread the projected ultimate into dated future cash flows.
Check the cash flows sum back to the projected ultimate.
Done when dated future cash flows are built from the ultimate.
verify: Sum the undiscounted cash flows.
Pass when the cash flows sum to the projected ultimate.

steps.title: Document the discount rate and its source
sop: Select the discount rate for the valuation.
Document the source of the rate and the date taken.
Apply the rate consistently across all projected cash flows.
Done when the discount rate is documented and applied.
verify: Check the valuation for a documented rate source.
Pass when the discount rate carries a documented source and date.

steps.title: Compute the present value of the cash flows
sop: Discount each dated cash flow at the documented rate.
Sum the discounted cash flows to give the present value.
Record the valuation date on the result.
Done when the present value of future ceded liabilities is computed.
verify: Recompute the discounting on a sample of cash flows.
Pass when the recomputation agrees to the workbook present value.

steps.title: Run sensitivities on the key assumptions
sop: Flex the development factors, payment pattern and discount rate in turn.
Compute the present value under each flexed assumption.
Present the results as a negotiating range.
Done when a sensitivity range is produced for the estimate.
verify: Check the output for a range rather than a single point.
Pass when the estimate is presented as a range with stated flexes.

steps.title: Store the estimate and publish to the BI reporting platform
sop: Store the valuation workbook against the treaty in the reinsurance system.
Publish the estimate and range to the BI reporting platform.
Log any assumption without a documented source for replacement.
Done when the estimate is stored and published with its assumptions.
verify: Open the stored estimate and check the assumption documentation.
Pass when every key assumption on the stored estimate has a documented source.

generic.Defined scope/population: The commutation opportunity on a candidate treaty including liability value and counterparty position.
generic.In-scope period: The evaluation cycle preceding the commutation negotiation.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Evaluation holds discounted liability, collectability view, capital relief and admin saving.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Evaluation inputs agree to the present value estimate and the ceded balance for the treaty.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Evaluation workbook retained in Microsoft Excel with its date and assumption set.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Inputs that cannot be quantified are logged with the qualitative judgement applied.
generic.Test population: All candidate treaties evaluated in the cycle.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fails if an evaluation is completed without a documented walk-away price.
generic.Exception handling path: Evaluations lacking a reliable liability estimate are deferred rather than negotiated.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: An evaluation is accepted when target and walk-away prices are documented before negotiation.
generic.Evidence location: Commutation evaluation stored against the treaty in the reinsurance administration system.

steps.title: Load the discounted liability estimate for the treaty
sop: Take the present value estimate produced for the candidate treaty.
Confirm the valuation date and the assumption set used.
Record the range alongside the central estimate.
Done when the discounted liability estimate is loaded for evaluation.
verify: Compare the loaded estimate to the stored valuation.
Pass when the loaded estimate matches the stored valuation.

steps.title: Assess expected collectability from the counterparty
sop: Review the counterparty rating, payment history and any collateral held.
Estimate the proportion of the liability likely to be collected in full.
State the basis for the collectability view.
Done when expected collectability is assessed for the counterparty.
verify: Check the collectability view against the counterparty evidence.
Pass when the view is supported by rating and payment history evidence.

steps.title: Quantify capital and credit risk charge relief
sop: Estimate the capital charge attributable to the counterparty exposure.
Quantify the relief from removing the exposure through commutation.
Record the method used for the quantification.
Done when capital and credit risk relief is quantified.
verify: Recompute the relief from the stated exposure and charge rate.
Pass when the recomputation agrees to the evaluation.

steps.title: Include the administrative run-off cost saving
sop: Estimate the annual administrative cost of running the treaty off.
Project the saving over the expected remaining run-off period.
Include the saving in the evaluation total.
Done when the administrative saving is included in the evaluation.
verify: Check the evaluation for an administrative saving line.
Pass when the saving is quantified and included.

steps.title: Derive target and walk-away prices
sop: Combine the liability value, collectability, capital relief and admin saving.
Derive a target price for the commutation.
Derive a walk-away price beyond which commutation is not worthwhile.
Done when target and walk-away prices are derived.
verify: Recompute the target price from the evaluation inputs.
Pass when the recomputation agrees to the documented target price.

steps.title: Document the recommendation and publish to the BI reporting platform
sop: Document the recommendation with the target and walk-away prices.
Store the evaluation against the treaty in the reinsurance system.
Publish the summary to the BI reporting platform for management review.
Done when the evaluation and prices are documented and published.
verify: Open the stored evaluation and check for both prices.
Pass when target and walk-away prices are both documented.

generic.Defined scope/population: The negotiated commutation agreement for the treaty awaiting execution by both parties.
generic.In-scope period: The execution window between term sheet agreement and the settlement date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Agreement holds settlement amount, currency, payment date and the release scope.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Settlement amount, currency and payment date match the agreed term sheet.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Countersigned executed copy stored in the contract repository with its effective date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Signature blocks failing the authority check are logged and re-routed before execution.
generic.Test population: All commutation agreements presented for execution.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fails if a commutation is executed without a full and final release clause.
generic.Exception handling path: Wording differences from the term sheet are referred back to Legal Counsel before signature.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Execution is accepted when both signatories are verified within their delegated authority.
generic.Evidence location: Executed commutation agreement in the contract lifecycle management repository.

steps.title: Check the release wording with Legal Counsel
sop: Read the release clause in the final agreement text.
Confirm it releases all past and future obligations under the treaty.
Flag any carve-out that narrows the release.
Done when the full and final release wording is confirmed.
verify: Compare the release clause to the agreed release scope.
Pass when the clause gives a full and final release with no unagreed carve-out.

steps.title: Reconcile commercial terms to the agreed term sheet
sop: Compare settlement amount, currency and payment date to the term sheet.
Flag any difference for correction before execution.
Record the reconciliation on the execution file.
Done when the agreement terms reconcile to the term sheet.
verify: Re-compare the agreement terms to the term sheet.
Pass when amount, currency and payment date all match.

steps.title: Verify signatory authority on both sides
sop: Check the internal signatory against the delegated authority schedule.
Confirm the counterparty signatory is authorised to bind the reinsurer.
Log and re-route any signature block failing the check.
Done when both signatories are verified as within authority.
verify: Compare the signatories to the authority evidence held.
Pass when both signatories are evidenced as within their authority.

steps.title: Circulate the agreement for signature through DocuSign
sop: Load the final agreement into DocuSign for signature.
Address the envelope to the verified signatories on both sides.
Set the completion deadline ahead of the settlement date.
Done when the agreement is circulated for signature.
verify: Check the DocuSign envelope recipients against the verified signatories.
Pass when the envelope is addressed only to verified signatories.

steps.title: Obtain the countersigned executed copy
sop: Monitor DocuSign for completion by both parties.
Chase outstanding signatures ahead of the settlement date.
Download the completed executed agreement with its certificate.
Done when the countersigned executed copy is obtained.
verify: Check the executed copy for both signatures and the completion certificate.
Pass when the copy is signed by both parties with a certificate.

steps.title: Store the executed agreement in the contract repository
sop: Store the executed agreement in the contract lifecycle management repository.
Record the effective date and the settlement date on the record.
Link the agreement to the treaty in the reinsurance administration system.
Done when the executed agreement is stored and linked to the treaty.
verify: Open the treaty record and follow the agreement link.
Pass when the link resolves to the executed agreement with its effective date.

generic.Defined scope/population: Commercial commutation terms under negotiation with the reinsurer for the candidate treaty.
generic.In-scope period: The negotiation window until the term sheet is confirmed by both sides.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Term sheet holds lump sum, release scope, payment timing and any late payment interest.
