generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Agreed lump sum is documented against the internal valuation range.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Term sheet retained with the confirmation correspondence and its confirmation date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Terms outside the walk-away price are logged with the escalation taken.
generic.Test population: All commutation negotiations reaching terms in the cycle.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fails if a term sheet proceeds to drafting without both sides confirming.
generic.Exception handling path: Offers beyond the walk-away price are escalated rather than accepted at the desk.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Terms are accepted when the release scope names the years and liabilities covered.
generic.Evidence location: Agreed commutation term sheet stored against the treaty in the treaty repository.

steps.title: Set the negotiating range from the evaluation
sop: Take the target and walk-away prices from the commutation evaluation.
Set the opening position and the concession steps.
Record the range on the negotiation file.
Done when the negotiating range is set for the discussion.
verify: Compare the recorded range to the evaluation prices.
Pass when the range matches the documented target and walk-away prices.

steps.title: Negotiate the lump sum with the reinsurer
sop: Conduct the negotiation by Microsoft Teams / Email or in meeting.
Document each position exchanged and the date.
Stop at the walk-away price and escalate rather than concede beyond it.
Done when a lump sum is agreed or the negotiation is escalated.
verify: Compare the agreed lump sum to the walk-away price.
Pass when the agreed sum sits inside the documented range or shows an escalation.

steps.title: Agree the scope of release explicitly
sop: Agree whether the release covers all years or named years only.
Confirm treatment of ECO and XPL exposures and unknown claims.
Record the agreed scope in unambiguous terms.
Done when the release scope is agreed explicitly.
verify: Read the agreed scope for named years and liability types.
Pass when the scope names the years and liability types covered.

steps.title: Agree payment timing and late payment interest
sop: Agree the settlement payment date and the currency.
Agree any late payment interest rate and its trigger.
Record both in the draft term sheet.
Done when payment timing and interest terms are agreed.
verify: Read the draft term sheet for payment date and interest terms.
Pass when both are stated in the term sheet.

steps.title: Document the agreed sum against the valuation range in Microsoft Excel
sop: Record the agreed lump sum against the internal valuation range.
Show where the sum sits relative to target and walk-away.
Note the reasons for any position taken outside the target.
Done when the agreed sum is documented against the valuation range.
verify: Compare the documented position to the valuation range.
Pass when the agreed sum is shown relative to target and walk-away.

steps.title: Circulate the term sheet for confirmation by both sides
sop: Circulate the term sheet to the counterparty for written confirmation.
Store the confirmed term sheet against the treaty in the treaty repository.
Release to legal drafting only after both sides confirm.
Done when the term sheet is confirmed by both sides and stored.
verify: Check the stored term sheet for confirmation from both sides.
Pass when both confirmations are held before drafting begins.

generic.Defined scope/population: Expired ceded treaties still carrying outstanding balances that could be candidates for commutation.
generic.In-scope period: The candidate review cycle at the current reporting date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each candidate holds treaty, counterparty, outstanding balance, age and the counterparty rating.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Candidate outstanding balances agree to the ceded balances in the reinsurance system.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Candidate list retained in Microsoft Excel with its review date and version.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Treaties excluded from the shortlist are logged with the exclusion reason.
generic.Test population: All expired treaties with ceded outstanding balances at the review date.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fails if the candidate list is produced without indicative ceded balances.
generic.Exception handling path: Treaties barred from commutation by their wording are excluded with the clause noted.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: The list is accepted when candidates are ranked by age, admin cost and counterparty rating.
generic.Evidence location: Ranked commutation candidate list stored in the reinsurance administration system.

steps.title: Filter expired treaties with outstanding balances
sop: Extract the treaty inventory from the reinsurance administration system.
Filter to expired treaties still carrying ceded outstanding balances.
Include the outstanding balance and the expiry date on each row.
Done when the expired treaty population with balances is extracted.
verify: Compare the extract total to the ceded outstanding balance for expired treaties.
Pass when the extract agrees to the ceded outstanding balance.

steps.title: Add the age of outstanding and administration cost
sop: Calculate the age of the outstanding balance from the treaty expiry.
Estimate the annual administration cost of running each treaty off.
Add both measures to the candidate workbook.
Done when age and administration cost are added to each candidate.
verify: Recompute the age on a sample of candidates.
Pass when the sampled ages agree to the workbook.

steps.title: Add counterparty ratings and impairment status
sop: Add the current counterparty rating for each candidate treaty.
Mark counterparties that are downgraded, impaired or in run-off.
Record the date each rating was checked.
Done when ratings and impairment status are added to the candidates.
verify: Query candidates for a dated counterparty rating.
Pass when no candidate lacks a dated rating.

steps.title: Check the treaty repository for commutation restrictions
sop: Read the wording for restrictions on commutation or assignment.
Exclude treaties barred from commutation and note the clause.
Flag treaties requiring third party consent to commute.
Done when commutation restrictions are checked for each candidate.
verify: Compare exclusions to the clauses cited.
Pass when every exclusion cites the restricting clause.

steps.title: Rank the candidates in Microsoft Excel
sop: Rank candidates by age of outstanding, administration cost and rating.
Prioritise impaired and downgraded counterparties in the shortlist.
Show the indicative ceded balance against each ranked candidate.
Done when the candidates are ranked with indicative balances.
verify: Check the ranking against the three ranking measures.
Pass when the ranking reflects age, cost and counterparty rating.

steps.title: Present the candidate list for management review
sop: Store the ranked candidate list in the reinsurance administration system.
Circulate the list with indicative balances for management review.
Log treaties excluded from the shortlist with the reason.
Done when the ranked candidate list is presented for review.
verify: Open the stored list and check for indicative balances.
Pass when every ranked candidate carries an indicative ceded balance.

generic.Defined scope/population: Commutations whose settlement value exceeds the delegated authority threshold for the desk.
generic.In-scope period: The approval window between term sheet confirmation and agreement execution.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Approval paper holds carrying value, proposed settlement, P and L impact and materiality test.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: P and L impact in the paper equals settlement consideration less carrying value.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Approval minute or e-signature retained with its date before execution.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Approvals refused or deferred are logged with the reason and the next step.
generic.Test population: All material commutations submitted for approval in the cycle.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fails if a material commutation proceeds without a documented approval.
generic.Exception handling path: Papers missing actuarial or finance views are returned before submission.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: An approval is accepted when it is obtained at the level set by the materiality test.
generic.Evidence location: Approval papers and minutes held in the document management repository.

steps.title: Prepare the approval paper in the document management repository
sop: State the carrying value of the ceded balances being commuted.
State the proposed settlement amount and the resulting P and L impact.
Summarise the commercial rationale for the commutation.
Done when the approval paper is drafted with the three figures.
verify: Recompute the P and L impact from carrying value and settlement.
Pass when the recomputation agrees to the paper.

steps.title: Apply the materiality test to set the approval level
sop: Compare the settlement and P and L impact to the delegated authority thresholds.
Determine the approval level required for the commutation.
Record the materiality test result on the paper.
Done when the required approval level is determined and recorded.
verify: Compare the determined level to the authority thresholds.
Pass when the level matches the threshold applicable to the amount.

steps.title: Include the actuarial and finance views
sop: Obtain the finance view on the accounting and P and L treatment.
Obtain the actuarial view on the liability estimate underpinning the price.
Include both views in the paper before submission.
Done when actuarial and finance views are included in the paper.
verify: Check the paper for both views.
Pass when neither view is missing from the submitted paper.

steps.title: Submit the paper for approval by Microsoft Teams / Email
sop: Submit the paper to the approval body at the required level.
State the decision date needed to meet the execution timetable.
Circulate supporting valuation and evaluation documents.
Done when the paper is submitted to the correct approval body.
verify: Compare the recipient body to the required approval level.
Pass when the paper was submitted at the required level.

steps.title: Capture the approval minute or e-signature
sop: Capture the approval minute or e-signature with its date.
Record any conditions attached to the approval.
Log refusals or deferrals with the reason and next step.
Done when the approval decision is captured with its date.
verify: Check the approval record for a date and the approver.
Pass when the approval carries both a date and a named approver.

steps.title: Gate execution on the recorded approval
sop: Link the approval record to the commutation in the reinsurance system.
Release the agreement to execution only after the approval is recorded.
Hold commutations without approval out of the execution queue.
Done when execution is gated on the recorded approval.
verify: Check executed commutations for a prior approval record.
Pass when no material commutation was executed before its approval date.

generic.Defined scope/population: Commutation settlement funds received against executed commutation agreements.
generic.In-scope period: The ledger period in which the settlement funds are received.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Posting holds treaty, agreement reference, amount, currency and the bank credit reference.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Funds received agree to the commutation agreement amount and currency.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Bank credit advice retained with the posted journal and its posting date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Short or late settlements are logged with the difference and the recovery action.
generic.Test population: All commutation settlement receipts in the period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fails if a settlement receipt is posted without agreement to the executed agreement amount.
generic.Exception handling path: Differences to the agreement amount are escalated before the receipt is cleared.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: A posting is accepted when the difference to carrying value goes to commutation gain or loss.
generic.Evidence location: Posted settlement journals in the ERP general ledger cross-referenced to the bank credit.

steps.title: Confirm funds received against the executed agreement
sop: Match the bank credit to the executed commutation agreement.
Confirm the amount and currency agree to the agreement.
Log any shortfall or late payment with the recovery action.
Done when funds received are confirmed against the agreement.
verify: Compare the credited amount to the agreement amount.
Pass when the credited amount and currency match the agreement.

steps.title: Post the receipt against the commuted treaty in the reinsurance system
sop: Post the receipt against the commuted treaty recoverable balance.
Clear the recoverable balance to the extent of the receipt.
Reference the commutation agreement on the posting.
Done when the receipt is posted against the commuted treaty.
verify: Re-query the treaty recoverable after posting.
Pass when the recoverable is cleared to the extent of the receipt.

steps.title: Compute and post the commutation gain or loss
sop: Compute the difference between the receipt and the carrying value.
Post the difference to the commutation gain or loss account.
Reference the treaty and agreement in the journal narrative.
Done when the gain or loss on commutation is posted.
verify: Recompute the gain or loss from receipt less carrying value.
Pass when the recomputation agrees to the posted amount.

steps.title: Update the ceded accounting platform balances
sop: Update the ceded accounting platform to reflect the settled balances.
Close statements settled by the commutation receipt.
Confirm the settled items drop out of the recoverable ageing.
Done when the ceded accounting balances reflect the settlement.
verify: Re-run the ageing for the commuted treaty.
Pass when no settled item remains in the ageing.

steps.title: Cross-reference the bank credit and the ledger posting
sop: Record the bank credit reference on the ledger journal.
Record the journal reference on the receipt in the reinsurance system.
File both references in the period close reconciliation.
Done when the bank credit and ledger posting are cross-referenced.
verify: Trace the journal back to the bank credit advice.
Pass when the journal and the bank credit reference each other.

steps.title: Include the settlement in the period close reconciliation
sop: Include the commutation settlement in the period close reconciliation.
Show the receipt, the carrying value released and the gain or loss.
Obtain reviewer sign-off on the reconciliation line.
Done when the settlement is reconciled in the period close.
verify: Inspect the close reconciliation for the commutation line.
Pass when the settlement line is present and signed off.

generic.Defined scope/population: Regulatory filings affected by the commutation including Schedule F and Solvency II templates.
generic.In-scope period: The regulatory reporting period in which the commutation takes effect.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Filing lines hold reinsurer, treaty, recoverable removed and the commutation effective date.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Filed figures reconcile to the post-commutation ledger balances.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Filed templates retained with the submission date and the filing version.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Templates not updated in the period are logged with the reason and the catch-up plan.
generic.Test population: All regulatory templates carrying the commuted reinsurer or programme.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fails if a filing shows a residual recoverable for the commuted reinsurer.
generic.Exception handling path: Late commutations after the reporting cut-off are disclosed as a subsequent event.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: A filing is accepted when the commutation is disclosed with its effective date and result.
generic.Evidence location: Filed statutory templates in the statutory reporting system with the disclosure notes.

steps.title: Identify affected filings for the commuted reinsurer
sop: List the regulatory templates carrying the commuted reinsurer or programme.
Include Schedule F lines and Solvency II reinsurance templates.
Note the reporting period each template covers.
Done when the affected filings are identified for the commutation.
verify: Compare the identified filings to the reinsurer exposure records.
Pass when every filing showing the reinsurer is on the list.

steps.title: Update the Schedule F reinsurer line in the statutory reporting system
sop: Open the Schedule F line for the commuted reinsurer.
Remove the commuted recoverable from the reinsurer line.
Record the commutation effective date against the change.
Done when the Schedule F reinsurer line is updated.
verify: Re-read the Schedule F line after the update.
Pass when no commuted recoverable remains on the reinsurer line.

steps.title: Refresh the Solvency II reinsurance templates
sop: Refresh the S.30 and S.31 templates for the commuted programme.
Remove the commuted counterparty exposure from the templates.
Confirm the programme structure reflects the post-commutation position.
Done when the Solvency II templates are refreshed.
verify: Compare the refreshed templates to the post-commutation programme.
Pass when the templates carry no commuted counterparty exposure.

steps.title: Disclose the commutation in the notes
sop: Draft the disclosure note stating the commutation and its effective date.
State the gain or loss recognised on the commutation.
Include the note in the filing pack.
Done when the commutation disclosure note is drafted and included.
verify: Read the note for the effective date and the gain or loss.
Pass when both are stated in the disclosure.

steps.title: Reconcile filed figures to post-commutation ledger balances
sop: Compare the filed recoverable figures to the ledger balances.
Investigate and clear differences before submission.
Record the reconciliation with the filing pack.
Done when the filed figures reconcile to the ledger.
verify: Inspect the reconciliation for residual differences.
Pass when the filed figures equal the post-commutation ledger balances.

steps.title: Submit the filing and publish the position to the BI reporting platform
sop: Submit the updated filings within the regulatory deadline.
Publish the post-commutation reinsurance position on the BI platform.
Log templates not updated in the period with a catch-up plan.
Done when the filings are submitted and the position published.
verify: Check the submitted filing for the commuted reinsurer.
Pass when the submitted filing shows no residual recoverable for that reinsurer.

generic.Defined scope/population: Factual and evidentiary material supporting the disputed recovery against the reinsurer.
generic.In-scope period: From first notification of the loss through to the reinsurer declinature.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Evidence index holds document type, date, source and its place in the chronology.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Indexed documents equal the documents identified in the claim and correspondence review.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Evidence pack retained with its index version and the assembly date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Documents that cannot be located are logged with the search performed and the outcome.
generic.Test population: All claim file and correspondence documents within the dispute scope.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fails if a document within the dispute scope is subject to routine deletion.
generic.Exception handling path: Gaps in the chronology are chased from claims and the broker before the pack is closed.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: The pack is accepted when the chronology runs from first notification to declinature.

steps.title: Apply a legal hold across the dispute scope

Apply a legal hold in the claim file repository across that scope.
Notify document owners that routine deletion is suspended.

steps.title: Build the chronology from notification to declinature

Cite the source document for each chronology entry.

steps.title: Index the claim file evidence

Record document type, date and source in the index.
Link each indexed document to its chronology entry.

Pass when every in-scope claim document appears in the index.

steps.title: Collate reinsurer and broker correspondence in date order
sop: Collect all correspondence with the reinsurer and the broker.
Order the correspondence by date.
Highlight the correspondence bearing on the declinature grounds.

Pass when the bundle is complete and in date order.

steps.title: Identify and chase gaps in the evidence
sop: Review the chronology for missing steps or documents.
Chase the missing items from claims or the broker.
Log documents that cannot be located with the search performed.
Done when evidence gaps are chased or logged.
verify: Compare the gap list to the chases issued.
Pass when every identified gap has a chase or a logged outcome.

steps.title: Store the indexed pack in the legal matter management system
sop: Store the indexed evidence pack and chronology on the dispute matter.
Version the pack with the assembly date.
Link the pack to the dispute record in the reinsurance system.
Done when the indexed pack is stored on the dispute matter.
verify: Open the matter and inspect the stored pack and chronology.
Pass when both the index and the chronology are held on the matter.

generic.Defined scope/population: Contractual documents and clauses relied on to support the disputed recovery.
generic.In-scope period: The treaty year and endorsements governing the disputed loss.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Case summary holds clause citations with text, the argument and the expected counter-argument.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Clauses cited in the summary all appear in the retrieved executed wording.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Wording and endorsements retained with the version and the retrieval date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Missing endorsements are logged with the search performed and the placement follow-up.
generic.Test population: All contractual documents for the treaty year under dispute.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fails if a clause is cited without the executed wording text supporting it.
generic.Exception handling path: Contract certainty gaps are referred to the broker for placement evidence.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: The case is accepted when expected reinsurer counter-arguments are summarised alongside.
generic.Evidence location: Contractual case summary held on the dispute matter in the legal matter management system.

steps.title: Retrieve the executed wording and endorsements from the treaty repository
sop: Retrieve the executed treaty wording for the relevant year.
Retrieve every endorsement attaching to that treaty year.
Record the version and retrieval date for each document.
Done when the wording and all endorsements are retrieved.
verify: Compare the retrieved endorsement list to the placement record.
Pass when no endorsement on the placement record is missing.

steps.title: Identify the clauses relied on
sop: Identify the clauses supporting the recovery position.
Include follow the fortunes or follow the settlements where relevant.
Include claims control, cooperation and any exclusion clauses in issue.
Done when the clauses relied on are identified.
verify: Check each identified clause appears in the executed wording.
Pass when every identified clause is present in the wording.

steps.title: Cite the clause text in the case summary
sop: Quote the operative clause text in the case summary.
Cite the document, clause number and page for each quotation.
Avoid paraphrasing the operative wording.
Done when every relied-on clause is cited with its text.
verify: Compare quoted text to the executed wording.
Pass when every quotation matches the wording exactly.

steps.title: Review placement documents for contract certainty gaps
sop: Review the slip, placement documents and broker representations.
Identify inconsistencies between slip and wording.
Refer contract certainty gaps to the broker for placement evidence.
Done when contract certainty gaps are identified and referred.
verify: Compare the slip terms to the executed wording.
Pass when every inconsistency found is documented and referred.

steps.title: Summarise the contractual argument
sop: Set out the contractual argument supporting the recovery.
Link each limb of the argument to a cited clause.
State the factual findings each limb depends on.
Done when the contractual argument is summarised with clause links.
verify: Check each argument limb for a linked clause citation.
Pass when no limb of the argument is unsupported by a clause.

steps.title: Set out the expected reinsurer counter-arguments
sop: Anticipate the counter-arguments the reinsurer is expected to raise.
Set out the company response to each counter-argument.
Store the case summary on the dispute matter in the legal system.
Done when counter-arguments and responses are documented and stored.
verify: Open the matter and read the stored case summary.
Pass when the summary holds both the argument and the counter-arguments.

generic.Defined scope/population: All open and newly identified reinsurance disputes across treaties and counterparties.
generic.In-scope period: Disputes raised or updated since the previous register review.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each entry holds dispute type, treaty, treaty year, counterparty and the disputed amount.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Disputed amounts on the register agree to disputed balances in the recoverable ageing.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Register retained in Microsoft Excel with its review date and version.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Disputes without a reliable exposure estimate are logged with the basis for the placeholder.
generic.Test population: All open disputes on the register at the review date.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fails if a register entry lacks a dispute type, counterparty or exposure.
generic.Exception handling path: Disputes above the materiality threshold are flagged for legal engagement.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Classification is accepted when each dispute is typed against the defined type list.
generic.Evidence location: Dispute register held in the reinsurance administration system and the legal matter system.

steps.title: Identify new and updated disputes
sop: Review disputed balances flagged in the recoverable ageing.
Identify disputes not yet on the register.
Identify existing entries whose position has changed.
Done when new and updated disputes are identified.
verify: Compare identified disputes to the disputed balances in the ageing.
Pass when every disputed balance maps to a register entry.

steps.title: Type each dispute against the defined type list
sop: Type each dispute as coverage, aggregation, late notice, allocation or quantum.
Use the primary ground where more than one applies.
Record the secondary ground in the notes.
Done when every dispute carries a type.
verify: Query the register for a populated dispute type.
Pass when no open dispute lacks a type.

steps.title: Record treaty, year, counterparty and amount
sop: Record the treaty, treaty year and counterparty on each entry.
Record the disputed amount from the ring-fenced balance.
Reference the originating claims on the entry.
Done when the four identifiers are recorded on every entry.
verify: Check entries for the four identifiers.
Pass when no entry is missing treaty, year, counterparty or amount.

steps.title: Assign estimated exposure and probability weighting
sop: Assign the estimated exposure for each dispute.
Assign a probability-weighted outcome based on the merits view.
State the basis for the weighting on the entry.
Done when exposure and probability weighting are assigned.
verify: Recompute the weighted exposure on a sample of disputes.
Pass when the sampled weighted exposures agree to the register.

steps.title: Flag material disputes for legal engagement
sop: Compare each dispute exposure to the materiality threshold.
Flag disputes above the threshold for legal engagement.
Open the matter in the legal matter management system for flagged disputes.
Done when material disputes are flagged for legal engagement.
verify: Compare flagged disputes to the materiality threshold.
Pass when every dispute above the threshold carries a legal flag.

steps.title: Reconcile the register to the disputed balances in the ageing
sop: Total the disputed amounts on the register.
Compare against disputed balances in the recoverable ageing.
Investigate and clear any difference before closing the review.
Done when the register reconciles to the disputed balances.
verify: Inspect the reconciliation for residual differences.
Pass when the register total equals the disputed balances in the ageing.

generic.Defined scope/population: The reinsurer stated coverage position on the disputed recoverable including every ground of denial.
generic.In-scope period: From the first reservation of rights through to the current reinsurer position.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each ground records the denial basis, the clause relied on and the date it was raised.

generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Grounds raised orally are logged with the date, participants and the follow-up in writing.

generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fails if the coverage position is summarised without recording each ground separately.
generic.Exception handling path: Ambiguous grounds are clarified with the reinsurer in writing before response drafting.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: The record is accepted when the date of first reservation of rights is captured.
generic.Evidence location: Coverage position record on the dispute matter in the legal matter management system.

steps.title: File the reinsurer letter verbatim to the dispute record
sop: Retrieve the declinature or reservation of rights letter.
File the letter verbatim to the dispute record in the claim file repository.
Record the date the letter was received.
Done when the reinsurer letter is filed verbatim with its receipt date.
verify: Compare the filed document to the received correspondence.
Pass when the filed document is the unaltered original.

steps.title: List each ground of denial separately
sop: Read the letter and separate out each ground of denial.
Record each ground as its own entry rather than a summary.
Note where a ground is stated only in general terms.
Done when every ground of denial is recorded separately.
verify: Compare the recorded grounds to the letter text.
Pass when every ground in the letter has its own entry.

steps.title: Record the clause the reinsurer relies on per ground
sop: Identify the clause the reinsurer cites for each ground.
Record the clause reference against that ground.
Note grounds where no clause is cited.
Done when each ground carries the clause relied on or a note of none.
verify: Check each ground for a clause reference or an explicit note.
Pass when no ground is left without a clause reference or note.

steps.title: Capture the date of first reservation of rights
sop: Identify the earliest reservation of rights on the dispute.
Record its date for limitation purposes.
Note the communication in which it was first raised.
Done when the first reservation of rights date is captured.
verify: Compare the captured date to the earliest correspondence.
Pass when the captured date matches the earliest reservation.

steps.title: Draft the provisional company response per ground
sop: Draft the provisional company response to each ground.
Reference the supporting contractual or factual point for each response.
Mark responses requiring counsel input before issue.
Done when a provisional response exists for every ground.
verify: Check each ground for a drafted provisional response.
Pass when no ground is left without a provisional response.

steps.title: Submit the position record for counsel review
sop: Review the recorded grounds and the provisional responses.
Confirm the record captures the reinsurer position accurately.
Store the reviewed record on the dispute matter in the legal system.
Done when the coverage position record is reviewed and stored.
verify: Open the matter and read the stored coverage position record.
Pass when every ground is recorded with its clause and response.

generic.Defined scope/population: Disputes flagged as material where internal and external counsel merits advice is required.
generic.In-scope period: The engagement window from legal flag to receipt of the merits assessment.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Engagement record holds firm, conflict check, engagement letter, budget and fee arrangement.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Matters instructed equal disputes flagged for legal engagement less those deferred.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Engagement letter and merits assessment retained with their dates on the matter.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Firms declining or conflicted are logged with the alternative panel firm instructed.
generic.Test population: All disputes flagged for legal engagement in the cycle.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fails if counsel is instructed from outside the approved panel.
generic.Exception handling path: Panel gaps are escalated for an off-panel approval before any instruction is issued.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Engagement is accepted when the merits assessment states an estimated recovery probability.
generic.Evidence location: Counsel engagement and merits assessment held on the matter in the legal matter management system.

steps.title: Select counsel from the approved panel
sop: Select external reinsurance counsel from the approved panel.
Match the firm expertise to the dispute type.
Escalate for approval where no panel firm is suitable.
Done when a panel firm is selected for the dispute.
verify: Compare the selected firm to the approved panel list.
Pass when the selected firm is on the approved panel or has an approval.

steps.title: Complete the conflict check
sop: Request a conflict check from the selected firm.
Confirm no conflict exists with the counterparty or the broker.
Record the conflict check outcome on the matter.
Done when the conflict check is completed and recorded.
verify: Check the matter for a recorded conflict check outcome.
Pass when no firm is instructed without a completed conflict check.

steps.title: Agree the engagement letter, budget and fee arrangement
sop: Agree the scope of instruction in the engagement letter.
Agree the budget and fee arrangement before work begins.
Record both on the matter in the legal matter management system.
Done when the engagement letter and budget are agreed.
verify: Check the matter for a signed engagement letter and agreed budget.
Pass when work started only after both were agreed.

steps.title: Provide the instruction pack from the claim file repository
sop: Assemble the wording, chronology and evidence pack for counsel.
Check documents against the confidentiality and privilege position.
Send the instruction pack to the instructed firm.
Done when the instruction pack is provided to counsel.
verify: Compare the pack contents to the instruction requirements.
Pass when the pack holds wording, chronology and evidence.

steps.title: Track the merits work against the agreed budget
sop: Track counsel time and fees against the agreed budget.
Query fees exceeding the budget before approval.
Record budget status on the matter.
Done when the merits work is tracked against the budget.
verify: Compare recorded fees to the agreed budget.
Pass when no fee above budget was approved without a query.

steps.title: Receive and file the written merits assessment
sop: Obtain the written merits assessment from counsel.
Confirm it states an estimated recovery probability.
File the assessment on the matter with its date.
Done when the written merits assessment is received and filed.
verify: Read the filed assessment for a stated recovery probability.
Pass when the assessment states an estimated recovery probability.

generic.Defined scope/population: Disputes where a negotiated or mediated resolution is to be attempted before arbitration.

Agree the internal settlement authority range before any approach.

sop: Send the approach to the counterparty and copy the broker.
Keep any figure within the agreed internal settlement authority.
Record the send date on the matter.
Done when the settlement approach is issued to the counterparty.
verify: Compare any figure issued to the internal settlement authority.
Pass when no figure was issued outside the agreed authority.

steps.title: Propose mediation or a senior executive meeting
sop: Read the dispute clause for a mediation or executive meeting step.
Propose the step with candidate dates to the counterparty.
Record the proposal and any counterparty response.
Done when a mediation or executive meeting is proposed with dates.
verify: Compare the proposed step to the dispute clause requirements.
Pass when the proposed step is the one the clause provides for.

sop: Log each position put and each counterparty response with dates.
Attach the underlying correspondence to each log entry.
Note where a response moves beyond the settlement authority.
Done when all positions and responses are logged on the dispute record.
verify: Compare the log entries to the correspondence exchanged.
Pass when every exchanged position appears on the log.

steps.title: Decide whether to settle or escalate to arbitration
sop: Compare the counterparty best position to the settlement authority.
Settle within authority or escalate for revised authority.
Route failed negotiations to the arbitration proceedings workflow.
Done when a settle or escalate decision is recorded for the dispute.
verify: Check the matter for a recorded settle or escalate decision.
Pass when every negotiated dispute carries a recorded decision.

generic.Defined scope/population: Reinsurance recoverables contested by the reinsurer and requiring reclassification as disputed.

Identify the specific balance and amount being contested.
Split partly contested balances so only the contested portion is logged.
Done when contested recoverables and amounts are identified.
verify: Compare identified amounts to the reinsurer correspondence.
Pass when every logged amount matches the amount actually contested.

steps.title: Reclassify the balance as disputed in the ageing
sop: Reclassify the contested amount from collectable to disputed.
Leave the uncontested remainder in the collectable ageing.
Record the reclassification date on the balance.
Done when contested amounts are reclassified as disputed.
verify: Re-run the collectable ageing after reclassification.
Pass when no disputed balance remains in the clean collectable ageing.

steps.title: Create the dispute record in the reinsurance administration system
sop: Create a dispute entry with the date raised and the basis of contest.
Record the disputed amount and the originating claims.
Link the entry to the treaty and counterparty.
Done when a complete dispute record exists for each contested balance.
verify: Check entries for date raised, basis, amount and originating claims.
Pass when no entry is missing one of the four fields.

Note the exclusion in the forecast working.
Confirm the forecast total reduces by the disputed amount.
Done when disputed amounts are excluded from the collection forecast.
verify: Compare the forecast reduction to the disputed amount logged.
Pass when the forecast reduction equals the disputed amount.

steps.title: Set the owner and next review date on the dispute record
sop: Assign a named owner to each dispute record at logging.
Set the next review date for the dispute.
Record both fields before closing the logging run.
Done when every dispute record carries an owner and review date.
verify: Query dispute records for an owner and next review date.
Pass when no dispute record lacks either field.

steps.title: Mirror material disputes into the legal matter management system
sop: Identify disputes above the materiality threshold.
Open or update the matter in the legal matter management system.
Cross-reference the matter to the reinsurance dispute record.
Done when material disputes are mirrored into the legal system.
verify: Compare material disputes to open legal matters.
Pass when every material dispute has a cross-referenced legal matter.

generic.Defined scope/population: Reinsurance disputes proceeding to arbitration under the treaty arbitration clause.

generic.Exception handling path: Timetable slippage is escalated to the panel through counsel with a revised proposal.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Management is accepted when arbitrator appointments meet the time limits in the clause.
generic.Evidence location: Arbitration matter record in the legal matter management system.

steps.title: Serve the arbitration demand per the treaty clause
sop: Read the arbitration clause for seat, rules and service requirements.
Draft and serve the arbitration demand accordingly.
Record the service date and method on the matter.
Done when the arbitration demand is served per the clause.
verify: Compare the service record to the clause requirements.
Pass when the demand was served by the required method and within any time limit.

steps.title: Appoint the party arbitrator and agree the umpire
sop: Appoint the party arbitrator within the clause time limit.
Engage with the counterparty on the umpire or chair appointment.
Record each appointment and its date on the matter.
Done when the panel is constituted within the clause time limits.
verify: Compare appointment dates to the clause time limits.
Pass when every appointment was made within its time limit.

steps.title: Diarise the procedural timetable milestones
sop: Take the procedural timetable set by the panel.
Diarise pleadings, disclosure and hearing milestones on the matter.
Assign an owner to each milestone.
Done when every timetable milestone is diarised with an owner.
verify: Check the matter for diarised milestones with owners.
Pass when no milestone is left undiarised or without an owner.

steps.title: Coordinate disclosure from the claim file repository
sop: Collect the documents within the panel disclosure order.
Check documents for privilege before release.
Produce the disclosure set by the timetable date.
Done when disclosure is produced within the ordered scope and date.
verify: Compare the disclosure set to the panel order.
Pass when the set matches the ordered scope and was produced on time.

steps.title: Track legal spend against the approved budget
sop: Record counsel and arbitrator fees on the matter as incurred.
Compare cumulative spend against the approved budget.
Escalate for a budget increase before exceeding the approval.
Done when legal spend is tracked against the budget through the proceedings.
verify: Compare recorded spend to the approved budget.
Pass when no spend exceeded the approved budget without an escalation.

steps.title: Record the final award on the matter and in the reinsurance system
sop: Obtain the final award from the panel.
File the award on the matter with its date.
Notify the reinsurance administration system owner to record the outcome.
Done when the final award is filed and the outcome notified.
verify: Open the matter and locate the filed award.
Pass when the award is filed with its date and the outcome notified.

generic.Defined scope/population: The company case and evidence to be presented to the arbitration panel for the dispute.
generic.In-scope period: The procedural timetable window set by the panel for filings and the hearing.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Filing record holds bundle contents, witness statements, expert reports and filing dates.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Documents in the hearing bundle match the index agreed with the counterparty.

generic.Exception handling path: Extension requests are made to the panel through counsel before a deadline is missed.

steps.title: Compile the hearing bundle from the claim file repository
sop: Compile the hearing bundle from the indexed evidence pack.
Agree the bundle index with the counterparty where required.
Paginate the bundle in the form the panel directs.
Done when the hearing bundle is compiled and indexed.
verify: Compare the bundle contents to the agreed index.
Pass when the bundle matches the agreed index.

steps.title: Prepare witness statements on the claim chronology
sop: Identify the company witnesses on the claim chronology and cession decisions.
Prepare statements covering the facts each witness can speak to.
Check each statement against the underlying documents.

steps.title: Serve expert evidence where directed by the panel
sop: Read the panel direction on expert evidence.
Instruct the expert on market custom or aggregation as directed.
Serve the expert report by the directed date.

verify: Compare the served expert evidence to the panel direction.
Pass when the evidence served matches the direction and date.

steps.title: File the bundle and statements by the panel deadline
sop: File the hearing bundle and witness statements with the panel.
Copy the counterparty on every filing.
Record the filing date on the matter.
Done when the bundle and statements are filed with the panel.
verify: Compare filing dates to the panel procedural deadlines.
Pass when no filing was made after its deadline.

steps.title: Prepare company witnesses for the hearing
sop: Brief each witness on the chronology and the cession decisions taken.
Run through the documents each witness will be taken to.
Confirm witness availability for the hearing dates.
Done when company witnesses are prepared for the hearing.
verify: Confirm each witness has completed preparation and is available.
Pass when every company witness is prepared and available.

steps.title: File post-hearing submissions within the panel timetable
sop: Draft the post-hearing submissions on the issues the panel identified.
File the submissions within the timetable set by the panel.
Store the filed submissions on the matter with their dates.
Done when post-hearing submissions are filed within the timetable.
verify: Compare the submission filing date to the panel timetable.

generic.Defined scope/population: Settlement payments and recovery receipts arising from resolved reinsurance disputes.

sop: Compare the payee bank details to the details already held.

verify: Check the payment record for a retained screening result.

sop: Raise the payment in the payment system with the verified details.

verify: Compare the raised payment to the verified details and amount.

Record both approvals against the payment.

verify: Query the payment for two recorded approvals.

sop: Post the payment to the ledger with the agreement or award reference.
Update the dispute record in the reinsurance system with the payment.

generic.Defined scope/population: Arbitration awards and negotiated settlements resolving reinsurance recovery disputes.
generic.In-scope period: Awards and settlements concluded since the previous outcome recording run.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Outcome record holds effective date, principal, interest, costs and the release scope.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Principal plus interest plus costs equals the total award or settlement amount.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Award or settlement agreement filed with its effective date and version.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Outcomes pending formal documentation are logged with the expected receipt date.
generic.Test population: All disputes resolved by award or settlement in the period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fails if an outcome is recorded without the amount split and the release scope.
generic.Exception handling path: Ambiguous release wording is referred to Legal Counsel before the record is closed.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: A record is accepted when the outcome is shown against the original claimed amount.
generic.Evidence location: Outcome records on the dispute in the reinsurance administration system and the legal matter system.

steps.title: File the award or settlement agreement to the dispute record
sop: Obtain the final award or the signed settlement agreement.
File it to the dispute record with the effective date.
Link the document to the legal matter management system matter.
Done when the outcome document is filed and linked.
verify: Open the dispute record and follow the document link.
Pass when the link resolves to the executed award or agreement.

steps.title: Split the amount between principal, interest and costs
sop: Read the award or agreement for the amount breakdown.
Record principal, interest and costs as separate components.
Check the components total the award or settlement amount.
Done when the amount split is recorded on the outcome.
verify: Sum the recorded components.
Pass when the components equal the total award or settlement amount.

steps.title: Record the release scope
sop: Read the release wording in the award or agreement.
Record whether the release covers this claim only or all claims on the treaty.
Note any carve-outs from the release.
Done when the release scope is recorded on the outcome.
verify: Compare the recorded scope to the release wording.
Pass when the recorded scope matches the document wording.

sop: Take the amount originally claimed on the dispute record.
Compare the settled or awarded amount against it.
Record the recovery rate achieved on the dispute.
Done when the outcome is shown against the original claimed amount.
verify: Recompute the recovery rate from the two amounts.
Pass when the recomputed rate agrees to the record.

steps.title: Set the dispute status to resolved
sop: Set the dispute status to resolved in the reinsurance system.
Record the resolution date and the outcome summary.
Close the matter in the legal matter management system.
Done when the dispute status is set to resolved.
verify: Query the dispute register for the resolved status.
Pass when the dispute shows resolved with an outcome summary.

sop: Notify the ERP general ledger owner of the amounts to recognise.
Split the notification between principal, interest and costs.
Reference the award or agreement on the notification.
